title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Summary:

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

The Sustaining Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the ongoing quality, manufacturability, and efficiency of Viavi Solutions Inc.'s products throughout their lifecycle. This position focuses on resolving product issues, optimizing manufacturing processes, and maintaining product documentation.

* Manage and update Bills of Materials (BOM) to reflect design changes, component obsolescence, and manufacturing optimizations.
* Analyze product designs and manufacturing processes to ensure manufacturability and identify areas for improvement.
* Collaborate with manufacturing operations to troubleshoot production issues, implement corrective actions, and improve overall line efficiency.
* Apply various quality techniques and perform quality analysis to identify root causes of product failures and implement robust solutions.
* Support existing products by addressing field returns, customer complaints, and internal quality escapes through effective sustaining engineering practices.
* Participate in design reviews and provide feedback on new product designs to ensure they meet manufacturing and quality standards.
* Document engineering changes, manufacturing procedures, and quality specifications thoroughly.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to product quality, cost reduction, and process optimization.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Qualifications:

* Proven experience in Sustaining Engineering or a similar role within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with Bill of Materials (BOM) management.
* Demonstrated expertise in manufacturability principles and their application in product design and production.
* Solid knowledge of manufacturing operations and various manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in quality analysis and the application of various quality techniques (e.g., FMEA, 8D, SPC).
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to root cause analysis.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

쿠팡 Privacy Business팀은 쿠팡의 각종 비즈니스와 운영과 관련하여 발생할 수 있는 개인정보보호 리스크를 관리 감독하는 역할을 수행하는 부서입니다. 개인정보보호법, 위치정보보호법, 정보통신망법 등에서 요구하는 개인정보보호 관련 의무 이행을 준수하기 위해 쿠팡 내부의 구체적인 기준과 이를 위한 업무 프로세스를 제시하는 역할을 수행하고 있습니다. 쿠팡 Privacy Business팀은 지속적으로 이러한 역할을 충실히 수행할 수 있는 각계의 전문가가 함께 하기를 바랍니다.

업무 내용

  • 개인정보보호 관련 각종 정책 수립 및 관리

  • 개인정보 Life-Cycle 관점에서 개인정보보호 법적 준거성 검토 (대만, 일본, 유럽 등 글로벌 계열사 지원)

  • 개인정보 처리관련 내부 프로세스 개선 및 관리

  • 개인정보보호 관련 인증(ISMS-P, CBPR, ISO) 심사 대응

자격 요건- L6 임직원

  • 최소 10년 이상의 정보보호 및 컴플라이언스 관련 경력 및 관련 분야의 학사 학위

  • 최소 5년 이상의 개인정보보호 업무 경력과 개인정보보호 관련 법제도에 대한 높은 이해도

  • 개인정보 컴플라이언스 문제를 검토하고 가이드를 할 수 있는 역량

  • 해외 개인정보보호법 관련 업무 경험자

  • 주도적으로 업무를 수행하고, 문제를 해결하고자 하는 열정

  • 조직의 다양한 이해관계자와 효과적으로 소통할 수 있는 뛰어난 의사소통 및 대인관계에 능통하신 분

  • 뛰어난 분석 및 문제 해결 기술과 프로젝트 관련 과제를 예측하고 해결 하는 능력

우대 사항

  • ISMS-P 등 개인정보 보호 관련 인증심사 자격증 보유자 내지 인증심사 경험자
  • 개인정보, 정보보호 분야 석박사 학위 소지자
  • 영어나 중국어 등 외국어 활용에 능통하신 분

근무지: 쿠팡 서울 구의오피스 (재택병행)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: Data Scientist- II
description:
Job Description

To plan, build, optimise and implement innovative quantitative analytical methodologies, procedures, products and advanced mathematical models that provide analytical support and interpret insights, to address business opportunities and problems and implement business strategy, with minimal guidance.

Hello Future Data Scientist II

Welcome to FNB, the home of the #changeables. We design for the shapeshifters and deliver products and services that make us incredibly proud of people that make it happen.

As part of our talent team, you will be surrounded by unique talents, diverse minds, and an adaptable environment that lives up to the promise of staying curious. Now’s the time to imagine your potential in a team where experts come together and ignite effective change.

Are you someone who can:

  • Deliver on model development, implementation, and governance for financial crime risk analytics (AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening).
  • Proactively identify analytical opportunities and solve unstructured problems with minimal guidance.
  • Translate technical solutions into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deliver clear and comprehensive technical documentation for models and processes.
  • Collaborate with business, risk, and technology teams across the FirstRand group to drive model effectiveness and compliance.
  • Support junior Data Scientists in developing both technical and business skills.
  • Apply SAS, SQL, and Python scripting for data manipulation, modelling, and automation.
  • Uphold model and rule governance standards and participate in periodic monitoring and reviews.
  • Demonstrate initiative and a solution-oriented mindset in high-stakes, regulated environments.

You will be an ideal candidate if you:

  • Hold an Honours Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
  • Have 2+ years of hands-on experience in developing and implementing analytical models, preferably in financial services.
  • Possess strong scripting skills in SAS, SQL, and Python.
  • Have experience in collaborating across multiple teams.
  • Experience in financial crime, fraud detection, or AML/CFT is a strong advantage.

You will have access to:

  • Opportunities to network and collaborate.
  • Challenging Work.
  • Opportunities to innovate.

We can be a match if you are:

  • Curious & courageous - you're driven by always wanting to know more and learn more and you're brave enough to.
  • Obsessed with mastery - you know what it takes to become good at what you do and are constantly pushing yourself to do it.
  • Adaptable, curious and willing to learn.
  • Passionate in providing insights.
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment.

Are you interested to take the step? We look forward to engaging with you further. Apply now!

title: Client Service Representative 1266
description:
If you are a current associate, you will need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

The Client Service Coordinator ("CSC") drives the flow of clients and pets through the hospital, maximizes the productivity of the veterinary medical team (in terms of numbers of clients and pets), ensures good communication with associates and clients, and coordinates the care of clients and pets in a happy, welcoming, friendly and efficient manner, influencing clients to return and refer their friends and families.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team. Actively recruit new clients by promoting hospital services and route the flow of clients and pets to ensure superior client care and maximum productivity of the veterinary medical team. Maximize the number of pets seen by the hospital team through through a productive and efficiently run hospital to support the needs of our wellness plan clients. Provide professional, efficient and exceptional service at all times. This includes encouraging hospital visits, welcoming clients and pets, ensuring that they are comfortable in the hospital, and educating them about their pet's health. Educate clients about Optimum Wellness Plans, preventative care, pet health needs and hospital services Assist incoming clients by completing the required documentation, entering all pet information and history in the computer, utilizing proper collars and tags for identification, and ensuring prompt service. Assist outgoing clients by providing all necessary instructions, information and invoices, dispensing prescription items per the veterinarian's instructions, selling retail products and scheduling future appointments. Manage the finances by maintaining accurate balances and utilizing proper opening and closing procedures. Conduct administrative functions as necessary. Other job duties as assigned.

THE FIVE PRINCIPLES

Quality –The consumer is our boss, quality is our work and value for money is our goal.

Responsibility –As individuals, we demand total responsibility from ourselves; as associates, we support the responsibility of others.

Mutuality –A mutual benefit is a shared benefit; a shared benefit will endure.

Efficiency –We use resources to the full, waste nothing and do only what we can do best.

Freedom –We need freedom to shape our future; we need profit to remain free.

HIRING QUALIFICATIONS COMPETENCIES
Leadership
Customer Focus
Peer Relationships
Integrity & Trust
Action Oriented
Listening
Functional
Preventative care and OWPs
Communication Skills
Client Service Skills
Priority Setting
Time Management
CAPABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE (CANDO)
Ability to multi-task-Manages multiple tasks at one time; quickly and accurately shifts attention among multiple tasks under distracting conditions without loss of accuracy or appearance of frustration.
Communication skills -Reads, writes and speaks fluent English, using appropriate grammar, style and vocabulary. Correctly spells commonly used English words and job specific terms. Demonstrates exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills.
Organizational ability–Demonstrates a systematic approach in carrying out assignments. Is very orderly and excels at cutting through confusion and turning chaos into order.
Problem solving skills -Demonstrates a strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. Translates problems into practical solutions.
Client service skills -Consistently ensures the team provides the client with attentive, courteous and informative service. Gains and shows personal satisfaction from delivering great service.
Intellectual ability-Accurately and consistently follows instructions delivered in an oral, written or diagram format. Can provide directions.
Mathematical ability-Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide, and to compute rate, ratio and percent; ability to convert units of measurement.
Computer skills-Comfortably and confidently uses a computer and specialized software. Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.
ATTITUDES (WILLDO)
Initiative–shows willingness and aptitude to use own discretion in taking appropriate steps in finding solutions to problems; presents options and ideas to enhance current processes or procedures. Takes on additional responsibility when both big and small tasks need to be done.
Integrity–Firmly adheres to the values and ethics of Banfield Pet Hospitals. Exhibits honesty, discretion, and sound judgment.
Cooperativeness–Willing to work with others, collaborating and compromising where necessary; promptly share relevant information with others.
Flexibility–Is open to changing situations and opportunities and is willing to perform all tasks assigned.
Independence–Able and willing to perform tasks and duties without supervision.
Tolerance for Stress / Resiliency–Maintains a positive “can do” outlook, rebounds quickly from frustrations and unpleasantness, and maintains composure and friendly demeanor while dealing with stressful situations.
SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS
Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.
Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)
Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.
Must have mental processes for reasoning, remembering, mathematics and language ability (reading, writing, and speaking the English language) to perform the duties proficiently.
The noise level in the work environment is moderately high.
Requires sufficient ambulatory skills in order to perform duties while at hospital.
Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.
Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.
EXPERIENCE,EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING
High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Must be at least 18 years old to perform duties involving radiography (x-ray) and exposure to radioactive substances.
One year related experience required with customer service preferred.
Medical background (veterinary technician, human healthcare, pharmaceutical, etc.) with medical terminology training is preferred.

$15.00 - $18.69 Hourly

title: Principal Power Systems Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

We are seeking a full-time Principal DERMS Power System Engineer to support the design, modeling, integration, and operation of distributed energy resources (DERs), including solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging, and other inverter-based resources. The ideal candidate will have strong power system fundamentals, hands-on modeling experience, and knowledge of interconnection standards and utility requirements.

In this role, the Principal. DERMS Power Systems Engineer will report directly to Manager and Working from AspenTech’ s Medina office, the successful applicant will contribute to project delivery and product management excellence in support of utility customers in the energy management industry.

Your Impact

  • Collaborate with customers and engineering teams to understand requirements and project plans for AspenTech DGM applications
  • Design, integrate, test, and commission advanced control systems for electric utilities.
  • Install and configure DERMS and DER applications.
  • Communicate detailed requirements to internal departments as needed.
  • Work directly with customers and remote engineering team members to understand requirements and communicate project plans.
  • Perform customer training and consult on power system modeling to ensure the effective use and maintenance of a customer’s power system applications.
  • Assist in creating project and product documentation as needed.
  • Perform unit testing and tuning to ensure power system applications will meet customer and industry requirements.
  • Support live customer systems using knowledge of power systems and DGM application functionality with clear, logical thought processes.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry standards and trends.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Systems Engineering or related technical field. Master’s degree with an emphasis in Power Systems preferred.
  • 5+ years of power systems, project engineering, or related technical project implementation experience required.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel up to 25% to domestic and international customer sites.
  • Technical background with the ability to apply knowledge spanning renewable and integration of renewable into the electric grid solutions required.
  • Understanding of DERs and integration DERs back to grid, including operation, control, and optimization.
  • Experience with DER modelling
  • Understanding/knowledge of IEEE1547 and other DER standards and protocols: example: OpenADR, IEEE2030.5
  • Knowledge of Virtual Power Plants, DER aggregations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills; analytical and problem-solving skills; commitment to providing superior customer service; and ability to multi-task on several projects in a fast-paced environment are required.

Additional Qualifications and Experience

  • The ability to utilize scripting languages (e.g., Python, C) for automation or problem-solving will be helpful.

Work Authorization

AspenTech will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

title: Financial Wellness Associate

19735 Tenth Avenue NE - Poulsbo, Washington 98370

As part of the branch team in a hybrid platform role, the FWA works closely with branch leadership and teammates to prioritize high-impact activities, ensuring their time is used strategically to support branch performance. At KeyBank, we believe it's our opportunity and our privilege to help our clients move forward in their financial journey. We take pride in serving our clients and making them feel that no bank will fight harder for them.

title: Staff Engineer AI
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: This is an onsite role based at Nextiva’s Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048). Working together onsite strengthens how we operate, enabling faster decisions, clearer communication, and stronger execution, so you can make a greater impact and move work forward with speed and clarity.

In-Office Expectation: This role is expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week, as required by the business. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity.

The Staff Engineer – AI is a hands-on individual contributor role for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, system design, and AI-powered applications. This role will play a key part in designing, building, and launching new AI capabilities while collaborating across Nextiva engineering teams and with external technology partners.

As a Staff Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of hands-on engineering, system design, and early-stage technical solutioning. You will take ownership of new capabilities from initial technical discussions through architecture, development, production readiness, and launch.

This is not an architecture-only role. We are looking for an engineer who stays close to the code, builds alongside the team, and can translate complex or ambiguous technical problems into scalable production solutions.

You will work on initiatives involving NextIQ, including collaboration with the Google Gemini team to bring capabilities developed within Nextiva into partner environments. You will also partner closely with Nextiva product and engineering teams in the U.S. and other locations, including teams working on NextOS, to extend NextIQ capabilities across the Nextiva ecosystem.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building new capabilities from the ground up, and taking end-to-end technical ownership while remaining a deeply hands-on individual contributor.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer – AI to accelerate Nextiva’s AI initiatives and help deliver exceptional customer experiences through a unified, modern platform powered by AI and automation.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and launch scalable AI-focused engineering capabilities, services, and modules.
  • Own complex engineering initiatives end to end, from early-stage technical solutioning and system design through implementation, production readiness, and launch.
  • Remain deeply hands-on with software development and contribute high-quality production code.
  • Build robust services and platforms using Python and strong distributed-systems engineering principles.
  • Lead and contribute to system design, architecture, and technical solutioning discussions across engineering teams.
  • Work closely with the Google Gemini team on initiatives that bring NextIQ capabilities into Gemini and related partner experiences.
  • Collaborate with external technology partners to integrate and extend Nextiva capabilities into their platforms and environments.
  • Partner with U.S.-based and global Nextiva product and engineering teams on new AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with teams supporting NextOS to extend NextIQ capabilities across the broader Nextiva ecosystem.
  • Navigate ambiguous, early-stage technical problems and translate them into practical, scalable engineering solutions.
  • Identify technical risks, trade-offs, and dependencies and drive decisions that enable teams to move quickly and effectively.
  • Establish strong engineering practices around scalability, reliability, observability, testing, and production readiness.
  • Take accountability for successfully designing, building, launching, and evolving the capabilities you own.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • 9 –15+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering production software.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Python and modern software engineering practices.
  • Strong system design and architecture capabilities.
  • Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and scalable backend services.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and launching complex software modules, services, or platform capabilities end to end.
  • Experience taking technical initiatives from initial solutioning and design through development, production deployment, and launch.
  • Ability and willingness to remain deeply hands-on with coding at the Staff Engineer level.
  • Experience influencing architecture and technical direction across teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Experience working on new initiatives where requirements, architecture, and technical approaches may still be evolving.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with internal engineering teams, product teams, and external technology partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams, including regular partnership with teams based in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating as a Staff Engineer or equivalent senior individual contributor in a product or technology organization.
  • Experience building new products, platforms, modules, or technical capabilities from the ground up.
  • Experience combining system-level architecture responsibilities with significant hands-on implementation.
  • Experience building or integrating AI/ML, generative AI, LLM, or agentic AI capabilities into production applications.
  • Experience integrating applications with modern AI platforms, APIs, or foundation models.
  • Experience collaborating directly with external technology partners on complex integrations.
  • Experience working across globally distributed engineering organizations.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising engineering standards through technical leadership and influence.

AI & Modern Engineering Expectations

description:
ICONIQ is seeking an Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Corporate Finance team, with a focus on the systems, data, and analytical infrastructure that support our financial planning and analysis capabilities. This is an opportunity for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with technical curiosity and an interest in building scalable processes and tools. As a member of a small, highly visible team, you’ll help support and expand our enterprise planning platform and related data infrastructure, enabling forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and strategic analysis. Candidates will be considered at the Analyst or Senior Analyst level depending on experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Build financial reporting, dashboards, models, and analyses that give senior stakeholders greater visibility into resourcing, profitability, cost drivers, and other key business metrics.
  • Help manage firmwide time tracking and allocations, maintaining data flows and calculation logic and supporting accurate department- and client-level allocation data.
  • Develop and maintain data flows across source systems, our data warehouse, and enterprise planning platform to enable accurate, scalable financial planning and reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, strengthen data quality and controls, streamline workflows, and reduce reliance on offline spreadsheets.

title: AutoChrome Operator
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for operating machinery that forms material into 3D decals by molding, backfilling, laser cutting, and/or laminating to create finished products.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Receives flat product stock from Material Handler.
  • Determines priority of jobs by analyzing production schedule.
  • Sets up machinery according to job specification.
  • Reviews and verifies tolerances of blueprints and ensures forming plates are in tolerance.
  • Runs all jobs according to customer and BGS requirements, submitting first sheet for approval to AutoChrome Supervisor.
  • Continually monitors adherence to the approved first sheet at a predetermined interval and stops if any deviation is noted.
  • Performs corrective action if necessary if product defect is noted.
  • Performs tear down tasks following run completion.
  • Records accurate production activities in quality management system.
  • Fills resin tanks when needed and changes barrel when empty on backfill machinery.
  • Operates automatic laminator unit to attach adhesive on Kromex material.
  • Sets up and operates laser to cut Kromes parts to BGS and customer specifications.
  • Performs complete tear down of the backfill mixer at the end of the work week
  • Performs preventative maintenance as needed including oiling and greasing machine parts.
  • Understands and implements company policies and safety regulations in all aspects of duties performed in this role.
  • Maintains cleanliness of work area and equipment.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities. Carries out conduct and leadership responsibilities professionally in accordance with company policies, procedures, safety, and applicable laws.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals in English. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence in English. Ability to speak effectively with small groups of customers or employees of BGS.


Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to

compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standard situations.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk for 8+ hours; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must regularly lift/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts, fumes, toxic chemicals, and heat. The noise level in the work environment Is usually loud

title: Pulsed Power Engineer
description:
Our Directed Energy team in Albuquerque is looking for a experienced Pulsed Power Engineer to contribute to the research and development of game changing, next-generation technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern equipment in cutting-edge laboratories at the Air Force Research Laboratories (AFRL) on Kirtland AFB, where you will see designs and ideas transformed into state-of-the art pulsed power devices and high power microwave (HPM) sources and systems. Working alongside our scientists, engineers, and technicians, our successful candidate will be afforded the satisfaction of building and testing new and novel creations in both laboratory and field settings.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and characterize novel pulsed-power devices and high-power microwave (HPM) sources and systems, including pulsed-power generators, trigger systems, high-voltage switches, field coils, nonlinear transmission lines, HPM amplifiers, and antennas.
  • Plan and execute laboratory and field tests, including defining test objectives, developing test procedures, configuring experimental systems, conducting tests, analyzing data, and documenting results.
  • Design and develop high-speed diagnostic and data-acquisition systems required to characterize pulsed-power and HPM devices and systems.
  • Develop and implement measurement techniques for high-voltage, high-current, high-frequency, and fast-transient systems.
  • Analyze experimental data to characterize system performance, identify failure modes, and guide subsequent design iterations.
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, RF/microwave, and test engineers to integrate and troubleshoot complex pulsed-power systems.

title: Director of Campus Technology
description:
The University of Maine System is seeking a Director of Campus Technology to provide strategic and operational leadership for technology services at the University of Maine at Presque Isle. This position serves as the primary connection between campus leadership and UMS IT, translating campus goals into practical technology strategies, services, and resources.

The Director will lead campus technology initiatives, oversee campus-based IT staff, strengthen service delivery, and coordinate the campus response to significant technical incidents and disruptions. The successful candidate will be a collaborative leader who can build trusted relationships, balance competing priorities, and connect the distinct needs of the campus with System wide IT strategy and capabilities.

This is an office-based position that may require travel to other University locations or work sites. The Director may occasionally work evenings and weekends to support campus events, significant service disruptions, and other campus needs.

What You Will Do

  • Build and sustain strong relationships with campus leadership, faculty, staff, students, and UMS IT partners to promote strategic alignment and responsive technology services.

  • Consult with campus leaders and administrative personnel to identify current and emerging technology needs, evaluate options, recommend improvements, and coordinate solutions.

  • Oversee academic, administrative, and research related technology services at the assigned campus and promote consistent, efficient, customer focused service delivery.

  • Lead, coach, and support campus IT staff, including performance management, employee development, training, and appropriate corrective or disciplinary processes.

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, identify gaps between campus needs and available IT capabilities, and collaborate across UMS IT to develop effective solutions.

  • Provide campus and IT leadership with executive level reports and key performance indicators related to Tier 2 support and customer service.

  • Coordinate campus response to significant technical incidents and service disruptions, including communication with campus and System stakeholders.

  • Participate in UMS IT leadership activities, campus committees, and the UMS IT Service Desk Council to advance shared priorities and service improvements.

  • Develop budget requests, monitor designated technology budgets, and represent UMS IT with relevant external groups, partners, and service providers.

  • Maintain compliance with University and UMS IT standards, policies, and procedures while remaining current on technology solutions and service management practices.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience, including leadership or supervisory responsibility.

  • Seven years of progressively responsible experience in mid-to-senior level information technology roles.

  • Broad knowledge of enterprise technology environments, including networking, data communications, telecommunications, hardware, and software systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop employees and guide teams toward organizational goals.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and conflict management skills, including the ability to explain complex information to varied audiences.

  • A collaborative and transparent leadership approach, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience providing technology leadership and services in higher education, including support for faculty, researchers, staff, and students.

  • Experience working effectively in a complex, decentralized organization.

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, endpoint technologies, networking, telecommunications, and IT service delivery.

  • Experience developing and implementing technology roadmaps and leading initiatives across multiple teams and functional areas.

What We Offer: Our comprehensive benefits package can be worth up to 50% of your annual salary and is designed to support your health, financial well-being, professional growth, and work-life balance. Benefits include:

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness programs supporting your health and well-being.

  • Professional development and opportunities to grow your career within Maine's public universities.

  • Additional voluntary benefits, including pet insurance, home and auto insurance discounts, and supplemental disability and life insurance options

title: Military Family Life Counselor - Adult - JBER, AK
description:
Leidos is hiring licensed behavioral health professionals to join our Adult Military and Family Life Counseling (MFLC) team to support Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, AK.

Join the mission to support U.S. military service members and their families as they work through important military life adjustments while serving their country. The Adult Military and Family Life Counselor (Adult-MFLC) position offers a unique opportunity to serve a vital role, in providing non-medical support, which includes counseling, consultation, and outreach, to service members, military family members and eligible staff. Non-medical counseling is preventive in nature and aims to address and provide solution focused approaches to issues before they become greater challenges.

Service members, spouses and family members face unique emotional and environmental challenges due to the stress of military life. This is an opportunity for you to reach them where and when you are most needed.

Adult-MFLC responsibilities include:

  • Face-to-face counseling to military service members and their families (individuals, couples, and families).
  • Visually observe, participate, and engage in activities with service members, military spouses and families; provide coaching, guidance and support to installation staff; and model behavior management techniques for staff and military family members.
  • Offer presentations to service members, military families, and military leadership at military-connect events.
  • Promote creativity and positivity through approved materials.
  • Build rapport with parents and families by attending installation and community events.
  • Help with transition adjustments, such as a new school and a new home.
  • Participate in regular in-service training or other contract activities as assigned.
  • Communicate information regarding trends and issues at assigned installation to Team Leads.

Adult-MFLC will also benefit from:

  • No insurance to file.
  • No progress notes required.
  • No treatment plans to develop.
  • iPad provided for easy digital reporting, with no PII or PHI.
  • Paid federal holidays.
  • Free and unlimited behavioral healthcare training.
  • Reimbursement for job-related license renewal fees.
  • Eligibility to participate in 401K retirement plan.
  • Centralized support through a Counseling Center of Excellence that provides best practices, expert speakers, and state-of-the-art resources.

Additional Job Duties May Include:

  • Responding to emergent situations in any physical location on a military installation
  • Traversing long distances to both indoor and outdoor locations, to maneuver through rugged, outdoor, or uneven locations (ascend/descend), and work in outdoor weather.
  • Travelling to locations outside of a military base in a variety of physical environments.
  • Due to the nature of working on military installations or related worksites, counselors may need to comply with various site-specific requirements to work at designated locations.

Environment:

At the direction of the Department of Defense, duties are performed in multiple indoor locations (approximately 60%) and outdoor locations (approximately 40%). The indoor locations are located within a school setting controlled by the state and/or Department of Defense Education Activity. The outdoor locations frequently involve traversing over uneven grassy, gravel, and/or dirt areas, ascending/descending stairs, and exposure to the weather.

Licensure Portability

Great news! Under the recent National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), licensed Military and Family Life Counselors may provide non-medical counseling services to military families at any location in a U.S. state, the District of Columbia, or a territory or possession of the United States, regardless of which state the counselor is licensed in. Within the scope of the MFLC program, a counselor may hold any independent and clinical license recognized by the Secretary of Defense as an appropriate license for the provision of non-medical counseling services.

Minimum Requirements:

  • A Master’s degree or higher in the Behavioral Health Professions (MS/MSW/MA/PhD).
  • The candidate must hold a valid independent license in the mental health field from any US state or territory (LCSW, MHC, MFT, LPCC, Psychologist).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to pass a basic background check for employment, a Child National Agency Check, and Inquiries (NACI/CNACI) clearance, commonly called a Public Trust clearance.

Job Description:

Consolidates load lists for all products shipping on trucks/carriers. Coordinates all loads leaving facility with loaders, liaisons, outside locations and Wilsonart drivers. Performs other tasks as required. This position is for N1.

title: Shift Lead
description:

VETERINARY HOSPITAL SHIFT LEAD

JOB SUMMARY

The Veterinary Hospital Shift Lead (“Shift Lead”) provides exceptional client and pet experiences while assisting the Practice Manager and/or Chief of Staff (COS) in guiding the team to maximize productivity and profitability of the hospital, and helps ensure effective communication with all clients, internal stakeholders, and colleagues. The Shift Lead also performs the duties of a Client Services Coordinator and Veterinary Assistant when needed.

  • Must have mental processes for reasoning, remembering, mathematics and language ability (reading, writing, and speaking the English language) to perform the duties proficiently.

  • You must be comfortable working in an environment with loud noise (moderately high) and strong smells.

  • Requires sufficient ambulatory skills to perform duties while at hospital.

  • Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.

  • Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

  • Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.

Experience, Education and/or Training

title: Manufacturing Engineering
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Workers’ Compensation Assistant supports the timely, accurate, and consistent processing of workers’ compensation reports of injury in partnership with the Workers’ Compensation Manager. title: EMT or AEMT Full Time, Nights
description:
Summary

The Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) plays a crucial role in providing emergency medical care and transportation to patients in need. This position requires a high level of professionalism, compassion, and medical expertise to ensure the safety and well-being of patients during critical situations.

Job Description:

Baptist Health is looking for a full-time, night shift EMT or AEMT to join our EMS Transport team at Baptist Health Louisville!


Full-time, 36 hours/3 days per week.

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments to identify injuries, illnesses, or medical emergencies.
  • Provide compassionate care and emotional support to patients and their families during transport to medical facilities.
  • Monitor vital signs and adjust treatment interventions as necessary to ensure patient stability and comfort.
  • Lifting and moving of patients to and from stretchers, frequently lifting more than 250lbs in a team setting.
  • Safely transport patients to medical facilities using designated EMS vehicles.
  • Communicate effectively with receiving medical personnel to provide a detailed patient handover and report on the patient's condition, treatment provided, and any pertinent medical history.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of patient assessments, treatments, and transportation activities.

description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

회사 소개

쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.
쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.
대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.
보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.

업무 내용

  • 비즈니스 도메인팀의 서비스를 위한 기반 플랫폼 서비스 설계, 구축 및 운영
  • Zero downtime 을 달성하기 위한 쿠팡 Fintech 차세대 infrastructure & platform 의 설계 및 구현
  • HA/DR Architecture 설계 (clustering, replication 등)를 주도 및 구현
  • CI/CD DevOps 도구 고도화 및 최적화(considering both cloud and on-premise environments)
  • best practice 를 발굴하고 팀에 전파

자격 요건 - Lv5 SW Engineer 직군 임직원

  • 팀 플레이어
  • Unix/Linux 기반의 5년 이상의 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 경력
  • 3년 이상의 backend architecture 설계 및 구현 경험
  • Strong coding skill - OOP and scripting language
  • 장애 관리 및 모니터링 기능이 있는 대규모 운영 시스템 경험
  • 조직이 확장되고 시스템이 복잡해지면서 발생하는 문제들을 겪고 구조적으로 해결해 본 경험
  • 컴퓨터 공학 또는 관련 기술 분야의 학사 학위를 소지한 자

우대 사항

  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를처리 할 수 있는 능력
  • Cloud background (docker, K8S and AWS/ Google/ Azure)
  • API Gateway, Service Mesh 를 company-wide 적용 경험
  • Strong Java, distributed systems, micro services, messaging services
  • 애자일소프트웨어 방법론이 익숙하신 분
  • 장애 관리 및 모니터링 기능이 있는 대규모 운영 시스템 경험이 있는 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: Head of Regulated Entities, EMEA
description:
Head of Regulated Entities, EMEA / Hybrid 1-2 days per week in the Dublin office / Competitive basic salary, plus Annual STIP Bonus / Benefits / Permanent


About the Team/Role

The Head of Regulated Entities, EMEA (HRE) is a critical executive leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, day-to-day management, and operational governance of WEX’s regulated electronic money institutions (EMIs) across the EMEA region: Optal Financial Europe Limited (OFEL) in Dublin, Ireland, and Optal Financial Limited (OFL) in London, United Kingdom.


Acting as a pivotal liaison to key regulatory authorities, primarily the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), the HRE ensures that all entity operations maintain the highest standards of compliance, risk management, and governance. The successful candidate will drive the operational execution of strategic initiatives set by the WEX Group Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and local Boards of Directors.


In this role, you will be expected to foster operational excellence by adopting modern tools and capabilities, including AI, automation, and advanced analytics, to optimize governance, scale operational resilience frameworks, and drive efficient execution in a multi-jurisdictional, matrixed environment.


What’s on offer?

  • Highly competitive salary (dependant on experience)
  • Annual Company Bonus
  • 40-hour week - Monday to Friday, no evenings or weekends
  • Hybrid working (1-2 days per week in the Dublin office)
  • Pension PRSA - 7% Employer and 3% Employee
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Group Life Assurance
  • Employee wellbeing platforms

How you'll make an impact


Regulatory Governance & Operational Oversight

  • Regulatory Liaison: Serve as the primary operational liaison point for regulators, particularly the CBI and FCA, ensuring full alignment with regulatory expectations and statutory obligations across OFEL and OFL.
  • Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all regional operations comply strictly with applicable legal and regulatory frameworks, partnering closely with the Heads of Risk & Compliance to maintain and advance robust governance and oversight models.
  • Operational Resilience Framework: Accountable for the Operational Resilience Frameworks of OFEL and OFL, including the operational resilience of critical third-party and internal service providers; provide specialist guidance to the OFEL and OFL Boards.
  • Outsourcing Oversight: Maintain full accountability for the management, oversight, and performance monitoring of services delivered via internal Outsourced Service Providers (OSPs) and external vendors. Supervise the Outsourced Service Implementation Manager in carrying out day-to-day operational delivery oversight.
  • IT & Technology Supervision: Direct oversight of all IT-related operational matters, ensuring systemic stability, data security, and seamless service delivery.
  • Individual Accountability Framework (IAF): Take direct responsibility for the annual certification and ongoing oversight of all relevant employees under the CBI’s IAF regime.

Strategic Leadership, Innovation & Business Partnership

  • Executive Alignment & Strategy: Implement strategic priorities and key initiatives defined by the WEX Group ELT and the OFEL/OFL Boards of Directors.
  • Financial & Resource Management: Partner with OFEL and OFL Finance Directors to manage Ireland- and UK-based personnel and operational expenditure within agreed budgets and target metrics.
  • AI & Process Innovation: Identify and leverage modern digital technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and automated reporting platforms, to modernize regulatory operations, streamline oversight of outsourced providers, and enhance data-driven decision-making.
  • Board Communication: Communicate proactively and transparently with the Group ELT and local Boards of Directors, keeping them informed of business performance, emerging risks, regulatory changes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Partner & Key Stakeholder Management: Maintain and nurture key strategic relationships at local and Group levels with critical commercial and ecosystem partners (e.g., Mastercard, eNett, and banking partners).
  • People Leadership & Coaching: Provide guidance, mentorship, performance management, and continuous development for all Ireland- and UK-based staff across the regulated entities.

Experience you'll bring

  • Progressive leadership experience in operations (IT ops, outsourcing, general management), legal, compliance, or risk management within a regulated financial services environment (EMIs or Payment Institutions strongly preferred).
  • Proven track record of executive leadership within a regulated payments or card issuing environment, including practical operational knowledge of card scheme operations.
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing Outsourced Service Providers (OSPs) in compliance with FCA, EBA, and CBI outsourcing guidelines and industry best practices.
  • Demonstrated success supporting complex projects and navigating governance within a matrixed, multinational public organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Management, Economics, Law, IT, or equivalent senior professional experience.

Skills and Competencies

  • Deep commercial and structural understanding of the B2B e-money, card issuing, and payments landscape in Europe and the UK.
  • Technology & AI Fluency: A proactive mindset towards adopting and championing modern technology tools (e.g., Gemini, AI-driven workflow engines, data visualization toolsets) to automate operational routines, improve resilience metrics, and elevate reporting quality.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to communicate complex operational and regulatory challenges to Board-level executives and international leadership.
  • Broad knowledge of international laws, regulatory expectations, and corporate governance standards applicable to multinational financial institutions.

Other Requirements

  • Residency & Authorizations: Must be an Irish resident legally authorized to work in Ireland to fulfill CBI regulatory expectations.
  • Regulatory Approvals: This position is a Pre-Approved Control Function (PCF) role subject to formal approval by the Central Bank of Ireland’s (CBI) Fitness and Probity team, as well as an EMD role subject to FCA approval.
  • Fitness & Probity Standards: Must formally agree in writing to comply with and abide by the CBI’s Fitness and Probity Standards (including Common Conduct Standards and Additional Conduct Standards), the OFEL Individual Accountability Framework (IAF), and the WEX International Fitness & Probity Policy.
  • Conflict Management: Strict adherence to WEX policies concerning conflicts of interest, including proactive identification, prevention, and resolution of real or perceived conflicts.
  • Comprehensive Governance & Handover: Ensure absolute operational oversight over assigned business areas, maintaining detailed, orderly handover protocols and documentation for any role changes under your responsibility to guarantee business continuity and compliance.

What's next?

If you feel that you have the necessary skills to be our Head of Regulated Entities, EMEA then please APPLY TODAY for immediate consideration.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.


Due to the volume of applications received, unfortunately it is not possible to respond to each one individually, applicants that are shortlisted will be contacted within one week of application.


We do not accept speculative agency CVs. Any CV received by WEX will be treated as a gift and will not be eligible for an agency fee. PSL agencies should only send CVs if authorised to do so by the Talent Acquisition team.

title: PT Sports Information Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Sports Information Specialist supports the promotion, communication, and documentation of Wallace State athletics and its student-athletes. This position assists with athletics communications, game-day coverage, statistics, website and social media content, photography and other media needs, and promotion of athletic programs and accomplishments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide game-day sports information and communications support for Wallace State athletic events.
  1. Compile, maintain, and report accurate team rosters, schedules, statistics, scores, records, and other athletic information.
  2. Update athletics website content, schedules, results, statistics, and related information.
  3. Develop and post timely content for athletics social media channels, including scores, highlights, student-athlete achievements, and upcoming events.
  4. Assist with photography, video, graphics, and other digital content for athletic communications and promotions.
  5. Prepare or assist with news releases, game recaps, feature stories, and other athletics-related communications.
  6. Coordinate with coaches and athletic staff to gather information and promote teams and student-athletes.
  7. Assist with nominations, awards, postseason reporting, and information requested by conference and national athletic organizations.

title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineering - Liquid Cooling.
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

  • The Manufacturing Engineer (P3) plays a critical role in driving operational excellence through the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and systems. With 4–8 years of experience, this professional leads cross-functional initiatives, supports strategic planning, and ensures alignment with business goals related to efficiency, quality, and productivity. The role includes leadership responsibilities, project ownership, and mentoring of junior engineers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead efforts to analyze and improve manufacturing processes, focusing on cost reduction, cycle time, quality enhancement, and throughput.
  • Develop and implement lean manufacturing initiatives and Six Sigma methodologies to drive continuous improvement.
  • Evaluate and integrate new technologies and automation solutions to enhance production capabilities.
  • Serve as the manufacturing lead for NPI projects, ensuring seamless transition from design to production.
  • Collaborate with R&D and design engineering to influence product designs for manufacturability and scalability.
  • Develop and validate manufacturing processes for new products, including tooling, equipment, and work instructions.
  • Manage complex manufacturing projects, including process transfers, equipment upgrades, and layout changes.
  • Define project scope, timelines, budgets, and resource requirements; ensure timely execution and delivery.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of process documentation, SOPs, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure compliance with internal quality standards, ISO requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Support audits and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers and technicians, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.
  • Provide training on new processes, equipment, and safety protocols.
  • Act as a technical resource for troubleshooting and problem-solving across production teams.
  • Lead structured problem-solving efforts using tools such as 8D, Fishbone, and FMEA.
  • Implement corrective and preventive actions to address recurring issues and improve process reliability.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Health Information Specialist I
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. title: Clinical Education Specialist (West Region)
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Your Role at Baxter

THIS IS WHERE you build trust to achieve results!


As a Clinical Education Specialist, you take pride in training clinicians on the use, adoption and optimization of Baxter Infusion Therapy products at customer sites across the country. Your clinical understanding of our deep portfolio of infusion pumps, syringe pumps, accessories and software upgrades and belief in the value and quality they provide to patients fuels your confidence. Our customers trust you and appreciate your knowledge and curiosity when finding solutions to meet their patient and organizational needs. You enjoy being on location leading classroom training to supporting go-live on clinical units and are actively building relationships, and establishing trust with the Nursing and Physician decision-makers for staff who use Baxter solutions every day.

As a primary connection to the healthcare leaders and professionals who rely on our products to save and sustain lives, you are the face and voice of our solutions. You enjoy seeing the connections between teams and how they work together to drive business results. The insights and feedback you share with your team and to cross-functional partners help validate and inform priorities and changes. Are you ready to be a clinical leader on our Infusion Systems team?!

  • Effectively executing clinical implementation and integration tasks at key Baxter customers
  • Building or deepening customer relationships with customer clinical staff and nursing educators at targeted healthcare facilities and healthcare systems applying a consultative approach
  • Having a steadfast focus on safe and effective use of infusion pump technology, clinical change management, and product expertise
  • Maintaining expert knowledge of Baxter’s Infusion Therapy products and integrated solutions and ensuring quality and integrity in implementations using the Universal Implementation Process and in-service scripts
  • Supervising and delivering product training and integration objectives for new and existing customers through defined, multi-phased implementation processes, access to eLearning, on-site training, use of collateral training material, and consistent follow-up
  • Appling education, product and clinical knowledge to troubleshoot and solving problems while ensuring adoption of new technology

title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist I
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity
This position works out of our Madison, WI location supporting clinical trials in our Cancer Diagnostics division.


We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.


Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key health and therapeutic areas, including infectious disease, cardiometabolic, informatics, and toxicology.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

Our rapid diagnostics solutions are helping address some of the world’s greatest healthcare challenges.


Our molecular division delivers best-in-class innovative testing solutions for people around the world to provide answers to life’s critical health decisions. We help people live full and healthy lives through our accessible, molecular-based solutions.

Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00 a.m.–6:30 p.m.

Flexibility required for special projects; schedule may vary with advance notice.

The Clinical Study Scientist I performs specimen processing and laboratory analysis on clinical trial specimens using established Laboratory procedures. The Clinical Study Scientist duties will include, but are not limited to, processing clinical trial samples, performing and documenting quality assurance, quality control, equipment maintenance, storing and shipping samples, performance of moderate, and highly complex analytical testing, and accurately documenting all work performed under the direction of the Laboratory Medical Director. As a Clinical Study Scientist I, you will recognize and resolve problems using good laboratory practices.


What You’ll Work On

· Perform processing blood, stool, and other type of clinical trial samples. Interpret problems with specimens which meet the rejection criteria for unacceptable samples. Make the decision to reject a sample and request recollection to ensure validity of results.

· Accession specimens for testing and determine acceptability of samples within guidelines.

· Identify samples collection issues and report them to the Lab Leadership in a timely manner.

· Follow scheduling and tasks assigned by the Clinical Study Team Leadership.

· Operate laboratory instruments and ensure proper functioning of laboratory equipment.

· Run sample processing automation.

· Report any automation, equipment, and specimen related issues to the Lab Leadership in a timely manner.

· Participate in Clinical Study Team sample pulling process and projects.

· Complete and document required maintenance activities on equipment, recognize and elevate potential issues reporting service needs to leadership for resolution.

· Perform appropriate specimen collection, handling, and transport procedures.

· Perform quality control procedures as specified and maintain quality control records and documentation necessary to meet the standards of accrediting agencies.

· Assist in developing procedures for specimen collection, handling and transport to maintain specimen integrity and viability.

· Validate acceptability of sample processing or testing results by reviewing test parameters.

· Monitor quality assurance and assist in data collection and preparation of QA indicators.

· Maintain clean and orderly work area. Clean bench surfaces and equipment each shift or after contamination or spill.

· Meet work product output expectations maintaining all section turn-around times.

· Participate in continuing education and staff meetings. Prepare and present continuing education programs for department personnel as requested. Responsible for own professional development.

· Apply step by step thinking, problem solving and critical thinking patterns.

· Contribute to design, research, review and writing of laboratory manuals. Remain informed of procedure updates and changes.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
The Undersea Systems Division at Leidos currently has an opening for a Systems Engineer to support a customer site in San Diego, California. This is an exciting opportunity to apply systems engineering, naval operations, test and evaluation, and technical project-management experience in support of large-scale fleet activities and critical maritime missions.


The selected candidate will serve as the onsite Systems Engineer and senior technical representative, working closely with the Leidos Project Manager, customer leadership, engineers, fleet personnel, operational stakeholders, and government representatives. The position will support day-to-day onsite execution of program activities while also contributing directly to systems engineering, integration, test, and evaluation efforts.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the onsite senior technical representative for Leidos at the customer site in San Diego.
  • Work side by side with customer leadership and technical personnel to support day-to-day program execution and mission priorities.
  • Support the Leidos Project Manager with program planning, execution, customer coordination, schedule management, risk management, and delivery of program commitments.
  • Lead and coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder organizations.
  • Translate customer operational needs into technically sound engineering approaches, priorities, requirements, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with engineers, subcontractors, fleet personnel, operators, government stakeholders, and program leadership to resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Track technical scope, milestones, schedules, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Maintain project-management artifacts, including project plans, schedules, milestone trackers, risk and issue registers, action-item logs, and status reports.
  • Identify schedule, resource, technical, interface, cost, or performance concerns and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Facilitate technical interchange meetings, program reviews, working groups, integrated product team meetings, and customer engagements.
  • Guide engineering teams in systems architecture, requirements analysis, systems integration, interface definition, verification and validation, and technical documentation.
  • Review engineering products and ensure technical deliverables are accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with customer and program requirements.
  • Support development and review of engineering analyses, technical assessments, system requirements, design documentation, integration plans, and program deliverables.
  • Support test and evaluation planning, assessment, and reporting activities as needed; extensive at-sea testing is not expected to be the primary responsibility.
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, program-status updates, decision presentations, risk updates, and recommendations to senior military and government leadership.
  • Analyze technical and operational information to identify deficiencies, risks, limitations, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate responses to customer requests and ensure follow-up actions are completed on schedule.
  • Support program planning, resource coordination, subcontractor or partner coordination, and preparation of technical inputs for contract deliverables.
  • Provide technical and program leadership during periods of increased operational activity or surge support.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagements, program activities, fleet events, and occasional demonstrations or assessments.
  • Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from engineers and operators to senior military and government leaders.
  • Support other systems engineering, technical leadership, and Deputy Project Manager activities as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, naval architecture, mechanical engineering, ocean engineering, electrical engineering, project management, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, naval engineering, maritime operations, fleet support, technical leadership, program management, or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex maritime, naval, shipboard, submarine, underwater, or other defense systems.
  • Experience working directly with customer, government, military, engineering, or operational stakeholders to address technical requirements and mission needs.
  • Experience leading or coordinating engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines or organizations.
  • Experience supporting program execution, including schedule management, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, stakeholder coordination, and status reporting.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or managing technical documentation, engineering analyses, requirements, system designs, integration products, or program deliverables.
  • Experience analyzing technical or operational information and communicating recommendations through written products, briefings, status reports, and presentations.
  • Experience facilitating technical meetings, program reviews, working groups, or customer engagements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a customer-facing environment alongside senior government, military, engineering, and program personnel.
  • Ability to balance systems engineering responsibilities with onsite Deputy Project Manager duties.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including overseas travel several times per year.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as a Deputy Project Manager, Assistant Project Manager, technical lead, chief engineer, or equivalent onsite program representative.
  • Experience coordinating across government organizations, engineering teams, fleet personnel, contractors, operational commands, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience with software development, scripting, or software-intensive systems.
  • Technical competency with Linux operating systems and environments.
  • Experience with maritime command-and-control, communications, combat systems, unmanned systems, or related mission technologies.
  • Graduate degree in engineering, systems engineering, project management, or a related technical discipline.
  • DAWIA, Defense Acquisition Corps, INCOSE, PMP, or other relevant professional certification.
  • Experience supporting classified programs, defense acquisition, operational planning, intelligence organizations, or government technical agencies.
