title: Regulatory Reporting Associate
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
The Role

We are seeking a highly qualified Associate to work in our Regulatory Reporting team. The Regulatory Reporting team partners with Compliance, Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, and Technology to ensure complete, accurate, and timely regulatory disclosures in every jurisdiction where the firm trades. As an Associate you will both run existing processes and help shape the future of regulatory compliance at the firm.

What you’ll do

  • Execute on key recurring and ad hoc regulatory filings and ownership disclosures (SEC, CFTC, FCA, MAS, etc.).
  • Design, implement, and monitor data quality rules to ensure the accuracy of regulatory filings.
  • Write detailed business process documentation and calculation specifications for regulatory filings.
  • Understand, execute, and contribute to code (SQL/Python) to aggregate datasets and automate processes.
  • Understand all the datasets available for reporting and scope out which datasets are appropriate for the given filing.
  • Interface with internal partner teams as well as external vendors to help build out reporting processes and infrastructure.
  • Perform ad hoc data analysis to answer questions from partner teams and regulators.

What you’ll bring

What you need:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance/accounting/economics or STEM; CPA / CFA a plus.
  • 3-5 years of relevant work experience at a buy-side firm, consulting agency, or managed service provider.
  • Experience with certain regulatory reports like Form PF, CPO-PQR, Annex IV, 13F, 13G, 13H, Form ADV, and MAS surveys.
  • Foundational programming skills in Python and experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Understanding of a variety of different hedge fund strategies and comfort dealing with a wide array of asset classes (Equities, Futures, Options, FX, Bonds, Swaps, Credit).
  • Strong written and oral communication skills; able to thrive in a fast-paced multi-PM environment.
  • Impeccable attention to detail.

We’d love it if you had:

  • Experience with Asia and EMEA reporting requirements.
  • Prior software engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence experience.
  • Prior audit, financial reporting, or fund accounting experience.
  • Experience using AI in a compliance or reporting setting.

Who we are
Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.

Our Culture
At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

title: On-Site Logistikkoordinator (International Shipping & Export)
description:
Job Summary

Er du passioneret omkring international logistik, eksport og koordinering af globale transporter? Vi søger en struktureret og serviceorienteret Logistikkoordinator til vores Shipping-team, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre, at kundeordrer håndteres effektivt, korrekt og i overensstemmelse med gældende eksportkrav.

Som Logistikkoordinator får du ansvaret for at koordinere internationale kundeordrer fra ordreoprettelse til endelig levering. Du samarbejder tæt med Customer Service, lagerfunktioner, speditører, transportører og øvrige interne interessenter for at sikre smidige og rettidige forsendelser til kunder over hele verden. Rollen omfatter håndtering af vej-, sø- og lufttransporter samt udarbejdelse og kontrol af eksport- og shippingdokumentation, certifikater og øvrige transportrelaterede dokumenter. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til løbende forbedringer, standardisering og digitalisering af logistik- og shippingprocesser i et internationalt miljø.

Rollen er baseret i Grindsted, Danmark (på stedet). Bliv en del af et engageret, samarbejdsorienteret og professionelt team, hvor vi sammen sikrer effektive globale logistikløsninger og understøtter forretningen gennem høj kvalitet, service og præcision. Dit potentiale er vores inspiration.

Hvor du kommer til at gøre en forskel

  • Oprette deliveries og shipments i SAP baseret på kundeordrer.
  • Koordinere transporter med lager, speditører, transportører og kunder.
  • Håndtere nationale, europæiske og oversøiske forsendelser via vej-, sø- og lufttransport.
  • Udarbejde, verificere og vedligeholde transport- og eksportdokumentation.
  • Udstede og kontrollere certifikater, herunder oprindelses- og fødevarecertifikater.
  • Gennemgå og godkende shippingdokumenter, herunder Bills of Lading.
  • Administrere FCA-ordrer, bookinginformation samt slutdokumentation til kunder.
  • Samarbejde tæt med Customer Service omkring kundeforespørgsler og hasteforsendelser.
  • Følge op på reklamationer, fragtomkostninger og fakturarelaterede aktiviteter.
  • Bidrage til optimering, standardisering og digitalisering af logistik- og shippingprocesser.

Hvad der gør dig til det rette match

  • Du har erfaring fra en shipping-, eksport-, logistik- eller speditørfunktion.
  • Du har kendskab til international transport og eksportdokumentation.
  • Du har erfaring med ERP-systemer, gerne SAP.
  • Du arbejder struktureret og har stor fokus på detaljer og datakvalitet.
  • Du trives med mange samtidige opgaver og korte deadlines.
  • Du er serviceminded og samarbejder effektivt på tværs af funktioner.
  • Du kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
  • Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger dem helt til dørs.
  • Du er løsningsorienteret og motiveres af at skabe værdi for kunder og interessenter.

Hvordan skiller du dig ud?

  • Du bidrager aktivt til videndeling og et stærkt tværfunktionelt samarbejde.
  • Du har interesse for procesforbedringer, standardisering og kontinuerlig udvikling.
  • Du trives i en forandringsorienteret organisation og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.
  • Hvorfor Vælge Os?
  • En spændende og varieret rolle med international kontaktflade.
  • Mulighed for at arbejde med hele værdikæden inden for shipping og eksport.
  • Et fagligt stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, service og kvalitet.
  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • En virksomhed med fokus på kontinuerlige forbedringer, digitalisering og fremtidssikring af processer.
  • Et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø, hvor dine idéer og bidrag gør en reel forskel.

title: Associate II, Quality Control
description:
The Role:

Moderna is seeking a Quality Control Chemistry Associate II based at their Norwood, MA site. The individual in this role will perform cGMP QC Chemistry testing for QC Chemistry, release, stability and in process samples. This role may support special projects as needed. This role will be working on the 2nd shift Sunday through Thursday.

Here’s What You’ll Do:

  • Performs routine analytical chemistry testing including HPLC, UPLC, GC, UV, Particle Analysis and Dynamic Light Scattering, KF, etc.

  • Supports special projects as assigned.

  • May assist with Troubleshoots assay methods and equipment.

  • Performs data entry and supports trending.

  • Performs general laboratory support activities including reagent preparation, sample management, equipment maintenance, lab housekeeping etc.

  • Supports authoring of SOPs, protocols and reports.

  • LIMS (LabVantage) sample result entry, execution of Electronic Assay Forms in LIMS

  • Perform HPLC (AEX) and NaOH plate reader-based assays in support of manufacturing process stat testing as needed

  • Stability program support.

  • Support more junior staff with data review, training, and troubleshooting.

  • Managing/stocking of QC lab supplies

  • Write/revise SOPs, protocols and reports.

  • Complete and maintain cGMP documentation for work performed.

  • Participate in authoring quality systems records such as investigations, deviations, change controls, CAPAs

  • Establish and maintain a safe laboratory working environment.

  • Follow all relevant GxP regulations, guidelines, and company policies to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal requirements.

  • Execute tasks precisely as defined in internal guiding documents including but not limited to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.

  • Follow Good Documentation Practices and Data Integrity requirements to ensure data, documentation, and records are completed and maintained for use by the business and available to support audits or inspections.

  • Complete training in assigned required learning plan according to the defined timing and the prescribed requalification cadence.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications):

  • Education: BA/BS in relevant scientific discipline

  • Experience: 2 years of Laboratory experience.

  • Demonstrated aptitude or ability to learn to gain a strong understanding of GxP regulations.

Our Working Model

As we build our company, we have always believed that an in-person culture is critical to our success. This role is 100% onsite, reflecting the importance of being physically present to support the work, collaborate closely with colleagues, and contribute to our site-based operations.

Working onsite enables real-time collaboration, strong team connections, direct mentorship, and the hands-on partnership needed to deliver our mission. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.


Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $63,200.00 - $100,900.00. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. title: Maintenance Storeroom Clerk
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Maintenance Storeroom Clerk is an integral member of the maintenance team, dedicated to ensuring the "Right Parts are in the Right Quantity at the Right Time". This role is responsible for controlling inventory by reviewing usage data and recording information in the company-provided CMMS (MVP Plant/MVPONE). By taking full ownership of the system and following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), this position ensures data integrity, stock availability, and organized storage to support continuous manufacturing
operations.

COMPANY SUMMARY:
American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE: AEO) is a leading global specialty retailer offering high-quality, on-trend clothing, accessories and personal care products at
affordable prices under its American Eagle Outfitters® and Aerie® brands. The company operates more than 1,000 stores in North America, and ships to 81 countries worldwide through its websites. American Eagle Outfitters and Aerie merchandise also is available at approximately 54 international franchise stores in 12 countries. For more information, please visit www.ae.com.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inventory Control & Catalog Management:
    • System Accuracy: Maintain 100% data integrity within the CMMS. Accurately track inventory, work orders, and part usage.
    • Cycle Counting: Execute regular inventory cycle counting programs by ABC classification; investigate, correct, and report discrepancies.
    • Material Flow: Perform daily tasks including receiving, labeling, putting parts away, and processing returns or transfers.
    • Catalog Maintenance: Assist with setting up new items, updating Min/Max levels, and maintaining catalog accuracy.
    • Technical Support: Use machine drawings and web search tools for part identification and cross-referencing for internal customers.
  • Purchasing & Vendor Relations
    • Procurement: Respond to all maintenance purchasing requests within one business day. Collect supplier quotes and coordinate orders for stock.
    • Financial Accountability: Manage and reconcile monthly purchasing card (P-Card) spending according to company standards.
    • Vendor Management: Research and negotiate with vendors to reduce maintenance spend while maintaining quality; resolve issues regarding lost or incorrect shipments.
    • Special Programs: Execute and support the repairable spare program and kit building.
  • Operational Support & Planning
    • Maintenance Planning: Anticipate the needs of planned maintenance by working closely with planners and schedulers.
    • PM Development: Develop and implement PM programs for parts with specific shelf-life or maintenance needs (e.g., gaskets, belts, motor shafts) and manage a shelf-life scrap program.
    • Audit & Improvement: Conduct annual audits of the parts room layout and design to identify improvement opportunities.
    • Reporting: Provide routine reports to management, including inventory value, usage trends, and cycle count discrepancies.
  • Teamwork, Safety & Housekeeping
    • Collaboration: Attend regular maintenance planning meetings and communicate effectively with team members regarding supplies and delivery dates.
    • Training: Assist in training new associates on MVP procedures and storeroom standards.
    • Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly parts room and satellite storage areas with superb housekeeping standards.
    • Safety Compliance: Adhere to all safety protocols, including the use of required PPE (safety shoes, glasses, and hearing protection).
  • General
    • Additional Tasks: Perform other duties as assigned by management to support the overall success of the maintenance and operations departments.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in industrial maintenance inventory, purchasing, or a similar warehouse role preferred.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in CMMS systems (MVPOne Preferred, SAP, Maximo, etc.) and Google Suite/Microsoft Excel.
  • Technical Literacy: Demonstrated ability to read and interpret standard machine drawings.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to be approachable, tactful, and possess negotiation skills.
  • Organization: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Physical Effort: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs occasionally; involves frequent bending, standing, and walking for extended periods.
  • Environment: Ability to work in high-bay areas, climb stairs, and work in warehouse conditions that may include dust, noise, and temperature fluctuations.
  • Flexibility: Must be flexible to work overtime to meet business needs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane
description:
About Starburst

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at .

About the role

Starburst is looking for strong Java engineers to work with our globally distributed engineering team on the core of Starburst's software. This role sits on the Control Plane team, whose mandate is to converge the control planes of our two flagship deployment models, self-managed Starburst Enterprise Platform (SEP) and fully managed Starburst Galaxy, into a single, unified platform.

You will design and build backend services and cloud infrastructure that run in both worlds: multi-tenant SaaS at global scale, and customer-operated on-premise and air-gapped deployments. Both models bring unique and interesting problems, and incredible learning opportunities for any engineer. Starburst offers the opportunity to compete at global scale with other elite vendors in the Data Analytics space and external customers.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane at Starburst you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain control plane services shared by Starburst Enterprise, Starburst Galaxy, and Trino.
  • Contribute to the Unified Control Plane: take capabilities that exist in one product (access control, multi-cluster management, routing, catalog management, observability) and deliver them as a single implementation that serves both SaaS and self-managed deployments.
  • Own the reliability, scalability, and efficiency (performance/$) of the services you build - provisioning and upgrading APIs, cluster lifecycle management, and the operational tooling that runs them.
  • Build for two very different operating models at once: a service Starburst operates at scale, and software our customers deploy and operate themselves across AWS, Azure, and GCP as well as on-premise.
  • Provide considerate and timely review of your peers' pull requests and design proposals.
  • Continuously improve our engineering processes, tests, and systems so the codebase and the team's productivity scale together.
  • Collaborate with team members and other teams globally, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
    • We prioritize focused work, ensuring minimal time is spent in formal meetings, allowing you to concentrate on coding and PR reviews.
    • Clearly articulating your ideas in writing — Slack, GitHub PRs, design documents — is essential in our globally distributed team.
  • Provide exceptional customer support for both internal and external customers.
    • We're humbled by the trust our customers place in our platform to crunch their data, and we handle the problems they report with utmost seriousness.
  • Periodically assist with the React and TypeScript-based Portal UI that surfaces these features; while knowledge of frontend development is beneficial, it is not a prerequisite.

Some of the things we look for:

  • Prior experience developing distributed systems.
  • Extensive software development experience with Java.
  • Cloud infrastructure architecture and orchestration experience across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Experience building and operating backend services that others depend on — APIs, control loops, lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on adoption of AI coding tools and agents in day-to-day engineering — shipping real code with them, and sound judgment about where they help and where they don't.
  • Demonstrated experience with software engineering and design best practices.
  • Appreciation for creating maintainable, performant, and high-quality software as part of a high-performing, globally distributed team.
  • Intrinsic motivation for improving your software engineering craftsmanship.
  • Comfort with significant autonomy and ownership.
  • Curiosity to see what other engineering teams are doing, and the ability to connect the dots — essential when the goal is one implementation replacing two.
  • Demonstration of Ownership, Grit, and Bias for Action — core values at Starburst.

Where could this role be based?

  • Warsaw - Remote, Poland

title: Email Designer
description:
We are currently recruiting for an Email Designer, creating engaging, responsive email campaigns that bring our brand to life and deliver exceptional customer experiences across every touchpoint. Please attach your portfolio for consideration.


About the Role


As an Email Designer, you will play a key role in the creation and delivery of visually compelling email campaigns across editorial, promotional, triggered, and transactional communications. Working closely with content, CRM, creative, and strategy teams, you will design and build high-quality emails that are both brand-focused and performance-driven. You'll help ensure every campaign is optimised for mobile devices, aligned to best practice, and supports ongoing improvements in customer engagement.


Key responsibilities:


  • Design high-quality email campaigns in Figma for editorial, promotional, and brand partner communications.
  • Create engaging digital assets in Photoshop for email content across a variety of categories, including fashion, beauty, food, and technology.
  • Build and prepare responsive, modular email templates within Emarsys using reusable content blocks and dynamic variations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to incorporate feedback and ensure all emails meet creative, functional, and personalisation requirements.
  • Test and optimise emails across devices, email clients, mobile platforms, and dark mode environments to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Depending on your role, you may be fully on-site or have a mix of on-site and home working – this is what we refer to as ‘Hybrid’. Our hybrid working policy allows colleagues to work from home for part of the week, with a minimum of three days on-site, depending on business needs.


Please see our Hybrid@Harrods policy on our Career Site for more information or speak to a member of our Talent Acquisition team if you have any questions regarding the requirements for this role.

You will be a creative thinker with a genuine passion for digital design and a keen eye for detail. You will enjoy transforming briefs into engaging customer communications and be motivated by creating work that is both visually impactful and commercially effective. You will be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, adapting to changing priorities while maintaining consistently high standards. You will thrive in a collaborative environment, working closely with a range of stakeholders and contributing positively to the wider team. Most importantly, you will be eager to learn, embrace new ideas, and continuously develop your skills in an evolving digital landscape.


You'll also have:


  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, alongside experience using Figma.

Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.

title: Certified Wastewater Treatment Plant Supervisor
description:
Location: Sioux Falls, SD
Schedule: Day Shift with On-Call
Employment Type: Full-Time

Lead Operations. Ensure Compliance. Drive Plant Performance.
Project Solutions, Inc. (PSI) is seeking an experienced Certified Wastewater Treatment Supervisor to oversee the daily operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of a wastewater treatment facility in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. This leadership role is ideal for a highly skilled wastewater professional who thrives in a hands-on environment while managing plant operations, personnel, safety, and compliance requirements.
The Certified Wastewater Treatment Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring efficient treatment plant performance, maintaining regulatory compliance, supervising operations staff, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the facility.

Position Overview:
The Certified Wastewater Treatment Supervisor serves as the lead operator responsible for the safe, compliant, and efficient operation of the wastewater treatment plant. This position provides technical oversight, operational leadership, staff coordination, regulatory reporting support, and maintenance planning while ensuring plant processes meet all federal, state, local, and permit requirements.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, advanced wastewater treatment knowledge, and the ability to make operational decisions that support safety, reliability, and environmental compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Direct and supervise daily wastewater treatment plant operations and staff activities.
  • Monitor, inspect, troubleshoot, and optimize treatment processes to ensure compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of pumps, motors, blowers, feeders, valves, SCADA systems, and related equipment.
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance programs and corrective repairs for plant systems and equipment.
  • Ensure all operational logs, reports, laboratory records, and compliance documentation are accurate and maintained.
  • Review laboratory testing results and implement operational adjustments as necessary.
  • Manage chemical inventory, application, and safety procedures in accordance with regulatory standards.
  • Coordinate wastewater sampling, testing, monitoring, and reporting activities.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, and permit compliance requirements.
  • Lead and develop plant personnel through training, coaching, and performance oversight.
  • Promote and enforce plant safety programs, procedures, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with PSI leadership, client representatives, vendors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and respond to operational emergencies as required.

Required Qualifications:
  • South Dakota Wastewater Treatment Systems Operator Level II Certification (Required).
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of 3 years of wastewater treatment operations experience.
  • Prior supervisory, lead operator, or management experience preferred.
  • Extensive knowledge of wastewater treatment processes, including biological, mechanical, and chemical treatment systems.
  • Experience with laboratory sampling, testing, and regulatory compliance reporting.
  • Strong troubleshooting and maintenance experience with treatment plant equipment.
  • Ability to interpret operational data, laboratory results, and process performance metrics.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to successfully pass a pre-employment background check.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment drug test. This position is also subject to the company’s random drug testing policy.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Additional Water Treatment or Wastewater Certifications.
  • Experience with industrial wastewater treatment facilities.
  • Experience working with SCADA and computerized control systems.
  • Knowledge of EPA, NPDES, and South Dakota regulatory requirements.
Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to climb ladders, stairs, and elevated work platforms.
  • Ability to frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to work around wastewater treatment equipment, chemicals, and process systems.
  • Ability to respond to emergencies and work weekends, holidays, and on-call shifts when necessary.

What Does PSI Offer You?
  • Three options for medical plans plus offered dental, and vision insurance
  • 24/7 healthcare access to telehealth services for your convenience
  • HSA
  • Company life insurance options for you and your family
  • 401(k) with a 4% employer match
  • PLUS, a $800 monthly allowance to cover PSI insurance premium costs
  • Generous PTO, paid-federal holidays, and sick leave.
  • Professional development opportunities.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (High Performance Computing)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (HIGH PERFORMANCE COMPUTING)

SpaceX HPC is a shared compute platform used across the company — vehicle and structures simulation, machine learning, AI inference, and more. We support every program at SpaceX to design and operate the worlds most advanced rockets and satellites. This role exists to put a real Site Reliability Engineer operating model on these capabilities and accelerating the world class engineering at SpaceX: toil reduction, automation, observability, and a sustainable incident process.

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who wants to own everything from Linux machines and our Infrastructure as Code, storage, and user facing applications – the whole ecosystem as a product, not as a ticket queue. You do not need a prior HPC title. You do need production instincts — you have operated real infrastructure, you write code to delete toil, and you care about whether users can actually get work done, not just whether nodes ping. You’ll work alongside HPC systems engineers who design and commission clusters to help make them more reliable and provide world class services for world class engineers.

Aerospace experience is not required. We value engineers who treat teammates with fairness and respect, who are self-critical, and who will take ownership of hard production problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation; practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
  • Manage node lifecycle with infrastructure as code: OS images, firmware, configuration management, kernel and driver stack
  • Build observability for both HPC administrators and end users — cluster, node, and storage health for operators, and job/workflow-level signal for the people running work on the platform
  • Reduce toil with automation; split time between operating production systems and writing the software that makes that work smaller
  • Sustainably manage resources, including compute and storage
  • Lead capacity planning with users across the company: understand what they will need next, and turn that into a concrete picture of tomorrow's compute and storage
  • Collaborate with HPC systems engineers and with engineers across all disciplines across the company on operable, maintainable infrastructure

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience operating production infrastructure in lieu of a degree
  • 2+ years of experience with Linux operating systems in production
  • 2+ years of experience operating production infrastructure (servers, services, or networks), including monitoring, debugging, and repairing what you own

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of professional experience in SRE, DevOps, or production infrastructure engineering
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or similar)
  • Experience deploying and maintaining configuration management or infrastructure as code (Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, or similar)
  • Experience writing scripts/code (eg. Python or similar languages) to automate common tasks
  • Experience with containers (Docker, Podman, Singularity/Apptainer)
  • Experience with Kubernetes administration for on-premise deployment
  • Experience with distributed or high-performance storage (VAST or similar), including capacity, performance, and lifecycle management
  • Familiarity with HPC clusters, schedulers (Slurm, PBS, LSF), or GPU compute — not required; we will teach this
  • Familiarity with scientific computing (CFD, FEA) and/or ML training workloads (PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA) and/or AI inference workloads
  • Good understanding of version control, testing, continuous integration, build, deployment and monitoring
  • Ability to communicate clearly with users, peers, and vendors in both incident and design settings
  • Comfortable working with mission-critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities
  • Eligibility for access to classified material up to TS/SCI with polygraph

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Position is based in Hawthorne, CA and is primarily on-site
  • Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed for incidents, cluster bring-up, and time-critical failures
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Business Process Specialist
description:
Job Summary

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level and make a real impact?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.


For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredients business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredients business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.


Food Ingredients:​ Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.​.​


The role is based on Memphis, TN (On- site role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.


Where You’ll Make a Difference

  • Own daily inventory reconciliation processes to ensure accurate production reporting, inventory balances, and SAP transaction integrity.
  • Execute and analyze inventory, production, and materials management reports to identify discrepancies and drive timely resolution.
  • Perform production confirmations, transaction corrections, backflush activities, and inventory adjustments within SAP to maintain system accuracy.
  • Support inventory control through reconciliation of raw materials, chemical inventories, and production volumes while investigating and resolving variances.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Accounting teams to improve data integrity and business process effectiveness.
  • Lead and support management system activities, including self-assessments, investigations, corrective actions, compliance tasks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support month-end close activities through reconciliations, reporting, journal entry support, accrual validation, and financial transaction accuracy.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate non-value-added activities, and improve operational efficiency across the site.
  • Promote compliance with company policies, internal controls, EHSS requirements, and cGMP standards while ensuring sustainable process execution

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Accounting, Human Resources, Organizational Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business processes, inventory management, manufacturing operations, accounting, supply chain, or related functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP, including inventory transactions, production reporting, and materials management processes.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience building effective relationships across multiple functions and influencing stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain a high level of ownership and accountability.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with experience identifying process inefficiencies and implementing sustainable solutions.

How You Would Stand Out

  • Experience in food, ingredients, pharmaceutical, chemical, or other regulated manufacturing environments operating under cGMP standards.
  • Proven success leading inventory management initiatives, business process improvement projects, or cross-functional operational excellence efforts.
  • Experience supporting investigations, management of change activities, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), audits, or compliance programs.

Why Choose Us?

  • Be part of a global organization recognized for innovation, sustainability, and industry leadership.
  • Make a direct impact on operational performance and business results within a growing manufacturing facility.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, and Leadership.
  • Contribute to meaningful continuous improvement initiatives that drive efficiency and business value.
  • Access opportunities for professional growth, development, and career advancement.

Join a culture that values safety, inclusion, accountability, and teamwork

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Virtualization Engineer
description:
Leidos is seeking a Virtualization Engineer to support the Compartmented Enterprise Services Office (CESO) Task Order for the GIG Service Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) contract. This person should be a seasoned, self-motivated, professional with at least 10 years of hands-on engineering and testing experience in virtualized on-premise and cloud environments. A skilled knowledgeable engineer with experienced in developing and implementing a VMWARE ESXi infrastructure.


With the CESO program, the Defense Information System Agency (DISA) is looking to transform the existing Secure Web Services (SWS) environment, used to provide secure information sharing to the community, into a more mature service offering to meet the DoD and IC community. As part of this task order, Leidos will manage the commercial cloud migration and fully automate the continuous development & continuous integration environment, fourth estate consolidation, professionalize services – ITIL/DevSecOps based processes, improve the customer experience 1st call resolution, and achieve development of a service catalog for Defense Working Capital Fund (DWCF) Model.

This position is 100% onsite in Arlington, VA with occasional/situational travel in and outside of the Washington Metro Area.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Tier 3 support to members of the operations virtualization administrators.
  • Maintain all HW and SW components at vendor supported levels.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of ESXi hosts, clusters, and vSAN.
  • Support mission-critical Continuity of Operations (COOP).
  • Develop and/or participate in After Action Reports (AARs)
  • Provide expert advice and direction regarding the management and operation of all VMWARE clusters in the DISA CESO enterprise architecture.
  • Evaluate current technologies and processes associated with DISA CESO to identify gaps.
  • Provide requirements and strategies for future cybersecurity operations.
  • Active participant in meetings with DISA CESO and mission partner working groups.
  • Adhere to applicable DOD STIGs, DISA applicable orders, and JSIG policy, guidelines, and regulations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of directly relevant experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 6+ years of hands-on VMWARE experience in both engineering, operations and maintenance roles.
  • Strong knowledge of VMWARE concepts and best practices:
  • Experience working in a high op-temp, Top Secret environment.
  • Candidate must possess an active DOD TS/SCI security clearance
  • Candidate must be willing to take and maintain a CI/Poly
  • 8570 IAT Level II Baseline Certification (e.g. CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, CND, SSCP)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • VCP- VMWare Certification desired
  • Prior experienced with DISA and DISA’s support to mission partners

title: Specialist, Quality Control
description:

VETERINARY HOSPITAL SHIFT LEAD

A career at Banfield means you'll find yourself working in the pet healthcare field alongside industry experts with a chance to make a difference in the lives of pets and the clients we serve through client education and effective communication. Work in a fun team environment that offers a clear career path you can pursue if continued growth and learning is your goal.

The Veterinary Hospital Shift Lead (“Shift Lead”) provides exceptional client and pet experiences while assisting the Practice Manager and/or Chief of Staff (COS) in guiding the team to maximize productivity and profitability of the hospital, and helps ensure effective communication with all clients, internal stakeholders, and colleagues. The Shift Lead also performs the duties of a Client Services Coordinator and Veterinary Assistant when needed.

The right person for this job enjoys:

THE FIVE PRINCIPLES

Every associate including the Shift Lead has an important contribution to make to the veterinary team. We’re looking for Shift Leads who are dedicated to their work, have a positive attitude and use our Five Principles:

  • Quality – The consumer is our boss, quality is our work, and value for money is our goal.

Special Working Conditions

  • Requires sufficient ambulatory skills to perform duties while at hospital.
  • Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.
  • Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Experience, Education and/or Training

title: Oracle NetSuite Finance Sr Business Analyst
description:

You’ll play a central role in implementing Oracle NetSuite across our finance organization, helping us design the foundation for a smarter, faster, and more connected business. You’ll partner with Finance and your IT peers to modernize our core financial processes and elevate how we work across multiple entities, currencies, and regions.
What we’re proposing is more than a project — it’s a journey.
A chance to build the foundations of the most efficient and innovative fashion/retail accounting organization, and ultimately become a true expert in how to build value in Finance through innovation.

  • Map business processes to Oracle NetSuite standard capabilities, identifying gaps and proposing elegant solutions — always prioritizing configuration over customization.

  • Ability to document, analyze, and optimize Finance processes while aligning with system best practices.
  • Proven experience in data migration, UAT, and user training.
  • Familiarity with modern EPM tools such as Anaplan or Pigment.

Who You Are
  • You bridge the gap between Finance and Technology.
  • You see complexity as an opportunity to simplify.

  • You’re collaborative, driven, and always looking to learn.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

We are Flutter Central & Eastern Europe (CEE).

As a proud member of the Flutter family - a global leader in sports betting and iGaming - we are building one of the Group`s most dynamic tech and product hubs in Central and Eastern Europe. We aren`t just here to participate; we`re here to change the game.

By uniting local powerhouses like MaxBet, Adjarabet.com, and Adjarabet.am, we combine deep regional expertise with the scale and strength of Flutter`s global platforms. We are setting a new standard for entertainment, responsibility, and innovation — powered by real customer signals that shape everything we build.

READY TO CHANGE THE GAME?
Join the Flutter Central & Eastern Europe team. This is where bold, ambitious minds build scalable platforms, drive innovation, and shape the future of iGaming in the region.


ROLE SUMMARY

The Security Project Manager is responsible for the controlled delivery of security-related initiatives, projects and workstreams

across Flutter CEE within the CIO delivery governance model.

The role ensures security initiatives are delivered with clear scope, ownership, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholder

alignment, governance cadence and transparent reporting. It provides hands-on project management discipline while ensuring

that security outcomes are coordinated with technology, operations, architecture, product engineering, business and leadership

stakeholders.

The Security Project Manager works under the Head of Delivery and partners closely with IS Security, Technology Service &

Operations, Architecture, AI & Innovation, Performance Intelligence, CTO delivery teams and business stakeholders. The role

ensures security delivery is treated as managed CIO delivery work, not only as a dependency or consultation activity.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


1. Security Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own day-to-day project management for assigned security initiatives, ensuring delivery is structured, transparent and aligned to agreed CIO priorities.
  • Create and maintain project plans, milestones, workstream plans, action logs, RAID, dependency maps, status reports and closure artefacts.
  • Ensure each initiative has clear scope, sponsor, delivery owner, accountable stakeholders, delivery approach, acceptance criteria, expected outcomes and reporting cadence.
  • Apply appropriate delivery methods based on initiative size, risk, complexity and delivery model, including agile, waterfall or hybrid approaches.
  • Challenge unclear scope, weak ownership, unrealistic timelines, missing dependencies and unmanaged risks in a constructive and professional way.

2. Security Workstream Governance


  • Ensure security initiatives and security workstreams follow agreed CIO delivery governance, PMO standards, reporting requirements and escalation routes.
  • Track security milestones, control readiness, implementation dependencies, decision points and evidence requirements through the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure delivery governance is practical, decision-focused and proportionate to project risk, complexity and business impact.
  • Maintain clear records of key decisions, approvals, exceptions, assumptions, dependencies and delivery commitments.

3. Stakeholder Management & Communication


  • Own stakeholder coordination for assigned security projects across IS Security, Technology Service & Operations, Architecture, CTO Product Engineering, AI Innovation Hub, Performance Intelligence, business teams, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
  • Maintain stakeholder maps, communication plans, meeting cadence, decision forums and escalation paths for assigned initiatives.
  • Provide clear, timely and audience-appropriate communication on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions required and delivery confidence.
  • Manage expectations proactively where scope, timing, resources, dependencies or priority sequencing changes.

4. RAID, Dependency & Escalation Management


  • Identify, document and actively manage risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies across assigned security initiatives.
  • Ensure risks and blockers are assigned to clear owners, reviewed regularly and escalated before they materially affect delivery outcomes.
  • Escalate material delivery risks, unresolved blockers, ownership gaps, dependency conflicts, governance breaches or resource constraints to the Head of Delivery with context, impact, options and recommendation.
  • Maintain an integrated view of dependencies between security, infrastructure, architecture, product engineering, operations, vendors and business stakeholders.

5. Cross-Delivery Coordination


  • Coordinate security delivery contributions for initiatives that span CIO, CTO and Chief Strategy Officer delivery teams.
  • Where security is a contributor, ensure security commitments, deliverables, risks, decisions, dependencies and readiness criteria are clearly planned and represented in the lead delivery plan.
  • Where security or CIO is leading, manage the delivery cadence, workstream coordination, dependency control, status reporting and escalation for assigned initiatives.
  • Support formal intake by clarifying security scope, impact, complexity, stakeholder groups, dependencies and delivery route.

6. Operational Readiness, Transition & Closure


  • Ensure implementation readiness, operational acceptance, support handover, documentation, training needs and post-implementation activities are planned and tracked.
  • Coordinate with Technology Service & Operations, IS Security operations, vendors and support teams to ensure delivered security capabilities are supportable and sustainable.
  • Support project closure, KPI tracking, lessons learned, delivery retrospectives and continuous improvement actions.
  • Ensure residual risks, open actions, support obligations and ownership transitions are documented before closure.

7. AI-First Delivery Operations


  • Apply AI-first thinking to improve delivery planning, status preparation, RAID summaries, meeting outputs, action tracking, stakeholder communication and PMO knowledge management.
  • Use AI-supported delivery practices responsibly, maintaining accuracy, transparency, data protection, security expectations and human accountability for judgement and decisions.
  • Share practical improvements and lessons learned with the Head of Delivery and Delivery Forum where relevant.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE


  • 5+ years of experience in project management, delivery management, technology delivery, security delivery or transformation delivery roles.
  • Experience managing technology projects involving security controls, risk reduction, compliance readiness, operational readiness or cross-functional security workstreams.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, delivery lifecycle management, planning, RAID, dependency management, status reporting and escalation practices.
  • Experience operating in matrix environments where business, technology, security, operations, product, architecture and vendor teams contribute to shared outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, planning and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate complex security and technical delivery topics into clear plans, risks, options, actions and decisions required.
  • Experience using delivery tooling such as AHA, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet or equivalent.
  • Ability to challenge unclear scope, weak ownership, unmanaged risks and poor delivery discipline constructively.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE


  • Experience in gaming, betting, fintech, digital platforms, regulated technology or multi-market environments.
  • Experience delivering security-related initiatives across infrastructure, cloud, workplace technology, platform engineering, identity, monitoring, vulnerability, data, AI or operational readiness areas.
  • Experience supporting audit readiness, control implementation, evidence coordination or regulated technology delivery.
  • Experience managing delivery with internal teams, vendors, shared services and cross-regional dependencies.
  • Experience supporting formal intake models, Lean Canvas, portfolio prioritisation and initiative qualification processes.

title: Golf Assistant Superintendent
description:
Be a part of a dynamic team whose common goal is to make a difference in our community.


It is amazing to know that by being a part of the City of Idaho Falls team, you would be doing important work for our community that affects people’s lives. Every day brings new challenges and rewards!

Job Description:

The City of Idaho Falls is recruiting for the position of Golf Assistant Superintendent.

Performs a variety of skilled duties related to leading and directing crews working in upkeep, construction, maintenance, and beautification of golf course facilities. May be designated responsible for specific sections of the golf course.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Works under the general supervision of a golf course superintendent.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED:

Provides close supervision to seasonal laborers on projects.

Essential Functions

Assists to Supervise and Train all Golf Maintenance Staff & Communicate with public.
Performs a variety of skilled duties related to leading and directing crews working in upkeep, construction, maintenance, and beautification of golf course facilities.

Communicates and motivates all staff daily and provides details on work assignments, expectations and areas of improvement. Inspects all job assignments for quality of work and completion. Tracks issues with staff and reports to Superintendent as requested.

Serves as lead worker to ensure timely completion of scheduled course maintenance projects.

Communicates and motivates all staff to ensure projects stay on schedule. Inspects all job assignments for quality of work and completion. Follows all City policies and ensures that safety procedures are followed and in place. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Directs work crews in carrying out duty assignments and provides close supervision to seasonal laborers on projects.

Communicates and motivates all staff daily and provides details on work assignments, expectations and areas of improvement. Inspects all job assignments for quality of work and completion. Follows all City policies on hiring and use Operational manuals and other training aids to help in training all workers; Keep track of employee issues and areas where more training is needed. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Monitors employee performance, provides training to seasonal work crews through demonstrations especially on equipment, monitors crew activities to ensure safety procedures are adhered to.

Follows all equipment recommendations and ensures that staff is fully aware and of all safety procedures prior to using any equipment. Uses Operational manuals and other training aids to help in training all workers; Keeps track of employee performance with equipment and issue more training sessions as appropriate. Inspects periodically to ensure that employees are exercising proper protocol on equipment. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Educates staff so they ensure that guests enjoy their golf experience by staff being considerate when doing assigned duties and responsibilities.

Ensures staff is educated on being considerate to the public when doing work processes. Inspect periodically to ensure staff is using good judgement when working around the public. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Follows and enforces all Maintenance and City policies and procedures at all times.

Ensure that Maintenance and City policies and procedures are available and discussed with all staff members and that they are reviewed as needed. Document all variances to policy as needed and reports to Superintendent as requested.

May be assigned responsibility for designated sections of the golf course by the Head Superintendent.

Follows lead of Head Superintendent with assistance where needed.

Assists to ensure that all turf and landscape are well maintained
Performs semi-skilled grounds construction and maintenance work as related to golf course operations; responsible for installation and maintenance of sprinkler systems; assists in selection of line sizes, sprinkler spacing, type and control equipment.

Appraises irrigation system results daily and informs Head Superintendent of all flaws and issues. Performs irrigation projects improvements and repairs as needed along with arranging for staff to help with needed repairs. Ensures all irrigation system repairs are completed within code and by certified irrigation professionals if required and reports all results to Head Superintendent when completed.

Responsible for the care and maintenance of golf course; participates in the construction of course greens, tees, and fairways; may relocate holes, bunkers, and tees; performs daily assessment of condition, health and playability of the course; supervises and performs the mowing, verticuting, aerifying, watering and maintenance of tees, greens, fairways and related areas; performs tree trimming; planting, fertilizing, and maintenance of turf.

Works with Head Superintendent to schedule all projects. Sets expectations and work assignments for staff daily and inspects results. Ensures turf conditions are within recommended heights, condition, and completed to plan. Reports to Superintendent on areas where employees are not meeting expectations and need more training.

Observes general condition of golf course grounds and facilities; may assist with the maintenance of MSDS sheets on various chemicals to ensure compliance with related regulations; reports areas needing attention to supervisor.

Reviews and communicates daily with Head Superintendent and staff on general condition of the course and areas that need improvement as necessary. Consults with Head Superintendent on recommended chemical applications based on soil and turf tests. Ensures that all Chemicals are applied safely and in accordance with the federal, state, and local guidelines.

Performs seasonal duties such as winterizing sprinkler systems to avoid freezing, flushes watering systems in spring, and repairs other equipment and facilities; assists with tree trimming and removal; may operate snow plow.

Consults with Head Superintendent on winterizing irrigation system each year. Recommends tree removal and trimming as necessary. Operates snow plow in winter months to keep entrance ways and areas open for emergency vehicle access to buildings, etc. Sets work assignments for staff on these repairs and projects as needed and inspects results. Ensures all tree and associated work is completed within code and follows all safety guidelines.

Assists to ensure that all buildings and facilities are well maintained
Helps repair, clean and maintain restrooms and other areas at the golf course to ensure effective operations.

Performs cleaning and minor repairs and adjustments in accordance with recommendations, guidelines, and codes. Uses staff as necessary to help. Works with the Building Maintenance Department to schedule repairs and remodels that require their expertise. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Assists to ensure that all equipment is working properly and safely
Operates various types of golf course construction and maintenance equipment essential to task completion; performs preventive maintenance and minor repairs on machinery and equipment; keeps daily journal of general golf course maintenance activities.
Inspects and certifies that all equipment is in working condition and within recommended safety guidelines daily. Documents all golf course maintenance activities to equipment as required. Schedules repair as needed. Works with the City Garage to schedule equipment breakdown service and required service intervals for all equipment and performs and directs minor repairs and adjustments as needed in accordance with equipment recommendations and guidelines. Reports to Superintendent as requested.

Assists in Preparing all golf related reports and future planning ideas as requested
Helps Head Superintendent prepare any requested reports and recommendations for future operations.

Compiles and updates Head Superintendent of all maintenance reports; keeps copies of reports for informational purposes and sends monthly and year end reports to Head Superintendent as requested.

Performs related duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

1. Education and Experience:

A. Graduation with an Associates Degree in Turf Management or Plant Science;
AND
B. Two (2) years experience in construction, maintenance, upkeep, and beautification of golf course facilities or four (4) years of seasonal golf course experience;
OR
C. An equivalent combination of education and experience.

2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Working knowledge of turf and greens management; landscape and sprinkler system design; herbicides, fungicides, insecticides and pesticides and proper application of the same; safety precautions in the effective application of herbicide, fungicide, etc., on greens and other related areas on the golf course care used in tree and sod removal and transplanting; landscape design and ground preparation; design, adjustment, operation, light maintenance and routine repair of diversified mechanical and electrical equipment.

Skill in the operation of various types of light equipment such as gang mower, front end loader, tractor, backhoe, etc. in trimming golf course greens, aprons, tees, and use of a variety of hand and power tools.

Ability to organize and direct the work of a crew performing similar duties; ability to evaluate work projects for efficiency and effectiveness; ability to work in outdoors under all weather extremes; ability to perform strenuous physical labor; ability to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing.

3. Special Qualifications:

Must possess a valid Idaho driver's license.
Must hold or be able to obtain, within six (6) months, a valid Idaho State Public Pest Control and Herbicide Applicators License.

Work Environment

Tasks require a variety of physical activities generally involving muscular strain. Physical demands may occur in activities related to walking, standing, stooping, sitting, reaching, lifting, etc. Talking, hearing and seeing required in the daily performance of job duties. Exposure to weather, environmental hazards and dangers resulting from working around dangerous equipment. Mental application utilizes memory for details, emotional stability and discriminating thinking and creative problem solving.

Pay Range:

$23.69 - 32.98

Benefits:
Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program which includes medical, dental, vision and life coverage. You will also be eligible for retirement benefits through PERSI. PERSI is a defined benefit plan that offers guaranteed retirement benefits for full-time employees.

title: Specimen Processor
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.

Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

The Target Pay for this position is $20.12 an hour. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.


Job Purpose/Overview

Specimen Processors are responsible for receiving, preparing, and processing most samples that come into the department.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions


  • Receives and prepares samples for laboratory analyses.
  • Accurately process standard requisitions per approved procedures at expected rates.
  • Removes specimens from transport bags, enter patient data, label samples and aliquot as needed for multiple testing
  • Keep inventory of samples after testing has been completed by scanning into storage racks. Search lab for any samples not scanned into storage racks.
  • Sort samples for distribution throughout the lab (Coggins, cytology, etc.).
  • Scan tubes into storage racks and enter specimen data into database to verify the accuracy of information
  • Accession various sample types for processing
  • Check all trash containers within the Specimen Processing department when assigned
  • Assists other lab personnel with specimen storage
  • Ensure Turn Around Times (TAT’s) are met
  • Follows applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), including safety and quality procedures. Maintains clean and organized work area. Restocks supplies as needed
  • Consult with senior peers on non-complex specimen processing tasks to learn through experience.
  • All other duties as assigned

We share a collaborative obligation to ensure that we conduct ourselves in the utmost ethical manner and that we hold each other accountable to the values and standards of the organization. Every Associate is responsible for asking questions, seeking guidance, and reporting concerns and/or violations of company policy or ethical standards. Antech Diagnostics has several processes in place to communicate with leadership and expects that Associates will have a commitment to integrity and uncompromising values.


Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required, with science related classes
  • 0-1 years related work experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Attention to detail and organized with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues
  • Communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Proficiency in the English language which allows for participation in team meetings, accurate entry of data into company systems and understanding of written directions
  • Attention to detail and organized with ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Positive, can-do attitude
  • Data Entry skills
  • Personal computer skills, including strong typing ability and proficient use of Microsoft Office

Working Conditions

  • Stationary Position- must be able to remain in a stationary position for up to 2 hours.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other lab equipment accurately and efficiently.
  • Occasionally required to bend, kneel, stoop, or crouch
  • Required to lift, move, and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Extended hours may be needed
  • Laboratory environments with potential biohazards present that are mitigated by the mandatory use of PPE
  • Work under close to moderate supervision.
  • Potential for exposure to agents known to cause zoonotic disease in humans and use of potentially hazardous chemicals as defined by the National Hazard Communication Standards. A complete list of such chemicals is available from department supervision.

About Antech

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

Benefits

Antech offers an industry competitive benefits package and continues to invest in and evolve benefits programs that meet the health, wellness and financial needs of our associates.

Benefits eligiblity is based on employment status.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays

  • Medical, Dental, Vision (Multiple Plans Available)

  • Basic Life (Company Paid) & Supplemental Life

  • Short and Long Term Disability (Company Paid)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Tuition/Continuing Education Reimbursement

  • Life Assistance Program

  • Pet Care Discounts

Commitment to Equal Employer Opportunities

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. For a complete EEO statement, please see our Career page at Antech Careers.


Note to Search Firms/Agencies

Antech Diagnostics, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (Antech) do not compensate search firms for unsolicited assistance unless they have a written search agreement with Antech and the requisition is position-specific. Any resumes, curriculum vitae, and other unsolicited assistance from search firms that do not have a written search agreement or position-specific requisition submitted to any Associate of Antech will be deemed the sole property of Antech and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Antech.

title: Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist-2
description:
About Ameren Missouri

Ameren Missouri has been providing electric and gas service for more than 100 years, and our electric rates are among the lowest in the nation. Ameren Missouri's mission is to power the quality of life for our 1.2 million electric and 132,000 natural gas customers in central and eastern Missouri. Our service area covers 64 counties and more than 500 communities including the greater St. Louis area.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire

  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

  • 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position

The Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist or Sr. Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist will support the execution of Ameren's Generation Transformation Plan by working cross-functionally with key leaders and teams on project due diligence in support of contract negotiations and regulatory approval for renewable acquisitions – build and development transfer agreements. This individual is responsible for cross-functional team coordination and timely communication on diligence activities, status, and risks and mitigation plans identified.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Renewable Energy Development Team Leadership and Cross-functional Teams to support key activities and initiatives related to due diligence and risk assessment for renewable energy acquisitions as part of Ameren Missouri's Generation Transformation plan.
  • Closely evaluate, streamline and maintain due diligence processes for acquisition of renewable energy projects. Participate in all due diligence meetings and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct due diligence activities in compliance with corporate processes to ensure continued and timely progress, identify and respond to key issues in a timely manner and systematically monitor and measure the overall status of the due diligence process.
  • Ensure continuous improvement and standardization of due diligence information, deliverables and processes with each new renewable energy project. Maintain streamlined and easily accessible shared due diligence systems and/or data rooms.
  • Work with all due diligence team members, leads and external experts, to develop and maintain a standardized risk assessment matrix and process for all new renewable energy projects.
  • Plan and attend meetings, identify major action items and work with leadership and others to ensure resources are available to complete all renewable energy due diligence and risk assessment tasks in a timely manner.
  • Assist with local, state and federal regulatory filings required for renewable energy acquisitions, specifically supporting the internal business case justifications, economic evaluation, technical and commercial due diligence data requests and regulatory filings with the Missouri Public Service Commission.
  • Work closely with key functions across the enterprise including but not limited to Corporate Strategy, Innovation & Sustainability, Real Estate, Environmental, Regulatory, Economic Development & Energy Solutions, Legal, Tax, Transmission, Digital, Supply Chain & Procurement, etc.to support the development of renewable energy projects.

Qualifications

Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College or University is required. Two or more years of relevant professional experience is required. Experience in or knowledge of Energy Generation, Renewable Energy Development, Transaction M&A, and/or other aspects of Sustainability preferred. Project management experience preferred. Experience leading cross functional teams without direct line reporting relationships preferred.


Sr. Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College or University is required. Five or more years of relevant professional experience is required. Experience in or knowledge of Energy Generation, Renewable Energy Development, Transaction M&A, and/or other aspects of Sustainability preferred. Project management experience preferred. Experience leading cross functional teams without direct line reporting relationships preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Champion learning and adaptability to the changes created by the external/internal environment.
  • Excellent team, program and project management skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal communications skills; able to effectively communicate and build relationships with stakeholders, process teams, leadership at all levels, and third parties.
  • Ability to prioritize, schedule and complete tasks for multiple projects with overlapping schedules.
  • Excellent facilitation skills for working with both internal and external parties.
  • Outstanding problem solving skills – ability to identify underlying causes of key issues, draw accurate conclusions across multiple situations, and develop strong insight into complex issues.
  • Highly motivated, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with competing priorities.
  • Proactive, persistent and dependable. Excellent time management skills. Strong work ethic.

Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

$71,100.00 - $137,200.00
