title: Network Administrator
description:
The Defense Sector at Leidos is seeking a motivated TS/SCI cleared Network Administrator to support the installation, configuration, and day-to-day management of enterprise network infrastructure. This role is an excellent opportunity for an early-career network professional to gain hands-on experience with routing and switching platforms, including Session Smart Router (SSR) / 128 Technology SD-WAN solutions, in a structured and security-conscious environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a solid foundation in networking fundamentals, a willingness to learn vendor-specific technologies, and the discipline to operate within DoD network standards.

The job duties will be performed daily on site at Langley Air Force Base, VA.

​

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • ​Assist in the configuration, deployment, and ongoing management of routers, switches, and Session Smart Router (SSR) appliances across enterprise and edge network environments.

  • ​Support the design and implementation of routing policies, service policies, and traffic steering configurations on SSR/128 Technology platforms under senior engineer guidance.

  • ​Perform LAN switching administration — including VLAN configuration, spanning tree, trunking, and port security — on Juniper EX Series and/or Cisco Catalyst platforms.

  • ​Assist with the configuration and troubleshooting of routing protocols including OSPF and BGP (eBGP and iBGP) across enterprise WAN and data center environments.

  • ​Monitor network health, availability, latency, and throughput using network management tools; escalate anomalies and assist in root cause analysis.

  • ​Support configuration and maintenance of firewall rules, access control lists (ACLs), IPsec VPN tunnels, and other network security controls.

  • ​Execute software and firmware upgrades, patch management, and lifecycle maintenance activities for network devices in accordance with change management procedures.

  • ​Maintain accurate and up-to-date network diagrams, device inventories, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • ​Coordinate with senior network engineers, system administrators, and security personnel to resolve network incidents and support planned infrastructure changes.

  • ​Participate in on-call rotation and assist with troubleshooting during network outages or degraded service events.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 2+ years of experience or a Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • ​Must have at least an active Top Secret clearance and the ability to obtain a SCI prior to your start date.

  • ​DoD 8570/8140-compliant certification at IAT Level II - CompTIA Security+ CE required at minimum.

  • Demonstrated understanding of OSI model, TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, static routing), and WAN technologies.

  • Practical experience with LAN switching concepts on Juniper EX Series or Cisco Catalyst platforms, including VLANs, STP, and trunking.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a team environment under supervision.

​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ​Juniper Networks Certified Associate (JNCIA-Junos) or progress toward JNCIS-ENT; Juniper SSR-specific training or certification a strong plus or Cisco CCNA.

  • Familiarity with Border Gateway Protocol — including eBGP and iBGP concepts, peer configuration, route policies, and basic troubleshooting in a multi-site or service provider-adjacent environment.

  • Exposure to Juniper Session Smart Router (formerly 128 Technology) platforms, including familiarity with session-based routing, service and tenant models, or WAN traffic steering concepts.

  • Hands-on experience with advanced switching features such as RSTP/MSTP, LACP/LAG, Q-in-Q, or Layer 3 switching on either Juniper EX Series or Cisco Catalyst hardware.

  • Working knowledge of IPsec VPN configuration, zone-based firewall policies, or experience with Juniper SRX Series security platforms.

  • Basic familiarity with network automation tools or scripting (Python, Ansible, or Junos) for configuration management or compliance checks.

  • CompTIA Network+, or other vendor-neutral networking credentials demonstrating a broad networking foundation.

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer, Avionics (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELECTRIC PROPULSION ENGINEER, AVIONICS (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads.

SpaceX is hiring an Electric Propulsion Engineer (avionics focus) to join a collaborative engineering team working on design, analysis, build, and test of high-volume, flight-qualified satellite electric propulsion systems. In this role you will contribute end-to-end hardware ownership of propulsion power-processing and control electronics—from design through production support and qualification—for hardware that must meet flight reliability requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, analyze, test, and provide operational support for high-volume production spacecraft electric propulsion avionics (power-processing and control electronics that drive thrusters, heaters, and propellant-feed actuators)
  • Lead or contribute to electrical architecture, specification, component selection, circuit-board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging (depth in several of these areas is expected over time; prior ownership of every step is not required)
  • Design, develop, and test propulsion electronics, including characterization, requirements generation and verification, and flight qualification
  • Partner with firmware/software, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and production-test teams
  • Design, build, modify, operate, and troubleshoot electric propulsion electronics and associated test setups, including vacuum-chamber electrical interfaces, high-voltage supplies, data acquisition and control systems, harnessing, and instrumentation
  • Analyze and review ground-test and flight data with numerical tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB) to confirm hardware is operating as expected and inform design decisions; develop scripts as needed
  • Lead root-cause investigations and board or component redesigns to improve reliability and/or production rates
  • Develop and execute qualification test plans for flight readiness (vibration, shock, thermal cycle, EMI/EMC, life cycle, fault injection)
  • Evaluate design and qualification coverage for new vehicles and missions; close gaps with targeted analysis or test
  • Make risk-informed trades across cost, lead time, reliability, and performance to meet program reliability targets for flight hardware
  • Own critical spaceflight hardware end-to-end, with support from manufacturing, reliability, test, firmware, and operations teams
  • Work as an integrated team, with daily interactions among technicians, engineers, and managers; identify and implement design and process improvements
  • Communicate clearly under ambiguity, escalate technical and schedule risks early, and collaborate through disagreement

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical, aerospace, physics, mechanical, or other engineering discipline preferred
  • 1+ years of total experience in one or a combination of the following: professional or internship experience designing, testing, and analyzing power electronics, analog/mixed-signal, or spacecraft avionics; academic research with comparable design/build/test ownership of power supplies, plasma or electric-propulsion power processing, high-voltage, or control electronics; or closely related hardware experience (e.g., motor drives, converters, RF/power, or instrumentation for vacuum or plasma systems)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated delivery of hardware for aerospace, defense, space, or equivalent high-reliability or safety-critical use (lab, flight, or production; new design or iterative redesign)
  • Experience with mixed-signal or power electronics bring-up, characterization, and debug
  • Working knowledge of analog and power electronics, high-voltage design, circuit protection, EMI/EMC, and numerical analysis programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB); control loops, plasma or nonlinear electrical loads, schematic/layout review, vacuum operation, and C/C++ as applicable (depth in several of these areas is valued; mastery of all is not expected)
  • Experience prioritizing concurrent design, build, and test work against flight and production milestones
  • Clear documentation habits appropriate for flight hardware
  • Track record of improving designs and processes for reliability, rate, or quality
  • Active Top Secret or Top Secret/SCI clearance, or ability and willingness to obtain a Top Secret clearance, is desired but not required

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • An active clearance may provide the opportunity to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing
  • Ability to perform essential job duties that may include working in and around vacuum chambers and high-voltage test areas—standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting the upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings, and climbing hand-over-hand. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time
  • This role is primarily on-site to support hands-on test facility and hardware work (location per posting)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $105,000.00 - $140,000.00
Level 2: $120,000.00 - $170,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

description:
Job Description

Hello Future Database Administrator III

Welcome to FNB, the home of the #changeables. We design for the shapeshifters and deliver products and services that make us incredibly proud of people that make it happen.

Are you someone who has experience in:

  • Responsible for the 24/7 support of postgres production database services to ensure the highest standards of availability, resilience, integrity, security and performance required by the business systems

You will be responsible for:

  • Responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, and performance of PostgreSQL databases supporting business-critical applications.
  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain PostgreSQL database servers across development, test, and production environments.
  • Design, implement, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions using PostgreSQL replication technologies (streaming replication, Patroni, repmgr, etc.).
  • Proactively monitor PostgreSQL instances, identify performance bottlenecks, and minimize downtime through preventive maintenance and health checks.
  • Perform database performance tuning by optimizing SQL queries, indexes, execution plans, and PostgreSQL configuration parameters.
  • Plan, implement, and validate backup and recovery strategies using tools such as pgBackRest, pg_basebackup, WAL archiving, and Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR).
  • Manage database storage, tablespaces, and capacity planning to ensure optimal utilization and future scalability.
  • Create and maintain database objects, including schemas, tables, indexes, views, sequences, functions, and materialized views.
  • Implement database changes, schema migrations, and release deployments in coordination with development and application teams.
  • Configure and maintain PostgreSQL security by managing users, roles, privileges, authentication methods, SSL certificates, and auditing.
  • Monitor database growth, resource utilization, replication health, and system performance, providing trend analysis and capacity planning reports.
  • Perform routine database maintenance activities such as VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX, statistics management, and partition maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve PostgreSQL database issues related to performance, replication, connectivity, locking, deadlocks, and data integrity.
  • Configure and maintain logical and physical replication, replication slots, WAL management, and failover mechanisms.
  • Support database migration and upgrade activities, including major PostgreSQL version upgrades and data migration projects.
  • Develop and execute SQL scripts, stored procedures, and ad-hoc queries to support reporting, troubleshooting, and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and DevOps teams to ensure database availability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Automate routine PostgreSQL administration tasks using shell scripting, SQL, and scheduling tools such as pg_cron.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, backup standards, and database governance best practices.

What you will need:

  • Must have between 4 and 6 years relevant experience
  • Experience administering Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databases on AWS is an added advantage.
  • Must be able to perform duties listed above
  • Postgres technical skills
    • General database maintenance
    • Database performance & storage optimisation
    • Database security
  • Good knowledge of PSQL.
  • Good knowledge of Linux
  • Hands-on experience in configuring, administering, and troubleshooting PostgreSQL ecosystem tools, including Pgpool-II, Patroni, pgBackRest, and PgBouncer, to support high availability, connection pooling, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.

We can be a match if you can:

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Committed, reliable, self starter, able to work independently

Position Overview

The Quoting Specialist is responsible for preparing and managing accurate and competitive quotations for customers based on their requirements. This role involves collaborating with various departments such as sales, procurement, and operations to ensure timely and effective delivery of quotes. The Quoting Specialist plays a critical role in supporting the sales process and contributing to customer satisfaction and company profitability.

This position will be located at Plant 2 for Wanzl North America (WNA) in Newton, NC.


Company and Opportunity Overview

WNA’s vision is to be a leading entrepreneurial player in terms of market share, agility, and game-changing solutions. WNA is a solution provider, creating value along the supply chain of our customers, from online purchase to their customers.

WNA is headquartered in the Charlotte Metro Area, North Carolina. With around 500 employees and ~$200M of sales, WNA focuses on the retail and distribution market segments with marquee customers such as Walmart, Amazon, and the majority of large grocers and retailers.

In addition to being the largest manufacturer of shopping carts in North America, WNA has three additional main product segments as well as a Service business, providing turnkey solutions for customer guidance (Access Systems), Shelving & Fixtures, and Material Handling products.

Access Solutions provides sophisticated customer guidance and loss prevention systems for major retailers. With German-engineered products and a strong installed base, this segment focuses on protecting existing market share while expanding into adjacent opportunities in smart retail, autonomous store technology, and digital integration.

description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a Principal Cybersecurity Engineer (Firewall Policy Implementation), with demonstrated AI experience to join our high-performing cybersecurity Team. This is a hands-on, deeply technical, engineering role for firewall experts with real-world Firewall Policy operations and management experience at the large-scale enterprise level. This position is not people management and is not intended for junior or mid-level candidates. Supervisory-only or Advisory-only level experience will not suffice for this role. You will be responsible for operating, maintaining, and optimizing Firewall Platforms, driving policy quality and consistency. Additionally, you will support troubleshooting and operational excellence across a complex, global environment. Over time, you will also help apply Operational Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities to improve efficiency, reliability, and security.


This is not a remote or hybrid position. This role requires onsite presence 5 days per week in the Charlotte, NC hub location. However, other hub locations, such as Dallas, TX; Bothell, WA; Middletown, NJ; or Alpharetta, GA may be considered for exceptionally strong candidate matches.

Key Responsibilities: Typical tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Security Implementation and Management: Optimize and implement firewall rules to mitigate risk, harden perimeter defenses, and protect systems, critical infrastructure, and customer data.
  • Firewall Policy Lifecycle Management: Own day-to-day firewall policy operations, management, tuning, cleanup, insertions, removals, and hardware decommissions.
  • Execute Configuration Change Management: Safely apply approved firewall policy changes within defined change processes, including validation and post-change verification to ensure changes are properly approved, documented, and meet intended outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot Connectivity and Security Policy Issues and Outages: Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and operations teams to troubleshoot outages and security incidents through identification, triage, analysis, containment, recovery, and root cause determination.
  • Identify and Drive Automation and AI Opportunities: Leverage AT&T-owned and managed instances of Copilot, ChatGPT, GitHub, Gemini Claude, etc., to reduce tedious manual process and improve accuracy.
  • Risk Assessment and Strategic Planning: Perform risk assessments and analyze complex security issues to develop mitigation strategies and reduce attack surface exposure, supporting forward-looking research, planning, and innovation in cybersecurity.
  • Technical Support and Collaboration: Provide technical support and expertise for security-related rollouts and issues. Work closely with IT, network, and business units to integrate security measures, and support various cyber-related projects.

Ramp-Up / Initial Focus:

  • Learn the team’s environment, offerings, tooling, processes, and operating models.
  • Complete structured onboarding: mentoring, coaching sessions, proficiency checks, and shadowing.
  • Earn authorization/sign-off to independently execute Firewall policy changes and operational tasks as directed and participate in an on-call rotation for troubleshooting in coordination with AT&T’s Global Technology Operations Center (GTOC).

Long-Term Focus & Scope:

Once fully integrated into the operational rotation, you will execute changes and navigate processes and systems to deliver Firewall policy updates, removals, monitoring/soak, and incident troubleshooting at enterprise scale as directed.

As proficiency grows, you will help introduce and mature AI-assisted operations to improve throughput, reduce risk, and strengthen defense layers.

Required Qualifications:

This is a Principal Position requiring direct, recent experience implementing, validating, and troubleshooting Firewall Policies.

  • 7+ years’ experience operating and maintaining Firewall Policies (Rule Sets).
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing enterprise Firewall Policy in production environments.
  • Strong operational discipline: change control validation, closely following documented processes, rollback planning, and post-change verification.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot Network/Security and Firewall Policy issues under time pressure.
  • Experience working in large-scale, complex environments with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or equivalent cybersecurity certification (CISM, CISA, CRISC, etc.).
  • Any Palo Alto certifications such as PCNSE / PCNSA (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
  • Experience with Palo Alto CLI policy automation, orchestration, or "policy as code" approaches and Python policy scripting.
  • Experience with Visual Studio Code, Jupyter Notebook, and Agentic coding using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT).
  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity/network security engineering experience, including enterprise operations.
  • 5+ years of Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS) Firewall platform and policy management in production environments.
  • Exposure to AI/ML-enabled operations, AIOps, or using AI tooling for incident reduction and efficiency.
  • Familiarity with metrics-driven operations (usage, hit counts, error rates, change success, MTTR, policy hygiene)
  • Experience with AlgoSec, URL Filtering, WildFire, Threat Prevention, DNS Security, and security profile tuning.
  • Experience with SSL decryption strategy/operations, including break/fix and exception handling.
  • Exposure to AIOps / Operational AI use cases (e.g., anomaly detection, change risk scoring, incident summarization, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation).
  • Experience integrating Firewall operations with ITSM and CI/CD tooling (e.g., ServiceNow workflows, change gates, automated validation).
  • Familiarity with network fundamentals at scale: BGP/OSPF basics, VRFs, VLANs, IPsec concepts, DNS, and load-balancing impacts on traffic paths.

Success Looks Like:

  • Safe, accurate, and timely delivery of Firewall changes per SLA requirements with minimal rework.
  • Strong troubleshooting outcomes and reduced incident recurrence.
  • Improved operational efficiency through automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Clear documentation and process contributions that scale across the team.
  • Demonstrated expertise with Palo Alto Firewall policy lifecycle: rule creation/updates, cleanup/removals, recertification, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Strong working knowledge of App-ID, User-ID, Content-ID, zones, security policies, NAT policies, and service objects.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and resolving issues involving:
    • Security/NAT rule matching and shadowing
    • Routing impacts on policy enforcement
    • Decryption/policy interactions (where applicable)
    • Application behavior vs. port-based assumptions
  • Operational rigor with enterprise change processes: risk assessment, implementation plans, validation/testing, rollback planning, and post-change verification.
  • Experience using centralized management such as Panorama (templates, device groups, commits, commit validation, log collection basics.)
  • Proficiency analyzing logs and traffic flows using Traffic logs, Threat logs, URL logs, and packet captures; ability to validate policy outcomes with evidence.
  • Ability to partner effectively with network, application, and operations teams to drive outcomes under time constraints.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to follow/author repeatable processes (playbooks & runbooks).

Leads critical, high-impact projects and designs/implements innovative business strategies. Works with minimal oversight, frequently consulting senior leadership and influencing executive decisions. Serves as a mentor and assists others with challenging issues.

description:
Summary:

Under the management Cardiac Interventional Services Manager, the Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist (CIS)/Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (CES) is a part of a patient care team that performs various cardiac, neuro and peripheral vascular diagnostic and interventional procedures.

The CIS must possess expertise in the theory and application of cardiovascular/peripheral vascular disease process, procedures specific to their specialty, as well as aseptic technique. The CIS/CES will be able to anticipate the next steps of the procedure by constant attention and assessment of the process and patient condition to promote a safe, expedient, quality patient outcome and positive patient experience.

The CIS/CES will scrub and assist the physician at the procedural table. They will also monitor, identify and record pertinent EKG and hemodynamic data. They will submit charges and document chronological events of the procedure. They will set up,operate and may troubleshoot Equipment pertinent to their specialty. RCIS - Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump (IABP), Rotoblator, Impella, Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR), Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS), CSI in addition to any new technologies. CES - Mapping, Programming, Recording with systems common to the field of electrophysiology. They will act as a resource to the physician by understanding the potential application, risks and benefits of all available procedural supplies and equipment. They will anticipate, gather and deliver required items to the sterile field using aseptic technique.

The CIS will be an active member of a 24/7 call team supporting Cardiac and Neurological emergencies.

Applications: Cerner(CIS), McKesson Horizon Cardiology, Vuemed.

Job Responsibilities:

1) Participates in team huddle/time-out and all aspects of the procedure.

2) Acts as a first assist during cardiovascular and Neurovascular procedures.

3) Maintains, AHA certification in ACLS and Healthcare Provider BLS.

4) Operates and maintains all diagnostic and therapeutic equipment under the direction of the performing physician.

5) Prepares the patient for the procedure in prep/recovery area and procedure room.

6) Explain the process and reinforce patient teachings throughout the procedure.

7) Sets up non-invasive monitoring. (EKG,BP, Pulse Oximetry, etc.)

8) Preps and drapes patients using appropriate aseptic and sterile techniques.

9) Facilitate insertion and manipulation of guide wires and catheters into vasculature under fluoroscopic guidance for cardiovascular and Neurovascular procedures.

10) Obtains invasive hemodynamic data, cardiac output, and blood samples as required by procedure.

11) Injects contrast manually or with the aid of a mechanical contrast device to visualize cardiovascular anatomical structures(angiography).

12) Manages diagnostic and therapeutic modalities. (FFR, IMPELLA, IABP, Angiojet, Rotoblator, CSI) CIS.

13) Performs Point of Care testing.

14) Assist and performs emergency resuscitation.

15) Performs patient monitoring as well as complete and accurate documentation of all aspects of the procedure—captures and inputs data for procedural calculations.

16) Manages access site and hemostasis, manual sheath removal.

17) Attends staff meetings, in-service, and other designated training events that will enhance clinical and other required skills.

18) Performs the minimum of on-call rotations as determined by staffing requirements and manager discretion to ensure competency is maintained. (CIS)

19) Dysrhythmia recognition.

title: Psychiatrist
description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.

Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaboate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.

Why We Are Different

  • Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.
  • Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.
  • Continuous learning. Through our collaboration with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.
  • Advancing the field. Our clinicians contribute to new outcomes frameworks and research shaping the future of severe mental illness care.
  • A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

The Role

We are hiring a Psychiatrist (Full-Time/Part-Time) to join our interdisciplinary team at our new clinic opening early 2027 in Irvine, CA. This onsite role is central to delivering personalized, compassionate, high-quality care to individuals with serious mental illness (SMI).

What You Will Work On

  • Provide behavioral healthcare management to Amae Health patients; monitor and manage care through an array of treatment modalities as patients progress through phases of recovery
  • Develop individualized treatment plans during the engagement and stabilization phase, focused on specific psychosocial and medical needs that might limit recovery
  • Provide continuous, regular consultations as patients navigate recovery, both in person and occasionally virtually
  • Liaise with patient care teams and collaborate with behavioral health providers to ensure an integrated, cohesive approach to care
  • Address medical needs to mitigate negative impacts of social determinants of health

What You'll Have

  • Board-Certified or Board-Eligible Psychiatrist, with a CA license and DEA that are active, unrestricted, and in good standing
  • In possession of or willing to obtain Clozapine REMS certification
  • Prior experience with mental health and/or addiction issues; familiarity with the medical, mental health, and social service systems in the Irvine area
  • Holistic perspective on health and understanding of patient rights
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a wide range of settings with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Comfort working one-on-one or in group settings; strong coaching and negotiation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ease adapting in a dynamic environment
  • Solid understanding of technology and a passion for utilizing technology to improve care delivery

What We're Building

As a clinician at Amae, you are not adjacent to this work. You are essential to it.

  • A national care delivery model for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
  • Precision medicine for SMI. Individualized treatment informed by multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data.
  • A clinical operating system that puts longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer for care teams.
  • Frontier science and measurement: defining and validating the outcomes frameworks that this field has never had. Hospitalizations avoided, days stable, functional improvement, and more.
  • A collaboration model with the country's leading health systems that proves coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Base salary range for this role is $300,000-$330,000 per year (full time) + performance-based bonus opportunity. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Parental leave and programs built around well-being. Note that part-time comp and benefits packages will vary depending on schedule. We’ll share specifics during the interview process.

If you want to practice at the top of your license, learn from the best in academic medicine, contribute to research that is defining a new field, and do it all inside a team that was actually built for this work, we'd like to talk.

What We Value

  • We center care in all we do. Empathy is not a brand value. It’s how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
  • We challenge convention. The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
  • We take the work seriously, not ourselves. High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
  • Your job isn’t done until the job is done. We close gaps, we follow through, and we don’t hide behind titles or org charts.

title: Multimedia Designer
description:
Position Summary

The Multimedia Designer creates engaging, high-quality visual experiences that bring the brand to life across digital, motion, video, and print channels. This role combines strong graphic design fundamentals with hands-on expertise in motion graphics, animation, and video editing to develop creative assets for integrated campaigns, social media, websites, product initiatives, events, sales enablement, and customer communications.

Working closely with the marketing team and cross-functional partners, the Multimedia Designer translates ideas, messaging, and business objectives into compelling visual stories. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing a polished static asset, animating a campaign concept, and editing short-form video. They are a thoughtful creative problem solver with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Multimedia Design and Creative Development

  • Design digital and print marketing assets, including website graphics, landing page visuals, email graphics, social content, digital ads, presentations, one-pagers, event materials, infographics, and campaign collateral.
  • Translate creative briefs, messaging, and campaign goals into clear, engaging visual concepts that align with brand and marketing objectives.
  • Develop graphics, templates, and reusable design systems that improve creative efficiency and consistency.
  • Prepare production-ready files and adapt creative across formats, dimensions, platforms, and audience needs.

Motion Graphics, Animation, and Video

  • Create motion graphics and animations for social media, digital advertising, websites, presentations, product storytelling, events, webinars, and internal communications.
  • Edit short-form video content, including promotional videos, customer stories, event recaps, speaker content, product demonstrations, and social clips.
  • Develop storyboards, style frames, transitions, animated typography, iconography, data visualizations, and other motion elements that make complex ideas easy to understand.
  • Incorporate music, voiceover, sound effects, captions, and brand elements to produce polished, accessible video content.
  • Optimize and export motion and video assets for different channels, aspect ratios, file-size requirements, and playback environments.
  • Create reusable motion templates and establish consistent animation standards for the brand.
  • Stay current on motion design, animation, video, and platform-specific creative trends, applying them thoughtfully rather than following trends for their own sake.

Brand and Visual Identity

  • Maintain a consistent, cohesive brand experience across static, motion, video, digital, and print touchpoints.
  • Help evolve and strengthen the company’s visual and motion identity through thoughtful design solutions.
  • Create and maintain brand assets, templates, motion guidelines, and creative resources.
  • Review work for visual quality, brand alignment, accuracy, and consistency before delivery.

Campaign and Marketing Support

  • Partner with marketing teams to develop creative concepts for integrated campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels.
  • Create supporting visuals and multimedia content for product launches, webinars, events, announcements, thought leadership, and customer initiatives.
  • Collaborate on creative direction, production plans, timelines, and deliverables for marketing initiatives.
  • Support sales enablement through presentations, videos, one-pagers, infographics, case studies, and other visual materials.

Website and Digital Experience

  • Design and optimize website graphics, banners, illustrations, animations, and promotional assets.
  • Partner with marketing and web teams to improve visual storytelling, usability, and engagement across digital experiences.
  • Support the creation and ongoing improvement of landing pages and company websites.
  • Design lightweight web animations and motion elements with attention to usability, accessibility, performance, and responsive behavior.

Social Media and Content Design

  • Design static graphics, animated content, short-form videos, templates, and campaign assets that support social media strategy.
  • Collaborate with content creators to translate written concepts into platform-appropriate visual stories.
  • Adapt creative for channel-specific formats and placements while maintaining a consistent campaign identity.

Project Management and Collaboration

  • Manage multiple creative projects while balancing priorities, deadlines, production requirements, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, sales, customer success, and external creative partners.
  • Present and explain creative concepts, incorporate feedback, and guide projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Maintain organized source files, templates, footage, project archives, and creative libraries.
  • Help scope projects, identify production needs, and communicate risks or timeline considerations early.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Motion Design, Animation, Visual Communications, Multimedia Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2–5 years of professional experience in multimedia design, marketing design, or a related role, including at least two years of hands-on professional experience creating motion graphics and animation.
  • Strong portfolio or demo reel demonstrating motion graphics, animation, video editing, and visual design work across multiple formats.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Demonstrated experience creating motion graphics and animations from concept or storyboard through final production. Motion design and animation experience are essential requirements for this role.
  • Experience creating animated explainers, product demonstrations, kinetic typography, animated data visualizations, or performance-focused social content.
  • Experience editing video, including pacing, transitions, audio, color correction, captions, and delivery for multiple digital platforms.
  • Experience designing assets for digital campaigns, social media, websites, presentations, and marketing programs.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, color, visual hierarchy, timing, movement, and storytelling.
  • Working knowledge of video and animation production standards, including aspect ratios, frame rates, codecs, compression, and export settings.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, respond constructively to feedback, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for a B2B SaaS, technology, property management, or service-based company.
  • Familiarity with Figma, Canva, and other collaborative or rapid-production design tools.
  • Familiarity with UI/UX principles, responsive web design, and web animation best practices.
  • Experience creating presentation decks, sales enablement materials, and event content.
  • Experience with photography, videography, art direction, or remote video production.
  • Familiarity with digital accessibility standards, including captioning, legibility, contrast, and motion considerations.
  • Understanding of digital marketing best practices and how creative decisions can influence engagement and campaign performance.

Core Competencies

  • Visual and motion storytelling
  • Creativity and concept development
  • Strong design fundamentals
  • Attention to detail and quality
  • Brand stewardship
  • Collaboration and communication
  • Organization and project management
  • Ability to receive, interpret, and incorporate feedback
  • Problem-solving and adaptability
  • Curiosity and continuous learning

Essential Functions

  • Consistent delivery of high-quality static, motion, and video assets that support marketing and business objectives.
  • Strong visual and motion consistency across campaigns, digital channels, and customer touchpoints.
  • Increased engagement with multimedia campaigns and creative content.
  • Efficient development of reusable templates, motion systems, and production workflows.
  • Reliable project delivery, clear communication, and positive collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex ideas and marketing objectives into clear, memorable visual stories.

title: Product Experience Associate
description:
Job Summary

Are you passionated for Sensory and Consumer Research analysis?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Within our Taste business, we combine science, creativity, and consumer understanding to develop innovative flavor solutions that help our customers create products consumers love.

This role is based in South Brunswick or Union Beach, New Jersey and is an on-site position. Be part of a collaborative, customer-focused, innovative team where together we can make a meaningful impact through sensory and consumer research. Your potential is our inspiration.

Where You'll Make a Difference

  • Manage and lead descriptive sensory and consumer panels, including recruitment, scheduling, vacation planning, attendance tracking, performance reviews, and ongoing panel development.
  • Plan, organize, and oversee sensory panel activities to ensure efficient execution of multiple projects while aligning priorities and timelines.
  • Lead descriptive sensory evaluations according to internally defined quality standards and support sensory methodology selection based on project objectives.
  • Partner closely with Creation & Design (C&D) teams and PX Researchers to align testing objectives, review ballots, select samples, and provide project feedback.
  • Ensure product and sample readiness by verifying quality, evaluating organoleptic characteristics, and coordinating delivery requirements, including serving conditions and testing protocols.
  • Analyze sensory and discrimination test data, generate reports, maintain study documentation, and support descriptive project deliverables.
  • Coordinate consumer research studies with external vendors and internal stakeholders, including recruitment, sample management, study execution, and data collection.
  • Maintain sensory databases, panel performance records, and project documentation while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and standard operating procedures.
  • Coach and coordinate the activities of the Panel Assistant while supporting knowledge sharing and sensory capability building across the organization.

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Biology, Psychology, or another related scientific discipline.
  • One to three years of experience in a laboratory environment; sensory laboratory experience is highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of sensory evaluation methodologies and sensory research principles.
  • Experience working with sensory data collection platforms such as EyeQuestion, Compusense, or similar tools is an advantage.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Ability to work independently and manage assigned responsibilities with limited supervision.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and data quality.
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to recruit, coach, and engage sensory panelists.
  • Ability to travel between South Brunswick and Union Beach as business needs require (1 day per week)

How Would You Stand Out?

  • Experience leading descriptive sensory panels or consumer research studies.
  • Knowledge of sensory statistics and data interpretation methods.
  • Bring curiosity, a love of learning, comfort navigating ambiguity, and a genuine passion for advancing best practices in sensory science.

Why Choose Us?

  • Opportunity to work with industry-leading experts in sensory and consumer science.
  • Exposure to innovative taste technologies and product development projects.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Hands-on experience across descriptive sensory and consumer research methodologies.
  • Mileage reimbursement when traveling between South Brunswick and Union Beach locations for business needs.
  • A chance to contribute to products that consumers experience every day around the world.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Data Analyst
description:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst (TID) is part of the Transit Technology team within the Transformation & Technology Department. The Transit Technology team is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining dispatching systems and other technology tools that enable MBTA Operations division to deliver safer, more efficient, and more reliable transit services. This role will work closely with Transit Tech product teams to measure and monitor the success of technology products and initiatives as part of outcome-driven technology delivery.

The Data Analyst (TID) will empower stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and create a culture of continuous improvement. The position will collect, clean, and validate data, perform statistical analyses using modern data analysis and visualization tools, communicate findings, and write technical documentation. The Data Analyst will collaborate with other team members to share knowledge, provide cross-training, and jointly support cross-divisional projects.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design dashboards, visualizations, graphs, charts, and tools that clearly communicate outcomes, findings, and trends of Operations data.
  • Proactively build and maintain positive and effective relationships with Departments. Work with Departments to analyze results, forecast current and future needs, assess performance, and evaluate strategic opportunities.
  • Communicate with and present to executive leadership project results and findings.
  • Gather, analyze, and interpret operational data using a combination of SQL, Excel, Python and/or relevant modern data analysis tools.
  • Perform quality control on data inputs, calculations, algorithms, and model outputs, and investigate associated data gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Develop tools to facilitate the automation and dissemination of analyses.
  • Prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports, slideshows, and other visual reports incorporating narratives and graphic data, for both online and print formats.
  • Manage timelines, project milestones, and communications with internal and external partners.
  • Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or coworker, in a courteous and professional manner consistent with the Authority’s quality standard.
  • Work directly with Operations Leadership to identify the needs specific to the assigned division.
  • Collaborate with other Analysts on the knowledge sharing, cross-training, and joint support of cross-division projects.
  • Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.
Additional responsibilities may include a focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Supervision
  • No direct reports.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in business, finance, economics, computer science, data science, urban planning, engineering, or a related field.
  • Two (2) years of experience in data science, business analytics, business intelligence, quantitative analysis, or other related fields.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. As part of the interview process, an Excel assessment may be required.
  • Experience in at least one approach to advanced data analysis (e.g., SQL, Python, R, SPSS, GIS, or other).
  • Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and use creative and collaborative approaches to resolve issues.
  • Effective organizational, analytical, multi-tasking, and time management skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Possess strong statistics and data fundamentals.
  • The ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle), including writing queries to obtain and manipulate data.
  • Experience with Python, Excel VBA, or other programming languages, and/or data management and statistical analysis tools (R, SPSS, STATA, SAS, etc.).
  • Experience with Tableau or other visualization software.
  • Familiarity with transportation planning and transit systems, particularly the MBTA subway and bus network

Substitutions
  • A High School Diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
  • An associate degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
  • A master’s degree in a related subject substitute for two (2) years of general experience.
  • A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one year of experience.

Job Conditions:

  • Ability to effectively read, comprehend, communicate, and respond to instructions, orders, signs, notices, inquiries, etc. in English.
  • Be at least eighteen (18) years of age, except if participating in an approved high school internship / co-op program.
  • Ability to commute to assigned work locations in the Boston, MA metro area, as required by the role.
  • Ability to provide internal and external customers with courteous and professional experiences.
  • Ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a diverse workforce team (or supervise, if required).

title: Fall Protection Training Expertise
description:
Leidos is seeking an Environmental Occupational Health and Safety (EOSH) Professional with Fall Protection Training expertise to join the National Airspace System Integration Support Contract (NISC IV) team.


In this role, you will be supporting the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Environmental Occupational Safety and Health (EOSH) Programs with the goal of mitigating organizational risks and assisting the FAA achieve an improved state of compliance with Occupational Safety and Health and Environmental Federal, State, and Local law(s).


The focus of the position will be providing support to the FAA’s Fall Protection Program and you will be responsible for the creation, monitoring, tracking, interpreting, and presentation of various reports and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to all levels of FAA and NISC management.



This is a remote position with up to 75% travel.

Should be located in the eastern part of the US.




Primary Responsibilities:

  • Inspect workplace for potential fall hazards, determine the necessary steps to mitigate fall risk, and submit recommendations to the FAA.
  • Conduct equipment inspections to recommend repair and replacements.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and demonstrate knowledge of current safety regulations (e.g., Occupational Safety and Health Administration [OSHA], American National Standards Institute [ANSI], Environmental Protection Agency [EPA], and US Department of Transportation [DOT]) while remaining abreast of evolving safety regulations.
  • Deliver training with technical concepts that are clear and relatable to various career levels frontline workers to senior management.
  • Directly responsible for conducting individual student evaluations as a subject matter expert to determine successful completion of the course.
  • Prepare and submit required pre- and post-course reporting.
  • Organize and manage all individual travel arrangements.
  • Ensure all Fall Protection specifications are consistent with all applicable federal, state, local and agency-specific laws, regulations, and guidelines related to Fall Protection.



Basic Qualifications:

  • Requires BS degree and 4+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters and prior relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Ability to classify and summarize EOSH data for the preparation and submission of reports on a recurring basis as needed.
  • Ability to work at heights, successfully complete fall protection training, and achieve rescue level fall protection certification.
  • Ensure all fall protection specifications are consistent with all applicable Federal, State, Local and Agency specific laws, regulations, and guidelines related to Fall Protection.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time.
  • Ability to work at heights on towers up to 100ft and to safely lift 75 lbs.
  • Solid analytical, planning and program assessment skills in the Environmental Occupational Health and Safety field.
  • Thorough knowledge of OSHA, ANSI, EPA, and DOT regulations, practices, and/or protocols.
  • Solid oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to create, interpret and present various EOSH related reports.
  • Working knowledge and proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office applications to include MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook and MS Power Point.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior FAA experience

title: Visual QA
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. About the Role

You will play a key role in ensuring both the visual quality and functional integrity of deliverables before release. You’ll work across design, content, and development stages to make sure every asset is not only pixel-perfect and on-brand, but also functionally seamless. We’re looking for someone detail-oriented, collaborative, and proactive—someone who can spot inconsistencies, validate functionality, and help improve the overall quality and consistency of our outputs.

Responsibilities:

  • You will be part of a dedicated project team for one of our biggest clients.
  • Review and QA designs, animations, and edits for pixel perfect execution, consistency, copy accuracy, and adherence to strict branding and platform specifications.
  • As a QA Monk at our assets division, you use your eagle eye and proven QA methods to assess and ascertain the correct execution of templated designs.
  • Provide detailed, constructive feedback to creative teams, acting as the final checkpoint before public release.
  • Use Jira, Airtable and other project management tools to document, track, and report bugs or visual inconsistencies, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Continuously refine and integrate QA processes within the wider production workflow, identifying opportunities to boost efficiency and quality.
  • Maintain accurate, insightful QA documentation to track trends and guide improvements.
  • Collaborate with producers, designers, and developers to ensure the highest creative standards are met in a fast-paced environment
  • Next to testing, you help to better integrate quality assurance into the overall production process, making sure QA methods are fine tuned to our teams and workloads.

About You

The essentials:

  • You have 2–4 years of hands-on QA experience managing assets at scale, thrive in fast-paced environments, and bring your best self to work every day.
  • You’ll be working on a global project together with Monks in other offices. You must be fluent in English as it’s the language used in our daily operations and client collaboration.
  • Strong eye for design, layout, spacing, composition, consistency, and detail, with working proficiency in Figma or comparable design tools.
  • Experience reviewing digital deliverables across multiple devices and browsers.
  • Good understanding of digital media specs and cross-device requirements
  • Excellent organization and prioritization skills—able to manage multiple projects while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.
  • Clear communicator, adept at providing thorough and actionable feedback to creative and production teams.
  • Versed in QA and production tracking tools, particularly Jira and Excel.
  • Positive, solutions-oriented mindset with a natural drive for continuous improvement
  • Previous experience in a marketing, advertising or digital production environment.

Not a Must but a Plus:

  • Knowledge of, or strong interest in, generative AI, AI agents, and automated workflows.

title: General Foreperson
description:
Costain have won extensive work across the water sector to support the AMP 8 investment cycle.

Anglian Water has a principal commitment to delivering safe, clean drinking water to all in the Anglian region. To uphold this commitment, it has an ongoing programme of capital investment to maintain and improve its water storage assets. As part of a structured process, the requirement includes draining down and inspecting these storage point assets so that a scope of work can be established, followed by the completion of the required work and then bringing the assets back online. This is a very large programme of work with assets in locations across the whole of the AW region.

As a key partner, we are looking for an experienced General Foreperson to sit within the Project Delivery team and drive delivery through the Project both in pre-construction and on-site delivery.

Key locations: Peterborough, Cambridgeshire, Norfolk, Suffolk, Lincolnshire.

As our new General Foreperson, you’ll be responsible for the operational delivery on specific water storage point projects supporting pre-construction buildability and onsite delivery, supported by a wider delivery team. The role requires an individual with strong strategic thinking and ability to engage and communicate with a wide range of stakeholders including client teams, designers and direct reports to drive safety and quality delivery at all stages.

  • Ensure coordination across individual projects
  • Communicate between all parts of the operation team including suppliers, subcontractors, engineering, safety and environmental and client’s team
  • Work within the team to deliver all aspects of the project requirements; identify training requirements, review the performance of the workforce, and ensure delivery of briefings
  • Ensure high standard of quality on the works to meet the specification requirements ‘first time’ and minimise rework
  • Ensure accurate, legible, and up-to-date allocation sheets are recorded and provided at shift close with delivery tickets and plant returns to the engineering and commercial teams
  • Ensure all records for example inspections, works permits and briefings are up to date and in place
  • Carry out regular safety and environmental inspections and implement recommended courses of action as identified from progress monitoring and management inspections
  • Keep a full and accurate daily site diary, including any changes / variations, subcontractors’ attendance, and records of work-related discussions with client / designer / RE / project team

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience of multidisciplinary projects including Civils and MEICA (preferably in the water sector)
  • A proven collaborative individual who is experienced in projects of work including water infrastructure / medium or large-scale projects
  • Experienced in leading multi-contractor and multi-disciplined teams
  • Ability to review information, consult with relevant persons and organisations to make agile decisions
  • Can demonstrate the ability to out-perform against a tight budget through effective programme development, risk and opportunity management and use of production and innovation
  • Experience in stakeholder management; including customers, client, site operators, landowners and utility companies
  • Full UK Driving licence

  • SMSTS qualification
  • Relevant CSCS card
  • Lift Supervisor

title: Assistant Vice President / Vice President, Community Engagement
description:
Company Introduction:

We’re home to Asia's most dynamic and vibrant capital markets.
Connecting capital, ideas, inspiration and innovation for deeper, more diverse and liquid global capital markets; providing greater choice and opportunity for our customers, each and every day.

HKEX is a purpose-driven company. Our commitment to the long-term development of our business and our markets is articulated in our purpose: "To Connect, Promote and Progress our Markets and the Communities they support for the prosperity of all."

Job Summary:

Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) is looking for an experienced and innovative museum or exhibition curator to lead the operations and public engagement activities of the Group’s reimagined finance museum, which is slated to open in the second quarter of 2027.

As the AVP/VP - Community Engagement, the seasoned storyteller will oversee the launch and ongoing evolution of the finance museum, supporting the delivery of immersive and impactful visitor experiences through relevant themes and creative content that underscore HKEX’s strategic vision to build a multi-asset ecosystem for Hong Kong’s markets. The individual will also be a self-starter, who proactively engages with stakeholders across our community, including schools, universities and other local organisations, designing collaboration opportunities with the museum that drive deeper awareness of Hong Kong’s financial markets and building excitement towards the future market development.

HKEX is redeveloping its finance museum – located inside the iconic HKEX Connect Hall – as part of a broader programme to establish its permanent headquarters at Exchange Square, enabling enhancements that will provide a more impactful visitor experience to HKEX for key events and listing ceremonies, significantly elevating community connectivity and accessibility to HKEX. For the first time, the museum will be open to the public for individual visits and will feature a gift shop with branded souvenirs and collectibles.

Reporting to the Head of the Corporate Communications Management Office, the successful candidate will lead a dedicated team to develop the museum’s operational policies, oversee daily operations and manage the evolution of the content delivery, build cross sector community partnerships and curate group visits, helping elevate financial literacy whilst sharing HKEX’s heritage, forward-looking narrative and brand story with the public.

The successful candidate will be well-networked, and have experience in museum or exhibition curation, as well as areas such as community outreach, brand and reputation management, and content development. We are looking for a dedicated team player with strong attention to detail and who is passionate about telling the story of Hong Kong’s vibrant markets.

HKEX’s Corporate Communications Division is responsible for shaping the Group’s brand visibility and helping drive external and internal engagements and awareness that help protect and enhance the reputation of its business. We are committed to proactively communicating HKEX’s strategy and its latest developments, maintaining the Group’s high standards of transparency and managing HKEX’s relations with key stakeholder groups. The Corporate Communications Division oversees Financial and Executive Communications, Media Relations and Social Media, Internal and Digital Communications, Brand, Content and Speechwriting, Executive Engagements and Events, Film Production, and Translation.

Job Duties:

Job Responsibilities

  • Leading the day‑to‑day museum management, visitor services, tour arrangements and souvenir shop coordination.
  • Curate outreach programmes and tour experiences, such as themed workshops and presentations, to promote financial market awareness, share HKEX and Hong Kong market heritage and milestones
  • Build and deepen relations with schools, professional bodies, community groups and other local organisations, to develop collaboration opportunities that drive awareness.
  • Bring the museum vision to life, telling the story of Hong Kong’s status as a global financial hub and the continuous development of HKEX’s markets.
  • Incorporate visitor and stakeholder feedback, guided by corporate strategic developments, to renew content and develop rotating thematic exhibitions

Qualifications

  • University educated, preferably in communications, social sciences or related discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in museum or exhibition operations, community engagement, stakeholder management, content development, or related areas.
  • Excellent spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese and Putonghua), with strong presentation & networking skills.
  • Understanding of financial markets would be a plus.
  • Solid project management skills to manage multiple priorities and a proven self starter.
  • Customer‑focused, creative, organised, detail‑oriented with good problem‑solving abilities.
  • Occasional flexible hours required for weekend events and opening activities.

description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your role at Baxter

The Specialist, Controllership role at Baxter is part of Regional Controlling organization and is critical in ensuring compliance with US GAAP, statutory and tax requirements in Brazil. From General Ledger knowledge to specialized statutory regional regulation, this professional analyses, processes and correct accounting activities while identifies irregularities in Taxes, Statutory regulations or any other accounting related process.


What you'll be doing

  • This role is part of Regional Controlling organization and is critical in ensuring compliance with US GAAP, statutory and tax requirements in countries in scope.
  • The role requires understanding of complex accounting matters, quick problem-solving skills and strong collaboration with other finance and non-finance teams.
  • Lead the preparation and execution of Statutory, US GAAP and tax accounting and reporting for the entities in scope; ensure completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the reporting.
  • Lead the preparation for external statutory audits, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, timely delivery of audit requirements, and successful completion of audit activities
  • Act as a liaison for local tax authorities for direct and indirect tax day-to-day interactions, queries and audits.
  • Ensure adherence of processes to company's policies and procedures, internal and external audit requirements and local rules and regulations; support strengthening of financial processes and controls.
  • Work closely with other finance and non-finance teams, as well as external providers, in execution of end-to-end finance processes.
  • Participate in resolution of complex accounting and tax issues.
  • Participate in local, regional, and global projects, as required.
  • Be an advocate of finance function.
  • Maintain focus on continuous process improvement.

What you'll be doing

  • Minimum of 7 years in general accounting with knowledge in local regulations including taxes and national and international best practices.
  • Proven experience in a multinational environment and/or audit.
  • Excellent knowledge of local GAAPs and tax matters for the countries in scope.
  • Very good knowledge of US GAAP.
  • Excellent communication skills, diplomatic, flexible and “can do” mind-set.
  • Fluent in both written and spoken English. Spanish is nice to have.

  • Master’s degree in Finance/Accounting or part qualified /qualified ACCA/CPA.

Additional hours at critical times (e.g., month-end) may be required. Also, and on an exceptional basis, the role may require work on public holidays.

description:

We’re home to Asia's most dynamic and vibrant capital markets.

Group Internal Audit (GIA) supports the HKEX Group in achieving its business objectives, safeguarding its assets and reputation, and strengthening the control environment by providing objective, independent, and insightful assurance to the Board and senior management. GIA reports directly to the HKEX Audit Committee and administratively to the Group Chief Executive Officer.

Job Duties:

The role reports to the Head of Business Audit. Key responsibilities include:

• Develop good knowledge of the Group’s strategy, products, risk management processes, and operating platforms.

• Keep abreast of industry developments and business trends. Conduct research on industry and risk topics to increase the effectiveness of audit coverage and GIA’s ability to add value to the Group.

• Support the preparation of materials for senior management, Audit Committee, and regulators.
