location: McLean, VA, Nashville, TN, Raleigh, NC, Charlotte, NC, Atlanta, GA, Dallas, TX
description:
Transform Your Career

We deliver unparalleled opportunities for growth and career advancement. Our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture supports your journey every step of the way.

Embrace new challenges and deliver real value to some of the world’s most influential Fortune 100 brands, growth companies transforming their industries, and mid-market firms that need help navigating the defining moments of their lifecycle. Work side by side with business leaders to solve complex client challenges and make a true impact. Love what you do as part of a diverse organization committed to collaboration and continuous learning.

The CPM Team

Advise fast growing companies and well-known enterprises (both publicly traded and privately held) on a wide variety of transformational corporate performance management (CPM) projects leveraging market leading tools including OneStream XF. Team with leaders from across the organization to provide fully integrated services to support clients in the office of the CFO, CAO, and CIO.

You Are

You are a team-builder and problem-solver. You stay updated on new products and technologies. You know that collaboration is key, so you look for ways to share and source best practices. If there’s a new way to do something that improves outcomes for clients, you’ll find it.

Your Impact

  • As a Director, you will be responsible for leading OneStream engagements, working with finance leadership of commercial companies to execute on large, complex engagements that identify, design, and implement creative business and technology solutions.
  • Participate in strategic practice growth initiatives, including the development of service offerings, geographic expansion, industry specialization, recruitment, retention and development of team members.
  • Lead business development efforts across all stages (market analysis, client sourcing, relationship building, proposal development, oral presentations).
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with clients at all levels that are based on integrity and trust.
  • Contribute perspectives on the implications of market trends such as data and digital transformation, emerging technology, macro-economic trends, regulatory demands.
  • Facilitate client working sessions ranging from executive and board level meetings to large group presentations and requirements gathering exercises.
  • Leverage a “roll-up your sleeves” style to develop and execute against clients’ strategic initiatives.
  • Manage and coach project teams to deliver complex engagements.
  • Develop and manage the performance of junior team members through active coaching, feedback and mentorship.

At a minimum, you will have:

  • 8+ years of direct, full life cycle OneStream XF implementation experience (or 4 years of OneStream XF and 4 years of Oracle EPM experience).
  • Tier 1 or Tier 2 consulting experience.
  • Demonstrated track record achieving business development targets by growing existing accounts and penetrating new accounts.
  • Proven ability to generate $1M+ in revenue annually.
  • Relevant experience with accounting, finance, FP&A industry experience and/or experience automating the financial close or FP&A process.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Close Consolidation and planning process experience.
  • Strong knowledge of metadata concepts (i.e. Cubes, hierarchies, dimensions).
  • Strong understanding of data integration process.
  • Experience managing technical development by acting as a liaison between the technical team and the user community.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems (MIS), IT, or related field.
  • Flexibility to travel.

Preferably, you will have:

  • OneStream Certified Professional Lead Architect
  • CPA, MBA, PMP, CSM, or Six Sigma.
  • Ability to demonstrate the use of Workflow, Cube Views, Dashboards and Security.
  • Experience with Agile software development.
  • .NET and/or VBA experience.
  • Experience writing Excel macros.
  • Experience with MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with data integration tools.
  • Experience with data transformations, interfaces/integrations, reporting, and customizations.
  • Experience with FX conversions, intercompany eliminations, and allocations.

The Kind of Person Who Thrives in This Role:

We are not looking for someone who fits neatly into a single box. The ideal candidate is a “bridger”—someone who can move fluidly between a technical deep dive and an executive conversation. Specifically:

  • You’re a builder, not just an analyst. When you see a gap in a process or a tool, your instinct is to prototype something—a script, a template, a dashboard, not just write a slide about it.
  • You’re curious about “why” and “so what.” You don’t just want to understand how a transformer model works; you want to understand what that means for how organizations should govern and secure it.
  • You write well. A significant portion of this role involves producing written work—reports, frameworks, articles—and clarity of writing is non-negotiable.
  • You’re comfortable being the least experienced person in the room. You’ll be in meetings with CFOs, CAOs, CIOs, and senior partners. You need the confidence to contribute and the humility to learn.

What We Offer

  • Accelerated growth trajectory: You’ll be helping to build a practice alongside senior leadership.
  • Investment in your learning: Budget for certifications, training programs, and conference attendance.
  • Client diversity: Work across industries and with organizations at different stages of AI maturity—from Fortune 500 companies to mid-market firms navigating their first AI initiatives.

As part of the AEGIS leadership team, you will directly influence how NASA evolves to support missions on Earth, in space, and beyond.


POSITION SUMMARY:

Leidos is seeking an experienced, innovative, and highly technical individual to provide technical leadership to both NASA and Leidos stakeholders, shape long-term modernization initiatives, guide major service upgrades, and ensure enterprise services continually evolve to meet NASA’s mission needs. The ideal candidate is a trusted technical advisor, a strategic thinker, an energetic people leader, and a recognized subject matter expert with broad experience across enterprise IT domains. The Chief Engineer will continuously assess the operational and functional baseline of our managed systems and services. The role is responsible for leading the engineering team while contributing to the program governance structure to ensure adoption of new technologies and/or configurations align with the overall direction of the Agency. The Chief Engineer will be directly responsible for the development, management, delivery, and day-to-day maintenance of the technology roadmap to assist in improved forward schedule planning for enterprise services, which includes planning for the introduction of tools and services to support new and emerging technologies and requirements.


As Chief Engineer for AEGIS, you’ll help shape the future of NASA’s enterprise IT landscape. You’ll influence major modernization initiatives, collaborate with top technical leaders, and lead a large team to ensure NASA’s infrastructure is prepared to support evolving mission needs. This role offers the opportunity to drive significant impact across one of the most innovative and mission-driven IT environments in the world.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering across all AEGIS technologies including data centers, cloud, networking, VoIP, cybersecurity, and collaboration services.
  • Build strong relationships with senior NASA and Leidos leadership to ensure alignment with agency priorities.
  • Continuously assess enterprise system baselines and recommend improvements to support modernization.
  • Translate NASA OCIO and Office of Engineering objectives into actionable engineering priorities, plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure daily engineering work remains aligned with long term organizational goals.

People Leadership

  • Lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team supporting networking, firewalls, VoIP, data centers, and cloud services across NASA.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, learning, and technical excellence.
  • Mentor engineers at all levels on career growth, skills, and technical decision making.
  • Communicate clear expectations, provide timely feedback, and model strong leadership behaviors.
  • Promote collaboration across engineering, architecture, security, operations, and program leadership.
  • Cultivate accountability, transparency, and a strong customer service mindset.
  • Ensure actions have clear owners, due dates, and follow through, reducing tactical burden on the government Engineering Office.

Planning & Architecture

  • Perform systems analysis and planning to support NASA’s infrastructure strategy.
  • Develop feasibility studies, trend analyses, business cases, benchmarks, and strategic roadmaps.
  • Understand contract technical requirements and guide the team toward solutions meeting user needs and contract obligations.
  • Review emerging technologies and assess impacts on NASA architectures, standards, and long term service evolution.

Engineering & Integration

  • Lead design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and logistics activities.
  • Maintain visibility across engineering projects, initiatives, studies, modernization efforts, and operational work.
  • Provide leadership with clear views of status, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required decisions.
  • Assess infrastructure impacts of new requirements and NASA network expansions.
  • Operate network technology labs for asset management, testing, standards evaluation, requirements analysis, and technology investigation.
  • Recommend standards for implementing new services across NASA.
  • Ensure engineering coordination across networks, telecommunications, cable plant, data centers, cloud, cybersecurity, and voice/video.
  • Identify dependencies and prevent cross-domain engineering conflicts.

Governance & Policy

  • Support AEGIS program governance to ensure new technologies align with NASA’s direction.
  • Participate in NASA IT policy, architecture, standards, and process reviews; recommend updates to maintain AEGIS compliance.
  • Establish consistent engineering practices including design reviews, documentation, standards, configuration management, change control, peer reviews, and decision records.
  • Ensure engineering consistency across technical areas.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Advise the Program Manager on impacts to stability, cost, architecture, interoperability, or compatibility, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Implement structured methods for identifying, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving risks and issues.
  • Inform NASA and Leidos leadership early when risks may affect mission or service delivery.

Roadmaps & Long-Term Planning

  • Develop strategic and implementation plans guiding the future of AEGIS services.
  • Assess IT innovations, product releases, and technology changes to introduce new capabilities and retire outdated ones.
  • Support development of comprehensive technology roadmaps capturing customer requirements and service evolution.
  • Maintain the Five-Year Hardware Lifecycle Plan for AEGIS-supported hardware.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Maintain strong connections with the Leidos Digital Sector CTO and Solutions Architect organizations to leverage enterprise expertise.
  • Support program growth by shaping innovative technical solutions and recommending improvements to services and operating models.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of prior relevant experience.
  • At least 7 years of experience managing a large engineering team as part of an IT organization.
  • Strong leadership abilities; detail-oriented; effective under deadlines.
  • Excellent analytical skills.
  • Strong budgeting and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated experience in strategic planning.
  • Demonstrated success building relationships with customers and teammates.
  • Experience executing development programs in an agile environment.
  • Experience developing Estimates to Complete/Estimates at Completion (ETC/EAC).
  • Ability to effectively communicate when briefing Leidos and NASA senior leadership.
  • Technical knowledge across one or more of the following technologies:
    • Network Solutions (e.g., LAN, WAN, SDA, SD-WAN)
    • Data Center Technologies (e.g., Virtualization, Capacity Management, Data Backup)
    • Cloud-based Architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
    • Collaboration Services (e.g., Conferencing, VoIP)



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • ITIL Certification.
  • SAFe® Agile Product Manager or Lean Portfolio Manager.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP)® Certification.
  • Experience working with NASA or other federal agencies.



CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance ranging from a Public Trust, at minimum, up to a Top Secret clearance, as required.

title: Civil Underground Structures Engineer
description:
Civil Engineer, Underground Structures

At Aurecon, we are optimistic about the future. We are thinkers, solvers, and collaborators who work with our clients to deliver the infrastructure and assets that strengthen communities and create a sustainable future.


The NSW & ACT Underground Structures team is a leader in the design of underground structures and soil-structure interaction analysis, including cut and cover tunnels, retaining walls, foundations and other civil structures in the NSW & ACT market. With a growing pipeline of work across a range of different projects and sectors, we are seeking a Civil / Structural Engineer, Underground Structures (5-7 years’ experience) to join our Underground Structures team.

The role offers an exciting opportunity for career progression within a dynamic and vibrant team to deliver sustainable outcomes and technical excellence for key clients. With a focus on underground structures design, this role spans both geotechnical and structural engineering—making it an ideal fit whether you already work across both disciplines or bring deep expertise in one area and a strong appetite to learn the other.

What are we looking for from you?

- The preferred candidate will have a relevant tertiary qualification in Civil or Structural Engineering with around 5-7 years’ experience and a background in the structural and / or geotechnical design of underground / civil structures.

- Your career to date will have included:

- Relevant experience in the design and documentation of retaining structures, deep shafts, cut and cover tunnels and/or reinforced soil and rock construction.

- Working knowledge of Australian Standards, TfNSW specifications and structural and/or geotechnical analysis software

- Experience in successfully working in a consultancy setting as part of project teams with both internal and external clients. Experience in transport work sectors preferred

- Interest in further developing existing skills in both structural and geotechnical engineering

- Be an Australian Citizen and eligible for security clearance (AGSVA requirements apply)

If you are technically focused with a flair for working with others and a desire to continue to develop your skillset amongst a world-class peer group, then we would like to hear from you.

How we support your growth

We believe your career should be a rewarding adventure. You will tackle some of the world’s most complex infrastructure challenges, in an environment that supports your ambitions, where we hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standards. Recognised by the AFR as a Best Place to Work in 2026, we embrace diverse perspectives, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact.


Who we are

We are an engineering consultancy with more than 6,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and Asia. We believe the world needs people who can engineer possibilities; people who can create infrastructure that makes life better for people and the planet. That is why we are here – to bring ideas to life, the Aurecon way.


Ready for your next adventure?

If this sounds like your next step, we’d love to hear from you. We value diverse experiences and welcome applications for part-time or flexible working arrangements. For recruitment adjustments, contact WorkplaceAdjustment@aurecongroup.com.

Our hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We’re most interested in your individual thinking and experiences—so please ensure your application reflects your authentic perspective

title: Digital Thread Test Lead
description:
The Digital Thread Systems team, within our Chief Information Office (CIO) and reporting through the Digital sector, is seeking a Test Lead to help scale Leidos manufacturing for the future by modernizing the systems, integrations, and infrastructure that connect product development to product realization. Our team enables the digital thread that moves critical product and manufacturing information across engineering, planning, and production – helping teams turn product designs into producible, deliverable solutions.

In this role you will provide enterprise-level test leadership across the systems and integrations that enable the digital thread, including PLM, MES, ERP, enterprise integrations, and reporting capabilities. This role owns the end-to-end testing strategy and lifecycle across concurrent technology initiatives, ensuring system functionality, integration integrity, quality, and readiness for production release. You will establish testing standards, coordinate multidisciplinary test teams and stakeholders, and provide clear assessments of release readiness and risk. The role also drives continuous improvement of testing methodologies, tools, automation, and emerging capabilities such as artificial intelligence.


Location: This position allows for full-time telework from any U.S. based location.


Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship is required.


Primary Responsibilities


Test Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test strategies, plans, procedures, schedules, and success criteria across digital thread initiatives.
  • Define test scope and approaches for component, system, integration, regression, smoke, and user acceptance testing.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into traceable test cases and acceptance criteria.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise testing standards, processes, templates, and governance.
  • Coordinate with project, functional, technical, infrastructure, cybersecurity, supplier, and business teams to ensure test readiness.

Test Execution & Release Readiness

  • Lead and coordinate testing across PLM, MES, ERP, integration, reporting, and related digital thread capabilities.
  • Oversee test execution and ensure adherence to approved plans, procedures, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate tester assignments, responsibilities, access, environments, test data, and prerequisite activities.
  • Manage defect identification, documentation, prioritization, retesting, and closure in coordination with technical and functional teams.
  • Assess test results, unresolved defects, and associated risks to provide recommendations regarding release readiness.
  • Ensure test evidence and results are complete, accurate, traceable, and appropriately retained.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Develop and present test status, results, risks, defects, and readiness assessments to program leadership and stakeholders.
  • Communicate complex technical findings effectively to technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Conduct post-test reviews, debriefs, and lessons-learned activities.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze testing results and defect trends to identify systemic issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Refine testing methodologies, processes, tools, metrics, and automation based on lessons learned and industry practices.
  • Evaluate and support responsible integration of artificial intelligence and automation into testing processes.

Basic Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline with 12–15 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree with 10–13 years of relevant experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree where permitted by the applicable job profile.
  • Significant experience developing and executing test strategies and test plans for complex enterprise applications or integrated systems.
  • Experience leading system, integration, regression, user acceptance, and release-readiness testing.
  • Demonstrated experience managing requirements-to-test traceability, defects, test evidence, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience coordinating testing across multidisciplinary technical, functional, supplier, and business teams.
  • Ability to analyze complex system behavior, integration dependencies, and defects spanning multiple applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical risks, results, and recommendations to senior and executive leadership.
  • Experience leading technical work across multiple concurrent projects or programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), ERP, or integrated manufacturing and engineering systems.
  • Experience with iBase-t Solumina MES, PTC Windchill PLM, Deltek Costpoint ERP, eQube-MI, or eQube-BI.
  • Experience validating end-to-end transactions and data flows across PLM, MES, ERP, and middleware platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server, Oracle, SQL querying, relational databases, and enterprise data structures.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, test management platforms, and requirements management tools.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence or intelligent automation to software testing and quality assurance.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, regulated manufacturing, or other mission-critical environments.

title: Quality Technician, Receiving & Inspection
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Your Role

A Quality Technician in the Receiving and Inspection (R&I) Department performs daily inspections of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), excipients, film, and various packaging materials to ensure the materials being received are produced in accordance with company methodology, procedures, and standards. R&I Quality Technicians are also responsible for documentation review to ensure compliance with material specifications.

  • Completes sampling and inspection of all printed direction inserts, Labels, Cartons, and other various packaging materials used in Round Lake Drug Delivery.

  • Releases materials for production after quality inspections and/or tests are completed and acceptable.

  • Uses small hand tools and various measuring and testing devices in performing quality tests.

  • Strong computer/software literacy, preferred experience with material inventory management systems.

  • Completes data entries in GME and Labvantage for materials.

  • Completes required weekly cleaning in the Non-Cephalosporin clean room.

  • Packages samples to be sent to external testing labs.

  • Flexible schedule with the ability to work overtime as needed to meet the production schedule.

title: Offensive Cyberspace Operational Planner, Journeyman
description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?


At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. The Leidos Intelligence Sector combines technology-enabled services and mission software capabilities in the areas of cyber, logistics, security operations, and decision analytics to support our defense and intel customers’ mission to defend against evolving threats around the world.


Your greatest work is ahead!


The Intelligence Sector seeks highly qualified and trained Journeyman-level Offensive Cyberspace Operational Planners to support Department of Defense Joint Planning processes that underpin United States Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM) operations, with focus on supporting power projection in and through cyberspace in support of Combatant Commander and National objectives. Individuals will engage in Cyberspace Operational Planning activities supporting Leidos on-site contract support to USCYBERCOM J3 (Operations), Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF), and Joint Task Force-Ares (JTF-ARES).


This posting is for multiple opportunities ranging in years of experience. Level of opportunity including compensation, will be match to the candidate's experience.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Engage in approved plans development and staffing processes within collaborative environment to enable range of Cyberspace Operations (CO) according to USCYBERCOM planning guidance and applicable Joint publications.
  • Develop and synchronize Offensive Cyberspace Operational (OCO) plans to deliver integrated cyber effects against adversary systems in support of Joint and National strategic objectives.
  • Support targeting selection, validation, synchronization, and enable integration during the execution of activities within Cyber Warfare domain
  • Draft and staff foundational planning documents such as Operational Plans (OPLANS), Operational Orders (OPORDs), and Fragmentary Orders (FRAGOs).
  • Support Joint Operational Planning Groups and Teams (OPG/OPT), and develop and integrate Cyberspace capabilities into plans.
  • Develop concepts of support, courses of action, integrate command and external capabilities, coordinate and document comprehensive plans.
  • Engage in, and provide situational awareness to, range of projects, Crisis Action Teams, and current operations activities supporting OPTs.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of cyber threats and attack methods and techniques emanating from state and non-state adversaries and tiered vulnerabilities within Blue Space as focus of threats.
  • Review, approve, prioritize, and submit operational requirements for research, development, and/or acquisition of cyber capabilities.
  • Analyze and assess internal and external partner CO capabilities and tools.
  • Transition operational planning efforts to current operations.
  • Navigate organizational structure as it pertains to full spectrum CO, including the functions, responsibilities, and interrelationships among distinct internal elements.
  • Integrate and synchronize intelligence planning activities with operational planning timelines.
  • Conduct long-range, strategic planning efforts with internal and external partners in cyber activities.
  • Communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and Polygraph, at the time of Application, to be considered for this position.
  • BA/BS degree within Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or relevant field of study.
  • 4 plus years recent (since 2018) work experience as CO Planner; can waive two years of experience requirement for every year spent on a Combat Mission Team (CMT) in any work role.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with OCO concepts, capabilities, and authorities (Title 10 vs. Title 50, and familiarity with military operations including phases of planning, approval, and execution.
  • Intimate familiarity with applicable Joint Publications.
  • Formal training as Cyber Operational Planner within Department of Defense or Intelligence Community.
  • Broad knowledge of Blue-space Cyber capabilities and demonstrate understanding of available Cyber infrastructure or platforms to conduct OCO.
  • Knowledge of the range of CO and their underlying intelligence support needs, topics, and focus areas.
  • Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as well as concepts, terminology, and operations of a wide range of communications media (computer and telephone networks, satellite, fiber, wireless).
  • Ability to support timely, accurate, relevant analytical production, to include documents, summaries, issue papers, talking points, and briefings.
  • Demonstrated proficiency working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, ability to proactively multi-task and meet short deadlines.
  • Able to work across Department of Defense and Intelligence Community agencies to support organizational goals.

Favorable if you have:

  • Masters’ Degree within Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or relevant field of study.
  • Familiarity with USCYBERCOM organizational structure and mission.
  • Prior experience supporting Joint operations across multiple warfighting domains.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning into operations at any level to increase efficiency and effectiveness of operational outcomes.
  • Experience with Space-enabled CO.
  • Joint Professional Military Education, Phase II (JPME II) graduate, or civilian equivalency.
  • Formal training within field of Cyber Warfare and Joint Operations.
  • Completion of Service-specific or Joint Cyberspace Operational Planning courses, such as Army Cyberspace Operations Planners Course or Joint Cyberspace Operations Planners Course.
  • Familiar with art of Data Science and applicability to CO.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Power BI data visualization software.
  • Desired Certifications: DoD 8570 IAT Level II (CCNA Security, COMPTIA CySA+, COMPTIA Security + CE, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP).

title: Senior Buyer / Planner
description:
About the role

The Senior Buyer / Planner is responsible for leading the efficient execution of approved supply plans, ensuring supplier performance, inventory health, and on-time product availability in support of business objectives. This role owns procurement execution, supplier management, and supply feasibility, translating the approved demand plan into actionable and reliable supply outcomes.

This position partners closely with Demand Planning, Operations, Finance, and external manufacturing partners to validate capacity, manage inventory targets, mitigate risk, and resolve supply constraints. The role is accountable for cost control, operational execution, supplier performance, and continuous improvement across procurement and supply execution processes.

The Senior Buyer / Planner leads a team responsible for purchase order management, supplier escalation, and supply tracking, ensuring the business can meet service level expectations while minimizing excess, obsolescence, and operational risk.

What you'll do

• Manage and maintain favorable relationships with suppliers, vendors, and other business partners; ensuring performance metrics, service levels, cost targets, and contractual commitments are met.

• Partner with Demand Planning to confirm supply feasibility against the approved demand plan, including capacity, lead times, and inventory implications.

• Serve as the feasibility gatekeeper for supplier execution during Stage Gate and product launch cycles, validating manufacturing capability, capacity, lead times, and inventory readiness to protect on-time delivery and reduce execution risk.

• Support the onboarding and ongoing management of qualified suppliers and manufacturing partners; partner with Quality on supplier quality management and compliance.

• Own supply planning, inventory strategy, and procurement execution based on the approved S&OP output.

• Translate approved demand into executable purchase plans, ensuring alignment with supplier capabilities and inventory targets.

• Optimize inventory levels to balance service levels, minimize carrying costs, and mitigate excess or obsolete inventory risk; lead cross-functional execution to reduce E&O.

• Act as the primary escalation point for supplier performance, production delays, and supply constraints.

• Represent the Supply Chain function in cross-functional initiatives, providing supply execution insights and feasibility-based recommendations.

• Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement and automation within procurement and supply execution workflows.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree

• 5+ years of experience in the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Manufacturing Operations

• Demonstrated experience managing suppliers, purchase execution, and inventory planning in a complex, fast-paced environment

• Strong analytical capability with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data analysis or ERP tools

• Proven ability to build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing and supplier partners

• Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and execution risks simultaneously

• Strong problem-solving skills with a track record of resolving supplier, capacity, and execution related challenges

• Clear and effective communication skills with the ability to present fact-based, execution-focused recommendations

title: Deputy Program Manager, NASA AEGIS Program
description:
The Digital Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Deputy Program Manager to help provide program leadership to NASA to support a complex set of enterprise IT services, including network infrastructure, data center operations, cloud computing and cybersecurity. In this position you will serve as a direct report to the Program Manager within Leidos for the NASA AEGIS Program. The Deputy Program Manager will be responsible for assisting the Program Manager with achieving financial, service delivery, customer satisfaction, and growth objectives. The position can be located onsite at any NASA Center. The AEGIS program is NASA’s largest IT infrastructure services contract, supporting enterprise IT and mission systems across data centers, cloud platforms, networks, collaboration tools, voice over IP, and cybersecurity. As part of the AEGIS leadership team, you will directly influence how NASA evolves to support missions on Earth, in space, and beyond.


POSITION SUMMARY:

The ideal candidate is a trusted technical advisor, a strategic thinker, an energetic people leader, and a recognized subject matter expert with broad experience across enterprise IT domains. The Deputy Program Manager must be able to create and maintain a collaborative work environment; set goals; give clear direction to the team and provide decisive and constructive feedback; empower individuals to take ownership for their assignments; facilitate identification and capture of funded program growth; and demonstrate and insist on ethical and professional behavior in accordance with company values. This person will help manage a complex IT service delivery program involving multiple tasks, multiple customer organizations, and complex responsibilities.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

title: Director, Program Management, Oncology
description:
The Role:

The Program Management team at Moderna is responsible for the management of the clinical-stage programs from lead nomination to licensure and life cycle management. Moderna is seeking a motivated and energetic Director, Program Management to drive the program teams forward in the development of novel mRNA medicines within the Moderna Oncology Portfolio. The successful candidate will work in close coordination with the Program Leader and the cross-functional Program Team to enable the execution of the program strategy. Each program manager may be assigned 1-3 programs depending on the phase of development. The successful program manager will have program management experience across multiple phases of pre-clinical and clinical development, preferably in Oncology.

Here’s What You’ll Do:

  • Partnering with the program leader to shape program strategy and execution plan.

  • Collaborating with functional leads to define program strategy and proactively identify and escalate gaps and challenges; Managing team through scenario planning to solve problems.

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders (team members and leadership) to ensure alignment of functional and corporate objectives; Leveraging organizational dynamics to promote program goals.

  • Coordinating team efforts to develop impactful presentations to summarize complex topics into critical points to facilitate strategic planning and decision-making; Communicating program status, risks, and decision enabling materials to governance bodies and executive leadership meetings.

  • Developing and tracking activities against program timelines and budget.

  • Administering the day-to-day activities, including facilitating cross-functional team meetings, leading discussions to drive decision-making, preparing agenda and meeting minutes, and defining and resolving action items.

  • Working with the Finance group to implement and track the program budget.

  • Contributing to Program Management initiatives to support the development and scaling of capabilities, tools, and processes.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table:

  • BS degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 10 years of experience or MS degree in a scientific field with at least 8 years of experience in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical setting.

  • Proven track record of successful project management experience in drug development (preferably in Oncology) across multiple phases (pre-clinical and clinical Phase 1-3).

  • Prior experience managing or working within cross-functional project teams with timeline management and budgetary responsibility.

  • Strong knowledge of project management tools and software (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, and timeline visualization software).

  • Must be adept at working in a fluid environment and foster a strong collaborative spirit internally and externally.

  • Strong personal skills to influence without authority, motivate others and manage conflict.

  • Strong written and oral communication skills as well as demonstrated organizational aptitude.

  • Preferred: Project/program management training.

  • Preferred: Ph.D. or PharmD

Our Working Model

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.


Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $167,000.00 - $300,700.00. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.

We’re focused on attracting, retaining, developing, and advancing our employees. By cultivating a workplace that values diverse experiences, backgrounds, and ideas, we create an environment where every employee can contribute their best.

title: Mechanical Assembler
description:
Meet CFS Technologies
Ready to Join the Hygiene Revolution?

CFS Technologies is a family of industry-leading brands dedicated to advancing hygiene, safety, and operational efficiency across a wide range of industries. Through our brands, Lafferty, Knight, and Meritech, we provide innovative dispensing, application, and hand hygiene solutions trusted by customers around the world.

For decades, CFS Technologies has partnered with organizations across foodservice, hospitality, healthcare, industrial, and commercial markets to deliver reliable, high-performing solutions that improve sanitation processes, optimize operations, and support healthier environments.

We are looking for a hands-on individual to join our team as a Mechanical Assembler. In this role, you’ll work with our Production, Quality, and Engineering teams to assemble, test, and finish our automated hygiene systems while ensuring the highest level of quality and craftsmanship.

Who You Are
This role would be a great fit if you enjoy:

  • Enjoy electrical, plumbing, or mechanical assembly.
  • Working with your hands and building things.
  • Tinkering or learning how mechanical systems work.
  • Using hand tools for mechanical, electrical, or plumbing assembly.
  • Working as part of a team in a hands-on environment.
  • Taking pride in quality and attention to detail.

What We Offer You
As a CFS Tech employee, you'll receive:

  • $19.00/hour starting base rate plus monthly bonus program.
  • A comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, and 401(k) with company match.
  • 3 weeks annually of paid-time-off and sick leave accrual, with increases based on tenure.
  • Paid company holidays.

Job Description:
Job requirements:
  • Assemble, test, and finish automated hygiene systems and components according to established specifications and quality standards.
  • Read and follow assembly instructions, drawings, and basic schematics.
  • Use hand and power tools to complete assigned assembly tasks.
  • Test completed systems to ensure proper function and quality.
  • Work closely with Production, Quality, and Engineering to resolve issues and maintain product standards.
  • Maintain an organized, clean, and safe work area.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and manufacturing best practices.

Job Requirements
We're looking for someone who is:
  • Experienced in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or manufacturing assembly; experience is preferred but not required.
  • Comfortable using hand tools such as drills, wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, wire strippers, crimpers, ratchets, and channel locks.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and consistency.
  • Able to follow written instructions, drawings, and basic schematics.
  • A team player who can also work independently.
  • Reliable, organized, and able to meet production expectations.
  • Able to regularly perform the following physical requirements, with or without accommodation:
    • Frequently: Prolonged periods of standing and walking around a manufacturing shop.
    • Frequently: Prolonged periods of standing and sitting while performing repetitive tasks.

    • Frequently: Stretch, squat, and reach to assemble equipment.
    • Frequently: Bend, lean, crouch, sit, and kneel to assemble equipment.
    • Frequently: Carry, lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds at a time.

title: Merchant
description:

Responsible for establishing merchandising objectives for a category or categories of merchandise. Drive the financial planning process and manage the process from recommending targets to pricing optimization. Drive the assortment planning process, from business performance review to supplier negotiations. Create operational plans used in SOAR execution. Oversee the supplier management strategy and works to source and rationalize suppliers to meet business needs. Responsible for approximately $350 million in business dollars.

  • Makes key decisions and manages supplier strategy (e.g. import vs. domestic, national vs. proprietary). Reviews the supplier portfolio on a ongoing basis to ensure suppliers maintain the bandwidth to support changing needs. Works with key functions to source new suppliers.

Nature and Scope

  • Solutions require analysis and investigation.
  • Achieves planned results by decisions and actions based on professional methods, business principles, and practical experience. May recommend/make decisions regarding new programs/initiatives that have significant impact to the business and carry consequences in unsuccessful endeavors.
  • Manages a larger team or multiple small teams through direction of subordinate management and/or supervisory staff.

Work Environment

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Education and Experience

title: Buyer
description:
Leidos Security Enterprise Solutions (SES) currently has an opening for a Buyer to join our Supply Chain team in Ladson, South Carolina. This is an opportunity to support a fast-paced manufacturing environment responsible for delivering advanced security detection and automation solutions to customers around the world.

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing and procuring materials, components, equipment, and services in support of manufacturing, engineering, and program requirements. This position will work closely with suppliers and internal partners across Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure materials are available to support production schedules and customer commitments.

The successful candidate will have experience in purchasing or supply chain, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while building effective relationships with suppliers and internal customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage procurement activities for materials, components, equipment, and services supporting manufacturing and program requirements.
  • Prepare and issue purchase orders in response to MRP-generated demand and other business requirements.
  • Develop and negotiate favorable pricing, delivery schedules, terms, and other commercial conditions consistent with business requirements and procurement policies.
  • Create and manage supplier solicitations and requests for quotation (RFQs).
  • Evaluate supplier quotations and proposals and make supplier recommendations based on price, quality, delivery, capability, and overall value.
  • Perform price and cost analysis to support procurement decisions and negotiations.
  • Work directly with suppliers to resolve pricing, delivery, quality, and other performance issues.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and proactively address potential material shortages or schedule risks.
  • Maintain accurate procurement documentation and purchase order files in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Support purchase order administration, modifications, file maintenance, and closeout activities.
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with suppliers and internal customers.
  • Partner with Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and other Supply Chain functions to support production schedules and changing business priorities.
  • Support proposal activities by obtaining supplier quotations, pricing, lead times, and other required information.
  • Manage procurements of moderate complexity and risk, escalating more complex contractual or supplier issues as appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, supplier performance, cost, and operational efficiency.
  • Support additional procurement and supply chain activities as business needs require.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of relevant purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience.
  • Experience working with MRP/ERP systems in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Experience creating and managing purchase orders and working directly with suppliers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated customer-service mindset and ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify issues, work through problems, and follow through to resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting procurement within an aerospace, aviation, defense, security, or advanced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint, SAP, or similar ERP systems.
  • Experience negotiating supplier pricing, delivery schedules, and terms and conditions.
  • Experience conducting price or cost analysis.
  • Familiarity with engineering drawings, Bills of Material (BOMs), specifications, and other technical documentation.
  • Knowledge of government contracting and procurement requirements.
  • Experience supporting production environments with changing material requirements and delivery priorities.

title: Product Development Process Intern (Graduate Level) (Summer 2027)
description:

GPDO drives operational excellence by reducing cycle time, improving quality, increasing process visibility, and enabling the successful delivery of products across the enterprise.

The Product Development Process Intern will support initiatives focused on process improvement, operational excellence, and the application of AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and accelerate product development activities across the organization.

title: Cyber Security Watch Officer
description:
Leidos' Digital Modernization sector is seeking a Cyber Security Watch Officer (CSWO) to join the GSM-O effort at the Pentagon.


Applicants must have a minimum Secret clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and must be available for shift work (including weekends), which may vary based on program needs and manning levels. We support 24/7 operations and while shift assignments are usually static, they are based on both preference and contract requirements, so we ask our team members to remain flexible to potential shift modifications to meet minimum staffing requirements. All new hires will spend a brief ramp-up period on weekday day shift to start.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support the Joint Network Operation and Support Center (JNOSC) Battle Captain and Cyber Center Security Chief with all cyber defense and network assurance issues.
  • Oversee all network defense operations, and be familiar with the operations process flow and execution.
  • Maintain awareness of all pertinent directives, orders, alerts, and messages; prepare and deliver daily situational awareness and operational update briefings.
  • Serve as Defensive Cybersecurity SME during 24x7 operations.

Required Clearance and Certifications:

  • Must have, at minimum, an active DoD Secret security clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI (active TS/SCI preferred)
  • Must have DoD 8570 IAT II or higher certification (Security+ CE or equivalent) prior to start.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of professional experience; additional military or relevant work experience may be considered lieu of a degree.
  • CND experience (Protect, Detect, Respond and Sustain) within a Computer Incident Response organization.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the life cycle of network threats, attacks, attack vectors and methods of exploitation with an understanding of intelligence driven defense and/or Cyber Kill Chain methodology.
  • Experience in a 24x7 environment.

About our Program:
Through the J6 Penetration Handling, Incident, System Health (PHISH) support services task order on the GSM-O contract, we provide IT products, services and solutions to the Pentagon and other DoD offices and agencies for them to meet mission and business requirements. Our CSWOs are principally engaged in the triage of events, cyber incident handling, network analysis and threat detection, trend analysis, metric development, vulnerability information dissemination, and the DoD Cyber Security Service Provider (CSSP) methodology.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Ignite your curiosity. Solve the unsolvable. At Leidos, we do more than write code—we decode the unknown. Our San Diego-based research and engineering team takes on some of the nation’s toughest defense challenges using advanced signal processing, ocean remote sensing, and high-performance computing. We’re seeking a Software Engineer / Computer Scientist who enjoys solving complex problems and pushing the limits of performance. In this role, you’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers with expertise in hydrodynamics, physics, acoustics, and signal processing to build impactful software that turns massive, complex data sets into meaningful insight. title: Technical Deputy Program Manager
description:
The Undersea Systems Division at Leidos currently has an opening for a Technical Deputy Program Manager to support a customer site in San Diego, California. This is an exciting opportunity to apply systems engineering, naval operations, test and evaluation, and technical project-management experience in support of large-scale fleet activities and critical maritime missions.


The selected candidate will serve as the onsite Technical Deputy Program Manager and senior technical representative, working closely with the Leidos Project Manager, customer leadership, engineers, fleet personnel, operational stakeholders, and government representatives. The position will support day-to-day onsite execution of program activities while also contributing directly to systems engineering, integration, test, and evaluation efforts.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the onsite senior technical representative for Leidos at the customer site in San Diego.
  • Work side by side with customer leadership and technical personnel to support day-to-day program execution and mission priorities.
  • Support the Leidos Project Manager with program planning, execution, customer coordination, schedule management, risk management, and delivery of program commitments.
  • Lead and coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder organizations.
  • Translate customer operational needs into technically sound engineering approaches, priorities, requirements, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with engineers, subcontractors, fleet personnel, operators, government stakeholders, and program leadership to resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Track technical scope, milestones, schedules, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Maintain project-management artifacts, including project plans, schedules, milestone trackers, risk and issue registers, action-item logs, and status reports.
  • Identify schedule, resource, technical, interface, cost, or performance concerns and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Facilitate technical interchange meetings, program reviews, working groups, integrated product team meetings, and customer engagements.
  • Guide engineering teams in systems architecture, requirements analysis, systems integration, interface definition, verification and validation, and technical documentation.
  • Review engineering products and ensure technical deliverables are accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with customer and program requirements.
  • Support development and review of engineering analyses, technical assessments, system requirements, design documentation, integration plans, and program deliverables.
  • Support test and evaluation planning, assessment, and reporting activities as needed; extensive at-sea testing is not expected to be the primary responsibility.
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, program-status updates, decision presentations, risk updates, and recommendations to senior military and government leadership.
  • Analyze technical and operational information to identify deficiencies, risks, limitations, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate responses to customer requests and ensure follow-up actions are completed on schedule.
  • Support program planning, resource coordination, subcontractor or partner coordination, and preparation of technical inputs for contract deliverables.
  • Provide technical and program leadership during periods of increased operational activity or surge support.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagements, program activities, fleet events, and occasional demonstrations or assessments.
  • Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from engineers and operators to senior military and government leaders.
  • Support other systems engineering, technical leadership, and Deputy Project Manager activities as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, naval architecture, mechanical engineering, ocean engineering, electrical engineering, project management, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, naval engineering, maritime operations, fleet support, technical leadership, program management, or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex maritime, naval, shipboard, submarine, underwater, or other defense systems.
  • Experience working directly with customer, government, military, engineering, or operational stakeholders to address technical requirements and mission needs.
  • Experience leading or coordinating engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines or organizations.
  • Experience supporting program execution, including schedule management, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, stakeholder coordination, and status reporting.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or managing technical documentation, engineering analyses, requirements, system designs, integration products, or program deliverables.
  • Experience analyzing technical or operational information and communicating recommendations through written products, briefings, status reports, and presentations.
  • Experience facilitating technical meetings, program reviews, working groups, or customer engagements.

title: Construction Materials Testing (CMT) Field Technician (Experienced)
description:
Braun Intertec is seeking an Experienced Construction Materials Testing (CMT) Technician to join our Urbandale office. As a technician, you will perform a variety of testing on construction materials such as soils, concrete, masonry, and asphalt. Onsite materials testing is conducted on various industrial, commercial and transportation construction projects located throughout the region.

As a technician, you will receive in-depth technical training and industry certifications upon successful completion of examinations and demonstration of ability.   • A strong safety focus and attention to detail
  • Excellent plan reading skills
  • A demonstrated math and technical aptitude
  • Flexibility to work extended or nontraditional hours as needed
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • State DOT certifications, and/or NICET certifications
  • ICC Concrete and Soils Certification preferred or must be willing to get within 90 days of hire.
  • ACI Concrete Field-Testing Certification Required.
  • 1+ years of construction materials testing experience
  • A High School diploma or equivalent

  • The ability to lift 75+ pounds

  • Ability to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl

title: Sr. State Tax Analyst role
description:
We are actively seeking a Senior State Tax Analyst to join our Tax team at Masco World Headquarters in Livonia, MI. In this role, you will support Masco’s state income and franchise tax compliance process, analyze diverse business activities for proper state tax treatment, and assist with research, reporting, and process improvements across multiple jurisdictions.


Summary


Are you looking to build your accounting experience while developing specialized knowledge in state and local tax? Masco’s broad business portfolio provides meaningful complexity and opportunities to continue learning and growing. The Senior State Tax Analyst will be actively involved in various aspects of state income tax including compliance, tax accounting support, technical research, and collaboration with business units and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong tax technical skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, technology-enabled environment.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare state income and franchise tax returns including collecting, analyzing, and organizing data needed for state filings.
  • Prepare and review state tax workpapers including state modifications, apportionment calculations, estimated tax payments, extensions, and supporting schedules.
  • Process state tax estimates, extensions, returns, and related tax payments.
  • Support the state tax accounting process by assisting with state tax provision calculations, deferred tax schedules, and related documentation.
  • Gain an understanding of Masco’s state tax compliance process, including the state-specific modifications and updating our IT systems.
  • Research and analyze state tax laws, regulations, and administrative guidance to support compliance, tax planning initiatives, audit responses, and business transactions.
  • Assist with state tax notice responses, audit support, and information requests from taxing authorities.
  • Utilize tax compliance software, data analytics tools, and internal reporting systems to prepare filings, perform analyses, and improve reporting accuracy.
  • Participate in state tax planning analyses related to mergers and acquisitions, business restructurings, tax credits and incentives, legislative changes, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Assist in researching technical issues, evaluating potential state tax impacts, preparing financial models, and developing recommendations for management.
  • Coordinate with business units and internal teams to gather information needed for state tax compliance, sales and use tax support, reporting, audits, and projects.
  • Support special projects and provide assistance in other areas of the Tax department during peak reporting and compliance periods.
  • Identify and implement process improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency, strengthen internal controls, improve documentation, and streamline compliance workflows.

Essential Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum four years of experience in state income tax compliance and tax accounting or related field.
  • Minimum two years of experience in corporate tax income.
  • Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, including effective prioritization of tasks, strong multi-tasking abilities, a high level of attention to detail, and the ability to work optimally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (primarily Word and Excel).
  • Works well independently, as well as part of a team, encouraging collaboration.

title: Gastheer/Gastvrouw Parttime
description:
Ben jij die vriendelijke, behulpzame en betrokken gastvrouw / gastheer die graag de leden verwelkomt? Heb jij oog voor service en gastvrijheid, en vind je het belangrijk om de club netjes opgeruimd en schoon te houden voor onze leden? Dan is de rol van Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij onze Basic-Fit club in Hoogezand perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Wij zoeken iemand voor deze leuke parttime baan voor 22 uur per week. Spreekt dit jou aan? Lees snel verder!


Dit bieden wij


Werken als Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij Basic-Fit betekent:

• Een bruto startsalaris van €15,17 per uur (vanaf 21 jaar). Ben je geen 21 jaar, dan gelden er aangepaste tarieven: €11,82 per uur (20 jaar), €9,11 per uur (19 jaar), €7,59 per uur (16-18 jaar);

• Vakantietoeslag van 8%;

• Een persoonlijke pensioentoeslag;

• 23 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van 40 uur);

• Reiskostenvergoeding (0,25 cent per km, van 1 tot max. 35 km afstand woon,-werkverkeer);

• Feestdagentoeslag van 50%.

De voordelen van werken bij Basic-Fit


• Bij Basic-Fit geloven we in jouw potentieel. Groei mee met ons mee als internationaal bedrijf en grijp de kans om door te groeien binnen onze organisatie. Je hebt onbeperkt toegang tot alle online trainingen van GoodHabitz.

• Je wordt onderdeel van de Orange Community waar diversiteit gevierd wordt en waar je jezelf mag zijn. Met de Orange Connect App ben je altijd verbonden en up-to-date.

• Wat is er beter dan werken in een omgeving waar gezondheid en fitness voorop staan? Maak gebruik van de mogelijkheid om zelf te sporten en ervaar de energieke en positieve werksfeer.

Zo ziet jouw functie eruit


Iedereen met veel plezier naar de club laten terugkomen, daar doe je het voor! Als Gastvrouw / Gastheer ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt van de club. Met een oprechte glimlach verwelkom je de leden en beantwoord je hun vragen. Je bent actief aanwezig op de werkvloer, stapt op de leden af, maakt een praatje en biedt met veel enthousiasme onze producten aan. Nieuwe leden geef je een rondleiding, adviseer je over onze lidmaatschappen en help je met hun inschrijving. Daarnaast zorg jij ervoor dat onze club tiptop in orde is: als jij er bent, zijn er geen rondslingerende gewichten of rommelige kleedkamers te bekennen. Hoewel je regelmatig jouw diensten alleen draait, werk je als team actief samen aan het resultaat van de club.


Wie zoeken wij?


Als enthousiaste Gastvrouw / Gastheer van Basic-Fit heb je:

• Een gastvrije, servicegerichte en energieke instelling;

• Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel voor het schoon en netjes houden van de club;

• Affiniteit met sport en fitness. Ook ben je:

• Beschikbaar: het werken op onregelmatige tijden, zoals avonden en weekenden, vormt voor jou geen enkel probleem. De diensten die op de club worden gedraaid zijn: ma t/m vrij van 08:30 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 21:00 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 14:00 uur;

• Flexibel: je bent in staat om snel te schakelen bij veranderingen en invallen op nabijgelegen clubs zie je als een uitdaging;

• Zelfstandig: je motiveert jezelf en anderen, ziet het werk liggen en pakt dit snel op;

• Behulpzaam: met een enthousiaste houding sta je altijd klaar voor onze leden.

Over Basic-Fit


Basic-Fit is een dynamisch en sterk groeiende organisatie met een duidelijke missie. Inmiddels zijn wij de grootste fitness keten van Europa. Buiten Nederland hebben we clubs in België, Duitsland, Luxemburg, Frankrijk en Spanje. Ons doel is om de komende jaren verder te professionaliseren en door te groeien. Mede dankzij jouw inzet kunnen we onze groei realiseren en dat geeft weer nieuwe mogelijkheden voor jouw carrière om hierin mee te groeien!


Basic-Fit zet zich daarnaast in om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt voor iedereen. Of je nu één van onze leden of medewerkers bent, wij hebben aandacht voor jouw welzijn en focussen ons op diversiteit! Waar je ook voor gaat, wij zijn er om je te ondersteunen en je te helpen met #becomfortable te voelen. Zo kun jij de wereld aan!


Klaar voor de uitdaging? Solliciteer direct!


Wil jij komen werken bij dé grootste fitnessketen van Europa? Solliciteer dan nu via de apply button, bovenaan deze vacature en wellicht maak jij binnenkort deel uit van de Orange Community van Basic-Fit!


Heb je nog een vraag over deze parttime baan? Neem dan contact op met recruitment@basic-fit.nl. Sollicitaties via dit mailadres worden niet in behandeling genomen. (Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld)

title: Football Officiating Specialist
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

This is a unique opportunity for a highly motivated individual to learn and master the technical delivery of our world-leading sports analytics and officiating technology (SAOT). You will be trained and mentored by top-tier specialists, gaining the skills to operate in a high-stakes environment and contribute to the integrity of the game.

What You'll Do

  • Training: You will be fully trained to learn and master the technical delivery of our world-leading SAOT, from system setup to live operation.
  • Matchday Operations: Under the guidance of senior team members, you will assist in operating our technology during live matches, focusing on building confidence and consistency.
  • Technical Knowledge: Develop a strong understanding of the Laws of the Game, successfully completing monthly knowledge tests to build your expertise.
  • Operational Support: Utilize our Knowledge Management System to learn and apply standard operating procedures, ensuring all tasks are completed with precision.

Required Attributes & Skills

  • Passion for Sport: A genuine interest in the sport and a desire to contribute to its integrity and accuracy.
  • Technical Aptitude: A quick learner with the ability to understand and operate complex software and hardware.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous and focused, able to spot small but critical details in fast-paced situations.
  • Team-Oriented: A collaborative mindset and a strong desire to learn from others and contribute to the team's success.
  • Adaptable & Resilient: You can remain calm and composed in high-pressure situations, with the flexibility to work irregular hours and travel as required.

What We Offer

  • Unparalleled Training: You will receive direct, hands-on training from some of the best technical specialists in the industry.
  • Clear Career Path: This role is the starting point for a rewarding career in sports technology, with a clear path for progression to senior specialist and leadership roles.

Purpose-Driven Work: You will have a direct impact on the accuracy and fairness of live sporting events watched by millions around the world.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.
