title: Molder
description:
Position Purpose

Responsible for molding parts on machines and related equipment in production of quality products.

Essential Duties and responsibilities

  • Perform molding operations using various techniques to produce parts or products according to specifications.
  • Maintain a clean and controlled environment by following strict cleanroom protocols, including gowning, gloving, and adhering to contamination control procedures.
  • During molding operation inspect parts for defects, dimensions, and quality, and report any issues to quality control or supervisory personnel.
  • Record production data, including batch numbers, material usage, and production yields, and maintain accurate records of molding operations.
  • Employee is required to perform precise lay-up and tailor materials (example prep regs) in accordance with work instructions using sharp tools like knives and scissors.
  • Employees are required to know how to use and how to read simple tools/measuring devices like rulers and calipers.
  • Ensure proper housekeeping by clearing and cleaning workspace.
  • Complete all paperwork pertaining to production neatly and correctly following all quality standards.
  • Monitor, record and report all scrap.
  • Responsible for following all Vaupell policies, standard operating procedures and safety practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications/Requirements

  • High school diploma/general education degree (GED) or equivalent combination of experience, training and education
  • Ability to read, speak, understand and follow instructions in English
  • Capable of using basic hand tools
  • Comprehension of basic math, including fractions, decimals, averages and percentages
  • Must be able to wear and properly us required personal protective equipment

Candidates must be a “US Person” (i.e. US Citizen or Permanent Resident) to ensure Vaupell's compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) and EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

Environmental Condition

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and vibrations. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to occasionally moderate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements


This position requires the employee to stand for 60% or more of the work shift and to walk, bend at the waist, reach above and below shoulder level, lift and carry up to 50 pounds, push up to 50 pounds, and turn or twist for 20% to 60% of the work time. The role also requires continuous or frequent use of hands and visual skills, including grasping, handling, finger dexterity, feeling, eye-hand coordination, near and far vision acuity, depth perception, color perception, keyboarding, and pulling. The employee may occasionally sit, carry 25 to 50 pounds, climb ladders, balance, kneel, crawl, and use ordinary hearing. Lifting, carrying, or pushing over 50 pounds and climbing stairs are not essential physical requirements of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Vaupell reserves the right to change, modify or add to the Essential Duties and Responsibilities of any position at any time.

Vaupell is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, belief and spirituality, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ethnicity/national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran or disability status.


We encourage applications from veterans and individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.

title: Strategic Transformation PMO
description:
Position Overview

This position is responsible for assisting the CSO in establishing, operating, and maintaining the company-level strategic project management mechanism; translating approved corporate strategies, major reforms, and transformation initiatives into clear project plans, owners, milestones, risks, acceptance criteria, and value targets; and continuously tracking project execution, business acceptance, and results reviews.

The position focuses on strategic project intake, initiation checks, portfolio maintenance, integrated planning, progress tracking, risk alerts, cross-functional coordination, meeting action-item management, project acceptance coordination, and 30/60/90-day value realization reviews. It promptly identifies unclear accountability, missed milestones, resource conflicts, prolonged delays, and similar issues, and escalates them to the CSO or relevant owners in accordance with the escalation mechanism.

This position is responsible for executing and maintaining PMO governance processes and recommending continuous improvements. It does not replace business functions in making professional judgments or owning project business results. Project business owners are accountable for execution and business outcomes; this position is accountable for the accuracy of project information, timely follow-up, risk warning and escalation, action-item closure, and completeness of project documentation.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategic Project Intake & Portfolio Management
    1. Receive strategic, reform, system, new-business, and key cross-functional projects confirmed by the CSO or CEO and include them in the centralized strategic project register.
    2. Verify that each project clearly defines the business problem, strategic value, scope, ultimate accountable owner, participating departments, budget, key metrics, timeline, and acceptance requirements; return incomplete submissions for supplementation.
    3. Assist the CSO in prioritizing projects based on strategic value, urgency, resource requirements, project risk, and expected return.
    4. Maintain the corporate strategic project portfolio; identify duplicate initiatives, resource conflicts, critical dependencies, and excessive team workload, and issue timely warnings or escalations.
    5. Retain approval rationale and complete change records for projects that are paused, cancelled, delayed, or have scope changes.
  3. Project Initiation, Planning & Accountability Mechanism
    1. Coordinate completion of the Strategic Project Charter by project owners, clearly defining objectives, baseline, target, business value, budget, deliverables, and success criteria.
    2. Assist in establishing the work breakdown, milestone plan, responsibility matrix, and communication mechanism, clearly identifying the owner, due date, and approver/acceptance owner for each task.
    3. Identify system, data, staffing, vendor, budget, and cross-functional dependencies across projects and incorporate them into the master plan.
    4. Organize project kick-off meetings to ensure team members understand objectives, responsibilities, milestones, reporting methods, escalation mechanisms, and acceptance criteria.
    5. When major changes occur to scope, budget, objectives, or delivery timing, coordinate reassessment of the impact and submit changes for approval according to delegated authority.
  5. Project Progress, Risk & Issue Management
    1. Continuously compare planned versus actual progress through weekly project follow-ups, monthly transformation reviews, and project dashboards.
    2. Establish Red/Amber/Green (RAG) project status standards and promptly identify delays, insufficient resources, unclear accountability, data anomalies, and cross-functional blockers.
    3. Record each risk or issue and assess its impact; drive responsible owners to define corrective actions, completion dates, and the next review point.
    4. Promptly alert the CSO and relevant owners to matters expected to affect key milestones, budget, go-live timing, or strategic objectives.
    5. Issues unresolved beyond the agreed deadline, showing no substantive progress for two consecutive reviews, or affecting major company objectives must be escalated to the CSO or CEO for decision.
    6. PMO must proactively verify actual project status and supporting evidence and may not stop follow-up because a project owner fails to report proactively.
  7. Meeting, Decision & Action-Item Closure
    1. Organize strategic project meetings, transformation reviews, and special decision meetings, and prepare project status, issues, data, and decision items in advance.
    2. Clearly document conclusions, owners, completion dates, and acceptance requirements during meetings; avoid vague wording such as “continue to follow up” or “complete as soon as possible.”
    3. Promptly create an action-item log after meetings and send it to responsible owners for confirmation.
    4. Continuously track all due action items and obtain the cause, corrective plan, and newly approved completion date for overdue items.
    5. Maintain decision records documenting decision background, options, approved conclusion, accountable owner, and subsequent execution results.
    6. The number of meetings is not considered a work outcome; completion of meeting actions and closure of issues are the project-management results.
  9. Cross-Functional Project Coordination & Escalation
    1. Coordinate Operations, Merchandising, Finance, HR, CAO, IT, Supply Chain, Marketing, Expansion, and other functions to resolve accountability and resource conflicts. Issues that cannot be resolved at the project level must be escalated promptly to the CSO or relevant management for decision.
    2. Drive each department to identify a business owner and project point of contact; “joint departmental responsibility” may not replace a single accountable owner.
    3. For cross-functional deliverables, clearly define the provider, recipient, delivery standard, delivery date, and acceptance requirements.
    4. For matters requiring management decisions, summarize the issue background, business impact, available options, recommended option, and latest required decision date.
    5. Do not replace business owners in making professional decisions, and do not allow projects to remain stalled for extended periods because departments disagree.
  11. Project Acceptance & Value Realization Management
    1. At project initiation, define separate standards for deliverable acceptance and value realization, and manage “project delivery completion rate” and “project value realization rate” separately.
    2. After go-live or solution release, coordinate acceptance by actual user departments to confirm whether functionality, processes, data, training, and usage conditions meet requirements.
    3. Conduct 30/60/90-day post-launch reviews against baseline and target values to assess adoption, efficiency, cost, revenue, risk, or other expected outcomes.
    4. Projects that meet go-live requirements but have not achieved expected value must be marked “Live - Value Not Yet Realized” and may not be closed directly.
    5. For projects that do not meet targets, coordinate root-cause analysis and drive the project owner to propose optimization, continued observation, reduction, pause, or exit options; summarize the options and impacts and submit them to the CSO or relevant approver for decision.
    6. A project may be formally closed only after business acceptance, action-item closure, documentation archiving, and value realization review are complete.
  13. Corporate Policy Governance Process Support
    1. Maintain the Policy Master Register in accordance with company Policy Governance requirements, recording the Policy Owner, scope of application, version, effective date, approval status, and review date.
    2. Receive requests from departments to create, revise, or retire policies; verify that submission materials and required reviews are complete and return incomplete requests for supplementation.
    3. Coordinate the Policy Owner and relevant professional functions through the Review and Approval process and track the request until the appropriate approver completes approval.
    4. For approved policies, manage version registration, publication coordination, notification, archiving, and retirement of superseded versions, and track required training, acknowledgement, or related SOP updates.
    5. Periodically identify policies due for review, version exceptions, and outstanding items; drive Policy Owners to resolve them and escalate major or long-unresolved matters to the CSO.
  15. Key Transformation Project Support & Responsibility Boundaries
    1. Provide PMO tracking for annual organizational-change projects, continuously monitoring milestones, risks, action items, and implementation results. Organizational-change design and people implementation are owned by the CSO, HR, and relevant business owners according to their responsibilities.
    2. Provide PMO governance support for ERP, WMS, POS, BI, CRM, internally developed systems, and other key system projects, tracking plans, milestones, risks, cross-functional dependencies, and value realization. Technical architecture, information security, development/implementation, and system operations are owned by IT.
    3. Provide PMO tracking support for strategic projects involving corporate legal and compliance remediation, tracking plans, milestones, risks, and action items. Legal judgment, corporate compliance, and board governance are owned by the CAO.
    4. Provide PMO governance support for store-operations reform projects, tracking plans, key milestones, risks, and results reviews. Sales, profit, labor, inventory, and store-management results are owned by the COO and Operations organization.
    5. Provide PMO governance support for new-business pilots, tracking project plans, milestones, risks, acceptance, and value realization reviews. The business owner is accountable for execution, operating results, and pilot business judgments.
  17. PMO Standardization & Project Knowledge Management
    1. Assist the CSO in establishing and continuously improving standard templates for project initiation, planning, status updates, risk management, changes, acceptance, review, and closure.
    2. Standardize project status, milestones, completion rates, risk levels, and closure criteria to prevent inconsistent definitions across projects.
    3. Fully archive project initiation, approval, plans, meetings, decisions, acceptance, reviews, and closure documentation.
    4. Periodically summarize and analyze project delays, rework, resource conflicts, and unrealized value; identify common causes and develop PMO governance improvement recommendations for CSO review.
    5. Based on project volume and work complexity, recommend PMO staffing, tools, and project-management system configuration for CSO evaluation.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above; Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Professional Experience: 2–4 years of experience in project management, PMO, enterprise transformation, process management, or cross-functional project coordination.
  • Project Experience: End-to-end experience with organizational change, system implementation, process optimization, or new-business projects from initiation through acceptance and closure; chain retail or multi-site enterprise experience preferred. Practical participation in projects from initiation and planning through tracking, acceptance, or review is preferred.
  • Knowledge & Skills: Project portfolio management, project planning and milestones, RACI, risk and issue management, business processes, data analysis, meeting and decision management, project acceptance, and value realization review. Basic capability in process governance, document management, and version control.
  • Tools: Proficient in Asana, Monday, Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, or similar project-management tools.
  • Core Competencies: Planning, persistent follow-up, integrity and adherence to standards, cross-functional influence, structured communication, risk awareness, problem solving, results orientation, and strong ability to perform under pressure.
  • Language: Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese.


Compensation

  • $72,000-$80,000 per year
  • Quarterly Performance Bonus: This position is eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus, subject to the eligibility requirements, performance criteria, and terms of the Company's bonus program.

Benefits

  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching - subject to the eligibility requirements
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid Time Off

title: Java Tech Lead
description:
Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Banking (Crédit Agricole CIB) is the corporate and investment banking arm of Crédit Agricole Group, world's 10th largest bank by total assets.

Our Singapore center is the 2nd largest IT setup (after Paris Head Office) for Crédit Agricole CIB's worldwide business. We work daily with international branches located in 30 markets by:

  • Envisioning and preparing the Bank's futures information systems
  • Partnering and supporting core banking flagships and transverse areas in their large scale development projects
  • Providing premium In-house Banking applications

This unique positioning empowers us to bring our core banking business a sustainable competitive advantage on the market. We seek innovative and agile people sharing our mindset to support ambitious and forthcoming technological challenges.

Position

In a challenging and multicultural environment, we seek for a Technical Leader to join our CBI Department, which stands for 'Corporate Banking IT'. Our department is at the heart of many large and deep IT transformation programs of the Bank.

The role will define and drive the team's technical vision, architecture, and delivery of technology solutions. You will lead and mentor the software engineering team, champion innovation, and establish best practices across development, deployment, and operations. The position will primarily focus on:

  • Architect a Powerful Ecosystem: Develop a platform that fosters collaboration between investors, lenders, and clients, streamlining deal flow across syndicated markets.
  • Embrace Complexity: Design a system capable of managing diverse loan formats, large lender pools, institutional investors, and multi-product offerings.
  • Boost Efficiency: Drive agility through more focused and structured transactions, optimizing deal execution.
  • Navigate the Regulatory Landscape: Implement solutions that adhere to evolving regulations like Basel IV and IFRS 9.

The position requires autonomy and reliability in performing duties while maintaining close communication with the rest of the program. The candidate will need to develop a good understanding of both IT systems and business processes.

Main responsibilities

Technical Leader primary responsibilities include:

  • Technical Strategy & Vision: define and execute technical roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and emerging industry trends.
  • Architectural Leadership: Oversee the design and implementation of the application, ensuring it's scalable, maintainable, and architecturally efficient.
  • Team Leadership & Mentoring: Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support of the software engineering team to cultivate technical excellence.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Act as a bridge between the technical team and Product Owners, including Business Analysts and Project Managers, translating business needs into technical solutions and vice versa, and contribute to study, evaluate, and provide feedback on functional requirements as needed.
  • Innovation: Explore and advocate for the adoption of cutting-edge technologies, tools, and practices to maintain a competitive edge.
  • Governance: Ensure adherence to coding standards, security policies, and compliance regulations.

Additionally, as a Senior Software Engineer, role includes:

  • Cloud-Native Integration Layer Development : Accountable for designing and implementing a cloud-native Integration Layer Application for Loanscape applications.
  • Smooth Roll-Out Execution : Prepare, plan and execute the rollout collaborating with release managers from support to production to ensure smooth deployment of the application across Loanscape.
  • Software engineering: Estimate development costs and implement solutions that meet business requirements and user stories.
  • Delivery Quality Maintenance : Contribute to maintaining high delivery quality standards.
  • DevSecOps Integration : Incorporate DevSecOps principles into the software development lifecycle by embedding security by design, continuous testing, and automated security checks from development through deployment.
  • Issue Analysis and Resolution : Actively participate in analyzing and resolving issues across the software development lifecycle, including production support and postdeployment incident response.
  • Tool integration : Integrate new tools into the bank's enterprise application ecosystem, ensuring compatibility, secure configuration, and operational scalability.
  • Documentation : Draft specifications, technical designs, unit tests, code review notes, and detailed system integration documents, and produce any additional documentation required throughout the project lifecycle.

title: Tagger 2nd Shift
description:
Who We Are:

Kontoor Brands is a portfolio of three of the world’s most iconic lifestyle, outdoor and workwear brands: Wrangler®, Lee® and Helly Hansen®. Kontoor Brands is a purpose-led organization focused on leveraging its global platform, strategic sourcing model and best-in-class supply chain to drive brand growth and deliver long- term value for its stakeholders.

Job Posting:

Summary

Provides the ability to print pre-ticketing on demand on standardized pre-ticket stock. Each case generates a pay coupon to allow for pay to be based on associate’s production. Outbound audits are performed to verify shipping accuracy of count and SKU integrity. Every garment in box is scanned when audited. Random audits are performed prior to carton sealing.

Responsibilities

Associate is responsible for performing Special Operations to units in a case, as directed by information on the case label or BOM report. Operations performed include attaching Pre-Ticket price stickers, seeding or attaching hangers, attaching size tabs to hangers, and bagging units. Associate must be able to read and follow instructions indicated on case labels and BOM report. The pay coupon bar code will be placed on their pay sheet, and they will stamp the case with their personal id stamper. Cases arrive at the workstation on conveyor, and a lift table is used to lower cases to proper work height. They will close the case and lower the lift table to place the completed case on the takeaway line. Hangers are attached using a Hanger Machine. Associates will perform the required ticketing, hanger attaching, hang tag attaching, etc. that the case requires based on both the remarks section of the case label or the bill of material sheet. Care must be observed in operation of the machine to avoid injury or damage. Required quality standards must also be met by department. Failure to meet these guidelines will result in disciplinary action. Failure to observe safety and work guidelines may result in disciplinary action or injury to self or others. Work areas must be maintained in a clean and orderly manner.

Education/ Experience

Years of related experience - 1 year Plus High School Diploma or Equivalent preferred Physical Demands Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds consistently Continuous standing required.

Typical Working Conditions

Will work around equipment, such as conveyors and rolling stock, which could contain hazards. Other exposures found in a distribution center such as high level of noise and dust may exist for this position.

Why Kontoor Brands?

At Kontoor, we offer a comprehensive benefit package to fit your lifestyle. Our benefits are crafted with the same care as our products.

When our employees are healthy, secure, and well, they bring their best selves to work. Kontoor Brands supports you with a competitive benefits program that provides choice and flexibility to meet your and your family’s needs – now and in the future. We offer resources to support your physical, emotional, social, and financial wellbeing, plus benefits like discounts on our apparel. Kontoor Brands also provides four weeks of Paid Parental Leave to eligible employees who are new parents, Flexible Fridays, and Tuition Reimbursement.

We are proud to offer a workplace culture centered on equitable opportunities and a sense of belonging for all team members. Here we have a global workforce of high-performing teams that both unlocks our individual uniqueness and harnesses our collaborative talents.

title: Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst
description:
Acorn Health is an Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) treatment provider dedicated to providing the best quality care for our clients. We aim to continually establish best-in-class standards in integrity and quality for not only ourselves, but also in the field of ABA. We work courageously and with accountability to focus on the individuality of each child, collaborate with client families, and generate permanence in client outcomes. We strive to hire and to invest in our greatest asset - our employees, who are the heart of Acorn Health.

Acorn Health is a standard-setting family of ABA treatment providers. We believe the best employees want to work with companies who share their beliefs, and that is true for families who entrust us with children they love. Every day and every interaction, we strive to demonstrate our Five Core Values.

Acorn Health is looking for a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join us as a Program Supervisor as we increase access to care in Otsego, Michigan.

We also have additional clinics across Michigan and beyond!

We believe in clinical quality. The compensation reflected in the job post includes the base level of a bonus package tied to your delivery of clinical impact hours. We look forward to sharing more details with you should you choose to seek partnership with Acorn Health.

Every day and every interaction, we strive to demonstrate our Five Core Values.

  • Authenticity: We present our true, consistent selves. Everyone hungers for genuine connections.
  • Accountability: We keep our promises and can be trusted with the life and future of a child.
  • Teamwork: The best outcomes are produced by people who collaborate with enthusiasm.
  • Growth: We know the needs of children and their families are unique and ever-changing.
  • Hustle: In autism care and treatment, time is always of the essence. We do things now.

You’ll have the opportunity to work in a team-oriented environment and engage in a wide range of activities, focused on providing behavior analytic assessment and treatment services in our clinical centers, at client homes, and/or in community settings.

What our BCBA Program Supervisors do:

  • Oversee client treatment from assessment through care delivery
  • Conduct initial and follow-up functional, behavioral and developmental assessments
  • Develop, oversee and implement client’s BIPs and Treatment Plans
  • Serve as the clinical lead on client cases, providing supervision to Behavior Technicians
  • Monitor and review client programs to analyze data, measure progress and make necessary changes to the treatment plan
  • Observe program implementation, and provide training on interventions as needed
  • Work closely with clients and their families providing family training and support
  • Meet with primary caregivers to discuss observations and concerns
  • Collaborate with colleagues, parents, and schools to share information and implement best practice intervention programs across settings
  • Promote awareness and disseminate information regarding ASD and Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) through training and presentations, both on- and off-site
  • Attend and participate in team meetings where ideas, success stories, and recent research topics are presented for discussion and use in treatment

Why work for Acorn Health:

  • Incentive Bonus
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Retirement Plan
  • Life insurance, long term and short term disability
  • CEU opportunities
  • Professional development funds
  • Career development opportunities, including Acorn’s Leadership Development Institute
  • Opportunities to collaborate with and learn from our Clinical Advisory Board
  • Positive and collaborative environment
  • Balanced caseloads and flexible work environment
  • Supportive administrative back office
  • Compensation Range: $76,000 - 94,500

You're perfect for the position if you:

  • Possess a master’s degree in ABA or a related field
  • Have active Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification
  • Have knowledge of best practices in the treatment of autism
  • Have Experience working with children, adolescents, young adults, and their families
  • Are able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, in English
  • Have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license, and satisfactory driving record
  • Meet the physical requirements of the position, to include lifting of packages, or equipment, and accessing non-barrier free premises
  • Enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team approach to develop and implement client treatment plans
  • Have strong organizational skills, are detail-oriented, able to maintain records, prepare reports and reliably develop timely correspondence related to work
  • Are able to pass a background check
  • Have the flexibility to work independently when needed, but also enjoy working as a part of the larger team

Note: This position requires a Board Certified Behavior Analysis (BCBA) from the BACB. Data and Business Analyst candidates cannot be considered due to payer restrictions.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Soil and Crop Sciences Open Pool
description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

The Department of Soil and Crop Sciences at Colorado State University seeks applications for temporary part-time or full-time Postdoctoral Fellow positions that may become available through the year. Fields of research include but are not limited to: Crop Breeding and Genetics; Soil Ecology; Soil Health; Agroecology; Microbiome Science; Biogeochemistry.

Postdoctoral Fellows work under the direction of individual faculty members and contribute to ongoing research activities specific to each lab. Duties, funding source, appointment length, and work modality (in-person, hybrid, or remote) vary by faculty lab. Detailed descriptions of faculty research programs are available on the department website:

The Department of Soil and Crop Sciences is focused on education, research, and outreach to solve the world’s most pressing food production issues and crucial matters about Earth, its ecosystems, and their services. Our faculty and staff apply research-based solutions to benefit Colorado and the world. We offer academic programs to prepare students to address national and global crop production, sustainability, and environmental quality challenges such as waste management, water quality, and reclamation of drastically disturbed lands. There are numerous opportunities for students to be involved in cutting edge research related to global food production and ecosystem function and protection.

Salary Range:

$60,000-$80,000 Salary is commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Essential Job Duties:

Essential job duties vary depending on the hiring laboratory and research program, but may include:

  • Conducting laboratory, field, or computational research activities.

  • Collecting, managing, and analyzing research data.

  • Assisting with experimental design and protocol implementation.

  • Maintaining laboratory equipment, materials, and documentation.

  • Contributing to manuscripts, reports, and presentations.

  • Collaborating with faculty, staff, graduate students, and other research personnel.

Specific duties will be defined at the time of hire by the supervising faculty member.

Conditions of Employment:

Pre-employment criminal background check (required for new hires).

Supervision:

This position reports to a faculty member within the Department of Soil and Crop Sciences.

Minimum Qualifications:

Completed PhD or equivalent degree from an accredited institution by start date of employment.

Preferred Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications vary by laboratory.

Application Instructions:

To apply, please upload a resume and cover letter. This is an open pool posting. Applications will be reviewed as hiring needs arise, and qualified applicants may be contacted by individual faculty members if a suitable opportunity becomes available. This pool will expire on December 31, 2026. Applicants wishing to be considered beyond this date must reapply.

Please note, applicants may redact information from their application materials that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world-class teaching, research, and service. description:

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

Job Description Summary:


Will handle most clerical duties associated with a medical clinic.

The job of Patient Services Specialist (PSS) is divided into “stations.” Each station has a distinct set of job duties, which includes job duties that usually are performed by one employee in a usual day. However, in addition to the “usual” duties of the station they are sitting in, every PSS employee is required and expected to assist their co-workers in performing every job duty of a PSS at all times. All employees hired for the Patient Services Specialist position will be expected to learn and perform all duties of all front office stations.


Due to the different office layouts, the person doing the named station that day or week may not perform some of the listed job duties. Demonstrated strong copywriting and editing skills are essential. Requires attention to detail and the ability to consistently meet time-sensitive priorities. Must be highly organized with the ability to be flexible, according to changing priorities.

Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

  • Interpersonal Effectiveness: Developed interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, diplomacy, tact, conflict management, delegation skills, and diversity awareness. Ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential material and sometimes emotionally charged matters.
  • Communication Skills: Good command of the English language. Second language is an asset but not required. Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation) are an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback.
  • Customer Service & Organizational Awareness: Strong customer focus. Ability to build an engaging culture of quality, performance effectiveness and operational excellence through best practices, strong business and political acumen, collaboration, and partnerships, as well as a positive employee, physician and community relations.

De voordelen van werken bij Basic-Fit
• Bij Basic-Fit geloven we in jouw potentieel. Groei mee met ons mee als internationaal bedrijf en grijp de kans om door te groeien binnen onze organisatie. Je hebt onbeperkt toegang tot alle online trainingen van GoodHabitz.

• Je wordt onderdeel van de Orange Community waar diversiteit gevierd wordt en waar je jezelf mag zijn. Met de Orange Connect App ben je altijd verbonden en up-to-date.

• Wat is er beter dan werken in een omgeving waar gezondheid en fitness voorop staan? Maak gebruik van de mogelijkheid om zelf te sporten en ervaar de energieke en positieve werksfeer.

Zo ziet jouw functie eruit
Iedereen met veel plezier naar de club laten terugkomen, daar doe je het voor! Als Gastvrouw / Gastheer ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt van de club. Met een oprechte glimlach verwelkom je de leden en beantwoord je hun vragen. Daarnaast zorg jij ervoor dat onze club tiptop in orde is: als jij er bent, zijn er geen rondslingerende gewichten of rommelige kleedkamers te bekennen. Hoewel je regelmatig jouw diensten alleen draait, werk je als team actief samen aan het resultaat van de club.


Wie zoeken wij?
Als enthousiaste Gastvrouw / Gastheer van Basic-Fit heb je:

• Een gastvrije, servicegerichte en energieke instelling;

• Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel voor het schoon en netjes houden van de club;

• Affiniteit met sport en fitness. Ook ben je:

• Beschikbaar: het werken op onregelmatige tijden, zoals avonden en weekenden, vormt voor jou geen enkel probleem. De diensten die op de club worden gedraaid zijn: ma t/m vrij van 08:30 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 21:00 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 14:00 uur;

• Flexibel: je bent in staat om snel te schakelen bij veranderingen en invallen op nabijgelegen clubs zie je als een uitdaging;

• Zelfstandig: je motiveert jezelf en anderen, ziet het werk liggen en pakt dit snel op;

• Behulpzaam: met een enthousiaste houding sta je altijd klaar voor onze leden.

Over Basic-Fit
Basic-Fit is een dynamisch en sterk groeiende organisatie met een duidelijke missie. Inmiddels zijn wij de grootste fitness keten van Europa. Buiten Nederland hebben we clubs in België, Duitsland, Luxemburg, Frankrijk en Spanje. Ons doel is om de komende jaren verder te professionaliseren en door te groeien. Mede dankzij jouw inzet kunnen we onze groei realiseren en dat geeft weer nieuwe mogelijkheden voor jouw carrière om hierin mee te groeien!

Basic-Fit zet zich daarnaast in om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt voor iedereen. Of je nu één van onze leden of medewerkers bent, wij hebben aandacht voor jouw welzijn en focussen ons op diversiteit! Waar je ook voor gaat, wij zijn er om je te ondersteunen en je te helpen met #becomfortable te voelen. Zo kun jij de wereld aan!

title: Logistics and Fleet Officer
description:
Job Purpose:

The Logistics and Fleet Officer works as a support service to the operation in Ratanakiri (RTK) and the role is expected to work closely with the HR/Admin Officer, Finance Officer and under direct supervision from Technical Field Manager. The position is also required to liaise with the CO Logistics team to ensure that the activities of NPA-RTK support services such as procurement, fleet maintenance, transportation, fuel consumption records etc. is compliant with NPA logistic policies and procedures.

The position is based in Ratanakiri province and requires some travel to other project areas as directed by the TFM or the needs of the programme.

Specific Duties
Procurement:

  • Ensure all logistics and procurement activities have been carried out with full compliance following NPA standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Process all requisitions, collect and analyze quotations, prepare PO, and run local purchasing for the RTK field office of equipment/material in close collaboration with the CO logistics team, RTK HR/Admin Officer, and Finance Officer.
  • Consult with TFM and work closely with CO logistics to develop the annual procurement plan for RTK operation.
  • Constantly evaluate all local suppliers, products, and prices to obtain the best value for money in purchasing.
  • Follow up with suppliers and transporters to receive goods and control delivery.
  • Keep accurate tracking of all requisitions, goods receipts, goods issuances, and all procurement documents.
  • Work with the CO Logistics Team for the preparation of a long-term agreement, contract, or leasing agreement with the suppliers.
  • Participates in review and development of logistics and procurement strategies with CO logistics.
  • Responsible for negotiation and getting contracts and agreements with suppliers and maintaining a good working relationship with relevant stakeholders.
  • Work closely with the CO logistics team to ensure sufficient support on logistics requirements for the RTK field office.

Fleet Management:

  • Ensure that the use of all types of NPA fleet (vehicle, motorcycle, generator, etc.) is compliant with policy and government rules, including registration, insurance, service agreements, and repair and maintenance.
  • Ensure accurate records of the vehicle logbook, trip movement, fuel consumption, and repair and maintenance, and produce monthly expense reports.
  • Keep vehicles in good condition for usage, arrange service and repairs as required
  • Keep generators in good working condition
  • Prepare the following reports, including:
    • Loss & Damage Report handling
    • Mechanical Failure Report handling
    • Vehicle Accident Report handling
  • Ensure accurate and update of vehicle history file
  • Coordinate closely with CO logistics, the security focal point, and the insurer when vehicle incidents take place.

Required qualifications:

Must have:

· Bachelor’s degree in business administration or any related field.

· At least three years of experience in logistics and procurement or any related field.

  • Good command of English and Khmer

Desirable:

· Experience in logistics, fleet and procurement functions and procedures

· Experience in customs clearance.

Relevant training related to Logistics

Other qualifications:

  • Good computer skills (with Microsoft Office, Khmer Unicode, E-mail, and Internet)
  • Good communication skills with a strong ability to work with people of all backgrounds, and being a good team leader
  • Logistics program (Preferably in Agresso).
  • Good communication skills with a strong ability to work with people with all backgrounds and being a good team player.
  • Ability to work in fast paced environment and manage priorities and workloads under minimum supervision.

Personal Competencies:

  • Organizational skills with attention to details
  • Sensitive to the needs of others
  • Obtain good communication skill with multi-culture environment
  • Willing to work calmly under the fast-paced environment
  • Obtain good communication skill with multi-culture environment
  • Ability to follow the data protection of the organization
  • Structure, accurate, and efficient approach
  • Self- motivated, independent, and proactive

We work continuously for more diversity and inclusion throughout Norwegian People's Aid. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Please note, that only applications submitted through our career site will be considered. Applications and resumes sent via e-mail will not be reviewed.

title: Digital Customer Insights & Renewal Intelligence Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one-to-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.

You will own the account-intelligence and renewal-risk workstream, converting multi-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.

Your Impact

Account health reviews: Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.

Early-warning and risk analysis: Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.

Portfolio and segmentation: Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.

Renewal intelligence: Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.

Risk and leadership reporting: Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data-quality caveats and recommended follow-up.

CRM health narratives: Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next-step entries aligned to the review cadence.

Data and source management: Extract, reconcile and quality-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.

Cross-functional collaboration: Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.

Documentation and controls: Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.

Automation and enablement: Help translate review and risk-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.

What You'll Need

Experience: 3–5 years in Customer Success operations, customer-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Data capability: Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.

Reporting tools: Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.

Business judgement: Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.

Communication: Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.

Operating discipline: High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.


Preferred / Nice to Have

Customer Success platforms: Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.

Data and automation: Exposure to Snowflake or other data-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.

Relevant models: Experience developing health scores, early-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.

Industry context: Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.


What Success Looks Like

Reliable delivery: Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.

Actionable insight: Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.

Data integrity: Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.

Scalability: Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.


How This Role Works

This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

title: Radiation Therapist
description:
At GenesisCare we want to hear from people who are as passionate as we are about innovation and working together to drive better life outcomes for patients around the world.

Care to join the team?

A new role. A new location. A fresh opportunity to grow.

GenesisCare is inviting Radiation Therapists from Tasmania to explore opportunities across Western Australia, South Australia and Regional Queensland.

Whether you’re an experienced Radiation Therapist ready for your next challenge or a recent graduate looking to start your career, we have opportunities across a range of locations where you can grow your skills and make a meaningful difference for patients.

What you’ll be doing

As a Radiation Therapist with GenesisCare, you’ll be part of an experienced multidisciplinary team delivering high-quality radiation therapy and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

Depending on your experience and location, you’ll work across pre-treatment and treatment, using contemporary technology and techniques while continuing to build your clinical skills and expertise.

More specifically, you will:

  • Deliver safe and accurate radiation therapy across pre-treatment and treatment
  • Provide compassionate, patient-centred care throughout the treatment journey
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to achieve positive patient outcomes
  • Maintain high standards of clinical practice, quality and patient safety
  • Contribute to quality improvement and service development
  • Help create a positive team culture and exceptional patient experience
  • Continue developing your skills through ongoing learning and training

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for Radiation Therapists who are passionate about patient care, enjoy working as part of a team and are excited by the opportunity to build their career somewhere new.

You’ll have:

  • A recognised qualification in Radiation Therapy and current, or close to obtaining, AHPRA registration
  • Eligibility to obtain the relevant radiation licence for the state in which you’ll be working
  • Experience in planning and treatment delivery, or an eagerness to develop these skills as a recent graduate
  • A genuine passion for exceptional patient care
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • A positive attitude and commitment to continuous learning
  • An interest in exploring a new career and lifestyle opportunity across Western Australia, South Australia or Regional Queensland

Picture your next chapter somewhere new

Beautiful coastlines, warmer weather, outdoor living and a new place to call home. Take your Radiation Therapy career somewhere new while discovering the lifestyle that comes with it.

Considering the move?

Relocation assistance is available for suitable applicants, conditions apply.

At GenesisCare, you’ll work alongside experienced multidisciplinary teams, with access to advanced technology, contemporary treatment techniques and opportunities to keep learning throughout your career.

Benefits of joining our team

Benefits and entitlements vary depending on role and location.

  • Relocation assistance is available for suitable applicants, conditions apply
  • Up to 5 weeks annual leave, plus annual leave loading for permanent employees
  • Generous professional development support, including up to 3 days paid professional development leave each year
  • Professional registration and radiation licence fees reimbursed, where applicable
  • Career development opportunities across senior, specialist and leadership pathways
  • Flexible full-time and part-time opportunities, with attractive roster arrangements to support work-life balance
  • Paid parental leave and access to a range of employee wellbeing and retail benefits

Thinking about a change?

Curious about what’s next? We’d love to hear from you. Apply today and let’s explore where your Radiation Therapy career could take you.

About GenesisCare

By joining GenesisCare, you will be joining a highly progressive and passionate team of healthcare professionals and support staff, united by a common purpose: to design care experiences that deliver the best possible life outcomes.

The ambition for better cancer care that began our story has grown into a passionate team of approximately 2,000 employees across 50 locations nationally. Join us to design better care and enjoy a career with purpose.

GenesisCare is committed to managing the risk of transmission of specified vaccine preventable diseases (VPDs). Certain roles may require the successful candidate to show evidence that they have been vaccinated against or are not susceptible to specified VPDs.

GenesisCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Sr. Regional Oncology Specialist - Nevada
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:


Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:


· Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

· An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.

· A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

· A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.


Abbott's Cancer Diagnostics business was established through the acquisition of Exact Sciences, bringing Exact Sciences' full cancer screening and diagnostics portfolio, including Cologuard, Oncotype DX, Cancerguard, and Oncodetect, into Abbott. Together, we're advancing the early detection of cancer and the precision oncology tools that guide personalized treatment decisions, helping patients and providers act on cancer earlier and more precisely. Our combined portfolio and global reach allow us to bring life-changing diagnostic technology to more patients, providers, and health systems worldwide.


The Opportunity

Working on the Oncology Sales team, the Sr. Regional Oncology Specialist (Sr. ROS) will develop and implement a plan to maximize the utilization of Abbott Cancer Diagnostics products in targeted accounts, while staying within budget, and support the corporate objectives and highlight the delivery of key selling messages. Products may include OncoExTra, OncoDetect (MRD) and RiskGuard (Hereditary Cancer Testing). The Sr. ROS should incorporate a high level of service toward being the best-in-class for an assay provider. The Sr. ROS’s plans are used to solve challenging problems in a dynamic environment. The plans should emphasize developing customer relationships as well as leveraging strong clinical and scientific expertise, key stakeholder insight, and selling approach in highly competitive and complex market. To do this plan, the Lead ROS must have, or be able to quickly develop, a clear understanding of key territory-related clinical/political issues. The Sr. ROS will devote whatever time is necessary to complete objectives outlined in the sales plan.


The Sr. ROS provides information critical to accomplishing our mission to all parties involved in the sales of products. The Sr. ROS will provide direct feedback to individuals so they can make accurate decisions at all levels of the company, such as national, regional, and area teams. The Sr. ROS will work with managed care, reimbursement, patients, to include patient support groups, Abbott Cancer Diagnostics advocacy group, and providers to ensure access to products.


This is a field-based position supporting Las Vegas, Reno and Tahoe, NV.


What You’ll Work On

  • Consistently meet or exceed sales objectives in an assigned geographic area (territory) through field-based call activity/meetings with healthcare providers and their staff on a regular basis.
  • Sell company products or services, develop new accounts, and drive depth within existing accounts.
  • Demonstrate elevated territory management, planning, and implementation.
  • Develop and implement results-oriented territory management and planning.
  • Develop and implement a highly strategic and actionable tactical plan to maximize the utilization of our products in the most productive accounts while staying within budget; support corporate objectives and highlight the delivery of key selling messages and provide a high-level of customer service toward being the best-in-class provider.
  • Executes with strong understanding of key territory-related clinical/political issues while devoting whatever time is necessary to complete objectives outlined in the sales plan.
  • Drives growth through in-depth knowledge of scientific and applicable disease states, competition, and outside influences that impact our business.
  • Complete all training programs and work proficiently with the concepts and complexities associated with genomic testing and our Precision Oncology products.
  • Invest the time necessary to maintain an in-depth understanding of all disease states associated with Exact Sciences’ products and the strengths and weaknesses of the competition; use technical fluency to move target physicians and influencers to actions that result in patient access and utilization of our products.
  • Strive for excellence in all aspects of performance and is committed to continuous self-evaluation and development.
  • Attend various sales meetings and professional conferences around the U.S. on an as needed basis.
  • Develop relationships with a demonstrated ability to quickly develop one with national opinion leaders in oncology and pathology within their target territory.
  • Strong communicator with an ability to maintain open communication with internal employees, managers, and customers, as needed.
  • Ability to integrate and apply feedback in a professional manner.
  • Ability to prioritize and drive to results with a high emphasis on quality.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
  • Ability to work designated schedule.
  • Ability to work seated for approximately 50% of a typical working day. Ability to work standing for approximately 50% of a typical working day.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds for approximately 15% of a typical working day.
  • Ability to travel 75% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Sales, Business Management, Marketing or, Science, or any other related field or 4 years relevant experience in lieu of degree.
  • 5+ years of sales experience with a strong record of success selling/promoting complex products in medical oncology and/or diagnostics or similar experience in selling/promoting complex healthcare products.
  • 3+ years medical sales experience in specialty areas including: Buy & Bill, Medical Device, highly clinical Specialties like urology, cardiology, GI
  • 3+ years experience selling in a highly competitive environment
  • Demonstrated clinical and scientific expertise.
  • Demonstrated strong territory or account management skills.
  • Demonstrated strong understanding of competitors and market trends that are impacting product utilization of customers.
  • Possession of a valid driver's license; no suspended, revoked, surrendered, invalid, etc. allowed.
  • No more than two moving violations, events, or accidents within the last 36 months.
  • No alcohol or drug event in which a vehicle was driven by the candidate or employee, including but not limited to Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) failure, refusal to submit to alcohol or drug test, alcohol related suspension, etc. in the last 36 months.
  • No other results from the Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) check that exposes Abbott Cancer Diagnostics to what we deems to be an unacceptable level of liability.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clinical experience.
  • 1+ years of experience in oncology either selling chemo/immunotherapy or diagnostics in oncology.
  • Strong relationships within oncology accounts in territory
  • Experience selling to surgeons and cancer centers.
  • Experience in NextGen Sequencing, Minimal Residual disease, comprehensive genomic profiling, liquid biopsy and/or hereditary cancer.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is building fast, reliable, and cost-efficient inference services for frontier models. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on our Applied AI team, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking, with a focus on improving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while maintaining model quality and reliability.

This is a hands-on role in which you will work on complex optimization projects, diagnose difficult serving problems, and deliver measurable improvements in production. Working closely with kernel and platform engineers, you will evaluate serving configurations, resolve performance and quality regressions, and optimize inference for real-world workloads, supported by reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own optimization work for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.

  • Run engine comparisons and recommend practical serving configurations for specific workloads.

  • Debug model quality or performance regressions during production rollouts.

  • Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

  • Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

  • Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

  • Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves:

  • Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

  • Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

  • Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

  • Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

  • CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

  • Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About ESi

Engineering Systems Inc. (ESi) is an engineering and scientific investigation and failure analysis firm. We are frequently retained by law firms, insurance companies, and manufacturers to answer complex technical questions on projects ranging from small, focused investigations to large-scale, high-profile losses.

Our work spans a wide range of challenges, including major transportation accidents, equipment and product failures, personal injury claims, and damage to residential, commercial, and industrial structures. The variety, complexity, and real-world impact of our projects create deeply fulfilling and intellectually engaging careers for our consultants.

At ESi, you’ll have the opportunity to shape your own path while being supported by a collaborative culture, national expertise, and industry-leading resources.

Why ESi

ESi’s Civil and Structural team evaluates, investigates, and restores structures and sites through detailed inspections, engineering analysis, and research. By identifying causes of damage and failure, the team develops practical solutions that improve safety, performance, and reliability across the built environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site visits to perform inspections of existing structures.
  • Dimensional documentation of structures and understanding of existing structural systems.
  • Condition assessment or damage documentation of damaged or other existing structures.
  • Reviewing literature, drawings, reports, or other documentation related to project work.
  • Preparing AutoCAD drawings detailing proposed repairs or retrofits to existing structures.
  • Using analysis software such as SAP2000 to perform structural analysis.
  • Using programs such as MathCAD or Excel to organize and present calculations and data.
  • Preparing technical reports to convey the results of analyses or inspections.
  • Internships with ESi are expected to be full-time, 40 hours per week, from Monday to Friday (Business hours are from 8 am-5 pm).
  • If you are participating in our internship program – we require that you take no more than 2 classes during your employment with ESi and are able to work a minimum of 32 hours per week.

Qualifications

Education / Certifications / Licenses

  • Completed 3 years of college in Civil engineering or Physics/Science program
  • 3.00 GPA or higher, preferred.

Experience

  • Any experience performing field investigations, construction, structural inspections, structural analysis, structural design, technical report writing, and preparation is preferred.
  • Intermediate skills with CAD and office productivity software.

Other Technical & Non-Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Office Suite. In particular: Excel, Word
  • Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation. Must be able to travel for trips of three days in length.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong verbal and written communication.

Physical Demands

This role requires frequently sitting or standing for extended periods of time and occasionally lifting and/or moving items weighing up to 50 pounds, with infrequent lifting up to 75 pounds. The work regularly requires bending, twisting, kneeling, crouching, and maintaining balance. This position frequently requires handling and operating specialized tools and equipment and working in a variety of physical positions, including occasionally accessing tight or confined spaces. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Work Environment

Work is performed in both office and field environments, including active construction sites, industrial settings, and damaged or compromised structures. The work environment may include exposure to varying noise levels, weather conditions, uneven terrain, and site-specific hazards. Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required depending on site conditions. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

To all recruitment agencies: ESi does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or agencies. Any resume submitted to any employee of ESi without a prior written search agreement will be considered unsolicited and the property of ESi. Please, no phone calls or emails.

ESi is an equal opportunity employer committed to attracting and retaining the most qualified individuals based on merit, experience, and skills. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status. In accordance with applicable laws, ESi actively supports the employment of veterans and individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior Risk Actuary
description:
Job Description

The Senior Risk Actuary sits within Quantitative ERM and supports the independent oversight of insurance risk across the Group, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, capital, and strategy. The role applies technical expertise across a range of topics to support business decision-making, risk identification and mitigation, and the delivery of the insurance risk agenda in partnership with stakeholders globally.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support the development and delivery of the Insurance Risk Assurance Plan across all risk-taking entities.
  • Provide independent challenge of business plan loss ratio assumptions, assessing whether key assumptions (including rate change, inflation, development patterns, catastrophe load, portfolio mix, growth and reinsurance strategy) are reasonable, supported and internally consistent, identifying material downside risks, areas of uncertainty and implications for earnings, capital and risk profile.
  • Support insurance risk stress and scenario testing, including scenario design, quantitative impact assessment, challenge of results and reporting to management and Board forums.
  • Support second-line oversight and challenge of reserve analyses, methodologies, assumptions and judgements, forming an independent view on reserving adequacy and uncertainty.
  • Support targeted insurance risk deep dives and thematic reviews (e.g. class performance, inflation, market cycle dynamics).
  • Deliver ad hoc quantitative analysis to support executive decision‑making on emerging risks and strategic initiatives.
  • Support with Group and legal entity CRO executive and Board forum reporting.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of insurance risk components of regulatory submissions and capital assessments, including ORSAs, PRA exercises, Solvency II Technical Provisions, SCR calculations and Standard Formula appropriateness assessments.
  • Maintain up-to-date technical expertise and awareness of regulations and professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the wider business and the broader Risk team.
