  • Gain experience in coordinating conflicting utilities and other field engineering design requirements, assessing and developing large design packages for complex cable/conduit projects in dense urban environments, work permit development, easements, and ROW applications
  • Be comfortable in both a field and office setting: the role may require local or regional customer-site visits to collect field data that will assist in developing work packages

What Sets You Apart (Background Requirements):

  • 2+ years of prior relevant experience is required.
  • Bachelor's Degree (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Industrial preferred); additional relevant experience/certifications may be considered in lieu of bachelor's degree
  • Experience and demonstrated proficiency with the National Electric Safety Code (NESC)
  • Some Prior experience with structural analysis, guying calcs, cable pulling calcs, coordination of protective devices, and electric demand and fault currents calculations.
  • Ability to provide your own reliable transportation, as some local or regional customer-related travel is anticipated (Job-related travel will be reimbursed at IRS-approved rates).
  • Ability to demonstrate strong written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills

You Might Also Have Some previous experience with:

  • Providing estimated costs, development of a BOM, calculating the CIAC.
  • Design tools such as Pole Foreman, Pull Planner, and Katapult.
  • Work management software and job estimating software.
  • CAD or MicroStation - performing Electrical Distribution design.

  • Positive attitude

title: Donor Services Coordinator
location: Ponte Vedra, Ponte Vedra, FL, US
description:
Determined to end Veteran suicide, K9s For Warriors is the leading nonprofit organization providing Service Dogs to military Veterans nationwide suffering from PTSD, traumatic brain injury, and/or military sexual trauma — at no financial cost to the Veteran. Founded in 2011 as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, K9s For Warriors is committed to saving lives at both ends of the leash by primarily rescuing dogs and pairing them with Veterans in need. In order to continue the great work we’re doing, we’re looking to add a Donor Services Coordinator to our amazing team!

Role and Responsibilities

The Donor Services Coordinator (DSC) is responsible for managing and overseeing Donor Services operations, systems, and processes to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality support for donors and the Development team. This position independently oversees and evaluates key donor services operations, exercising discretion and independent judgment in establishing priorities, resolving complex donor and data issues, maintaining donor database integrity, analyzing reports, administering recurring-gift processes, and directing donor communication and stewardship activities to support departmental strategy and organizational objectives. The DSC serves as a primary resource for donor inquiries, independently evaluating and resolving donor needs and determining when escalation is appropriate. The role analyzes donor and giving data, identifies trends and opportunities, and recommends and implements process improvements that strengthen donor engagement, operational efficiency, data quality, and fundraising effectiveness. The DSC also manages Donor Services projects and volunteer initiatives, collaborates across departments, and serves as a subject-matter resource for donor database and Donor Services procedures.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

The Functions and Responsibilities of the Donor Services Coordinator include all or some of the following:

  • Manage and oversee donor services operations and processes to ensure timely, accurate, and high-quality support for donors and the Development team.
  • Prepare, and analyze regular reports to support donor stewardship, fundraising strategy, departmental planning, and leadership decision-making.
  • Oversee the accuracy and integrity of donor database records, including gifts, donor information, documentation, and stewardship activity, identifying and resolving data discrepancies as needed.
  • Independently oversee and administer the monthly sustainer program, exercising discretion and independent judgment in evaluating donor service matters, resolving complex account and payment issues, determining appropriate courses of action, and implementing solutions to support donor retention and effective program operations.
  • Develop, coordinate, and manage Donor Services volunteer opportunities, including determining departmental needs, establishing processes, and overseeing volunteer activities.
  • Serve as a primary resource for donor inquiries, exercising independent judgment to evaluate donor needs, resolve complex issues, and determine appropriate responses or escalation when necessary.
  • Develop and implement personalized donor communications and stewardship strategies designed to strengthen donor relationships, retention, and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Program, Finance, Development, Education/Communications, and Administrative Support teams.
  • Manage Donor Services systems and workflows, including donor records, correspondence, gift acknowledgments, reporting, tracking, and related processes in accordance with organizational policies and best practices.
  • Maintain standards for the accurate and timely documentation of donor interactions and activity within the K9s For Warriors donor database.
  • Monitor database quality and system performance, proactively identifying issues, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Oversees donor data integrity, system health, security practices, and appropriate access to sensitive donor information.
  • Develop, evaluate, and recommend database management procedures, workflows, and internal controls to improve departmental efficiency and data quality.
  • Analyze donor and giving data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas of concern and provide recommendations to Development leadership.
  • Evaluate existing Donor Services processes and independently recommend and implement improvements that enhance donor experience, operational efficiency, and fundraising effectiveness.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for donor database processes and Donor Services procedures, providing guidance and support to Development staff as needed.
  • Manage assigned projects and initiatives with responsibility for planning, prioritization, coordination, execution, and follow-through.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities consistent with the scope and level of the position as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Two to five years of experience in donor services, development operations, CRM/database administration, or a related field requiring independent judgment and problem-solving.
  • Advanced knowledge of database structure and theory
  • Experience planner with strong skills in prioritizing, multi-tasking, and follow-through
  • Experience with reporting tools
  • Experience with CRM software, preferably Blackbaud and/or Salesforce
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Skills

  • Some college experience in Business, Communications, Nonprofit Management, or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, establish priorities, exercise sound judgment, and manage responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Advanced knowledge of Raiser’s Edge/Blackbaud and/or Salesforce, with the ability to independently manage CRM processes, evaluate data and system needs, troubleshoot complex issues, and recommend process improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Understanding of Military Service Organizations (MSO) and Veteran Service Organizations (VSO)

Core Competencies /

  • Donor Relationship Management & Service
  • Planning, Prioritization & Organization
  • Written & Verbal Communication
  • CRM & Database Management
  • Analytical Thinking & Problem-Solving
  • Independent Judgment & Decision-Making
  • Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency
  • Project Management & Execution
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

title: Head of IT Strategy and Transformation
description:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

Head of the IT Strategy and Transformation Office (STO) leads an integrated enterprise capability that connects strategy, architecture, investment planning, delivery excellence, organizational change, and executive governance. The role brings Enterprise Architecture, Lean Portfolio Management, Agile Delivery (LACE), Organizational Change Management, and Executive Governance together into one accountable operating model. Through this leadership, the Head of IT Strategy & Transformation ensures technology investments are strategically aligned, architecturally sound, appropriately prioritized, delivery-ready, and supported through adoption. The role connects enterprise strategy to execution by enabling informed decisions, focusing resources on the highest-value work, and improving transparency, consistency, and accountability for transformation outcomes.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Leads the Integrated IT Strategy & Transformation Office

  • Sets the strategic agenda and annual operating plan for the STO, unifying architecture, portfolio, delivery, and governance activity behind one coherent enterprise strategy.
  • Owns the end-to-end operating model connecting strategy formulation, investment funding, architectural standards, delivery execution, and governance decision rights.
  • Serves as the single executive point of accountability for whether the organization's technology investments collectively advance its strategic priorities — through the quality of the recommendations, architecture, and delivery readiness the STO brings forward, not through unilateral funding authority.
  • Represents the STO to the executive team, the Investment Council, and Board-level committees, translating strategic intent into well-formed, architected, and delivery-ready investment recommendations for those bodies to decide.

Enterprise Architecture

  • Directs the definition of enterprise architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and reference architectures that ensure every investment advances one coherent strategy.
  • Establishes the architecture governance model — including an Architecture Review Board that evaluates major initiatives for strategic fit, technical risk, and reuse before funding is committed — and delegates day-to-day chairmanship of the Board to the Principal Architect.
  • Owns the technology rationalization and modernization roadmap, reducing redundant platforms and technical debt over time.

Lean Portfolio Management

  • Directs enterprise investment planning, aligning funding, capacity, and prioritization with strategic themes and value streams.
  • Facilitates the Investment Council — a standing committee of executive leaders who hold formal decision-making authority over funding, sequencing, and re-prioritization of major initiatives — by preparing prioritized investment recommendations, portfolio trade-off analysis, and capacity/value data for the committee's decisions. The Head of IT Strategy & Transformation does not hold personal or unilateral funding decision rights.
  • Owns portfolio-level value realization: tracking benefits, cost, and capacity against plan, and reallocating investment as strategic priorities shift.

Agile Delivery (LACE)

  • Builds and matures enterprise delivery capability through the Lean-Agile Center of Excellence — coaching, engineering practices, and operating model maturity across delivery teams.
  • Scope note: LACE owns the ways of working and delivery-team practices used to build initiatives; it does not own business-side adoption of the resulting process or operational changes — that responsibility sits with Organizational Change Management, below.
  • Sets delivery standards and operating cadences (e.g., Program Increment planning, Scrum of Scrums) that give the portfolio a predictable, transparent delivery rhythm.
  • Establishes delivery KPIs (predictability, flow, quality, cycle time) and drives continuous improvement across delivery teams.

Executive Governance

  • Personally designs, chairs, and runs the decision forums and escalation paths that connect strategy, investment, architecture, and execution — including cadence, membership, and decision rights for each forum. This is not delegated to a direct-report manager; the Head of IT Strategy & Transformation is the accountable owner of governance.
  • Ensures every major decision (funding, architecture exception, delivery risk) is made in the right forum, by the right owner, with the right information, and personally facilitates the highest-stakes / executive-level sessions.
  • Publishes and maintains a governance operating calendar and RACI so accountability is explicit at every level of the model; may be supported by governance/PMO analysts for administration and reporting, but retains direct ownership of the function.
  • Serves as the escalation point of last resort within the STO for unresolved cross-discipline conflicts (e.g., architecture vs. delivery timeline, portfolio priority disputes).

Organizational Change Management

Owns enterprise-level change leadership for the operational and process-related impacts of major initiatives on the business — how work gets done, roles change, and processes are re-designed — as distinct from LACE's focus on delivery-team ways of working.

Directs the Manager, Organizational Change Management to build and run a repeatable OCM methodology (stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, communication planning, training, and adoption measurement) applied consistently across major initiatives.


Ensures every initiative entering the portfolio carries a change-readiness assessment and a named change plan before it is funded, closing a common gap where technical delivery outpaces organizational readiness.

Personally sponsors change management for the STO's own operating model — leading the organization through the shift to a unified strategy, architecture, portfolio, and governance function, including communication, training, and adoption of new decision rights and cadences.

Partners with HR, Communications, and business-unit leaders to align change plans with broader organizational initiatives and to manage change fatigue across concurrent transformations.


Establishes adoption and sentiment metrics (e.g., stakeholder readiness scores, training completion, adoption rates) and reviews them alongside delivery and portfolio KPIs so change outcomes are tracked with the same rigor as cost and schedule.

Team Leadership and Development

Provides strategic, tactical, and day-to-day direction to the architecture, portfolio, delivery, and change management leads who report into the STO.

Builds a cohesive leadership team across historically separate disciplines, establishing shared metrics, cadence, and a common operating language — while personally modeling the governance standard the team is held to, since the Head of IT Strategy & Transformation owns that discipline directly.


Owns hiring, performance management, coaching, and development planning for direct reports; holds them accountable for the same standard across their functions.


Manages the STO's budget, staffing, and vendor/consulting resources, and ensures adherence to company policy and compliance requirements.

Acts as an escalation point and thought partner for the organization on complex, cross-functional strategy, architecture, portfolio, or delivery problems.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises the leaders of Enterprise Architecture, Lean Portfolio Management, Agile Delivery (LACE), and Organizational Change Management, and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. Executive Governance is run by the Head of IT Strategy & Transformation directly and has no dedicated manager. Supervisory responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training team members; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining staff; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing direct reports and their teams; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations and goals; forecasting staffing needs across the STO; and enforcing department policies and procedures.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university required, in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive experience across enterprise architecture, portfolio management, agile delivery, or IT/business strategy.
  • Minimum 7 years in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary teams and/or a Strategy, Transformation, PMO, or Enterprise Architecture function.
  • Demonstrated track record building or leading a Lean Portfolio Management model, Agile Center of Excellence, or comparable transformation function.

CERTIFICATES AND LICENSES

SAFe Program Consultant (SPC) or SAFe Agilist required; SAFe Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) certification preferred. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification preferred. Prosci Change Management Certification or equivalent OCM credential preferred. PMP, PgMP, or ITIL certification a plus.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Deep working knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, Lean Portfolio Management, SAFe or comparable scaled-agile operating models, and executive governance design.
  • Proven ability to translate enterprise strategy into a funded, architected, and delivery-ready portfolio of initiatives.
  • Skilled at designing governance forums, decision rights, and operating cadences that hold a large organization accountable without adding bureaucracy.
  • Strong financial acumen — able to build, defend, and manage a multidisciplinary budget and demonstrate portfolio-level value realization.
  • Exceptional executive communication and influence skills; able to synthesize complex, cross-functional trade-offs into clear recommendations for senior leadership and the Board.
  • Experience leading organizational change across historically siloed functions, building one shared operating culture out of separate disciplines.
  • Hands-on knowledge of organizational change management methodology (e.g., Prosci ADKAR or equivalent) and demonstrated ability to personally sponsor change on high-visibility, enterprise-wide initiatives.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently will sit, stand, walk, and bend during working hours. Requires manual and finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination. May be required to lift light objects. Requires normal or corrected vision and hearing corrected to a normal range.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Role Overview:

Responsible for providing direct care, supervision, and therapeutic support to clients in a 24/7 inpatient/residential treatment setting. The Residential Counselor maintains a safe, structured, and trauma-informed milieu while supporting clients in meeting individualized treatment goals. This role works collaboratively with medical and clinical staff to deliver behavioral health interventions, manage crisis, facilitate therapeutic activities, and ensure accurate and timely documentation of client care.


Essential Duties:

  • Provide individualized behavioral health intervention and milieu management on the unit to maintain patient and staff safety.
  • Support client intake and orientation, including completion of required paperwork and explanation of program rules and routines.
  • Monitor client behavior, movement, and engagement throughout the facility and during client appointments off site, always ensuring accountability and safety.
  • Facilitates client participation in their service plan through interaction with them, resourcing, problem solving and advocacy as an active contributor to the interdisciplinary treatment team shaping and informing treatment.
  • De escalate conflicts and intervene in behavioral crises using trauma informed and approved intervention techniques.
  • Facilitate therapeutic and skills based activity groups as assigned.
  • Assist with discharge planning, including scheduling follow up appointments and coordinating transitions as directed by clinical staff.
  • Accurately document client interactions, observations, and interventions in the electronic health record in a timely manner.
  • Assist medical and clinical providers with client related tasks and unit operations as needed.
  • Respond appropriately to emergency codes and critical incidents in accordance with agency policies.
  • Maintain a clean, structured, and therapeutic environment that supports recovery and safety.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in health, human services, or a related field preferred
  • At least one year of experience working in behavioral health setting or programs preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be evaluated and considered


Licenses and Certifications:

  • Valid Colorado driver’s license or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire and a clean driving record required
  • CPR and First Aid certifications required or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Addiction Technician (CAT) or Certified Addiction Specialist (CAS) in Colorado preferred – pursuit of CAT or CAS required within 6 months of hire for full time employees
  • Trauma Informed Care experience preferred
  • Bilingual/bi-cultural preferred

title: Client Service Coordinator
description:
If you are a current associate, you will need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE AND FUNCTION The Client Service Coordinator ("CSC") drives the flow of clients and pets through the hospital, maximizes the productivity of the veterinary medical team (in terms of numbers of clients and pets), ensures good communication with associates and clients, and coordinates the care of clients and pets in a happy, welcoming, friendly and efficient manner, influencing clients to return and refer their friends and families.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

 Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team.

 Actively recruit new clients by promoting hospital services and route the flow of clients and pets to ensure superior client care and maximum productivity of the veterinary medical team.

 Maximize the number of pets seen by the hospital team through through a productive and efficiently run hospital to support the needs of our wellness plan clients.

 Provide professional, efficient and exceptional service at all times. This includes encouraging hospital visits, welcoming clients and pets, ensuring that they are comfortable in the hospital, and educating them about their pet's health.

 Educate clients about Optimum Wellness Plans, preventative care, pet health needs and hospital services Assist incoming clients by completing the required documentation, entering all pet information and history in the computer, utilizing proper collars and tags for identification, and ensuring prompt service.  Assist outgoing clients by providing all necessary instructions, information and invoices, dispensing prescription items per the veterinarian's instructions, selling retail products and scheduling future appointments.

 Manage the finances by maintaining accurate balances and utilizing proper opening and closing procedures.

 Conduct administrative functions as necessary.

THE FIVE PRINCIPLES

 Quality – The consumer is our boss, quality is our work and value for money is our goal.

 Responsibility – As individuals, we demand total responsibility from ourselves; as associates, we support the responsibility of others.

 Mutuality – A mutual benefit is a shared benefit; a shared benefit will endure.

 Efficiency – We use resources to the full, waste nothing and do only what we can do best.

 Freedom – We need freedom to shape our future; we need profit to remain free.

HIRING QUALIFICATIONS COMPETENCIES Leadership

 Customer Focus  Peer Relationships  Integrity & Trust  Action Oriented  Listening Functional  Preventative care and OWPs  Communication Skills  Client Service Skills  Priority Setting  Time Management

CAPABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE (CAN DO)

 Ability to multi-task- Manages multiple tasks at one time; quickly and accurately shifts attention among multiple tasks under distracting conditions without loss of accuracy or appearance of frustration.

 Communication skills - Reads, writes and speaks fluent English, using appropriate grammar, style and vocabulary. Correctly spells commonly used English words and job specific terms. Demonstrates exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Organizational ability – Demonstrates a systematic approach in carrying out assignments. Is very orderly and excels at cutting through confusion and turning chaos into order.

 Problem solving skills - Demonstrates a strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. Translates problems into practical solutions.

 Client service skills - Consistently ensures the team provides the client with attentive, courteous and informative service. Gains and shows personal satisfaction from delivering great service.

 Intellectual ability - Accurately and consistently follows instructions delivered in an oral, written or diagram format. Can provide directions.

 Mathematical ability - Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide, and to compute rate, ratio and percent; ability to convert units of measurement.

 Computer skills - Comfortably and confidently uses a computer and specialized software. Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.

ATTITUDES (WILLDO)

 Initiative – shows willingness and aptitude to use own discretion in taking appropriate steps in finding solutions to problems; presents options and ideas to enhance current processes or procedures. Takes on additional responsibility when both big and small tasks need to be done.

 Integrity – Firmly adheres to the values and ethics of Banfield Pet Hospitals. Exhibits honesty, discretion, and sound judgment.

 Cooperativeness – Willing to work with others, collaborating and compromising where necessary; promptly share relevant information with others.

 Flexibility – Is open to changing situations and opportunities and is willing to perform all tasks assigned.

 Independence – Able and willing to perform tasks and duties without supervision.

 Tolerance for Stress / Resiliency – Maintains a positive “can do” outlook, rebounds quickly from frustrations and unpleasantness, and maintains composure and friendly demeanor while dealing with stressful situations.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

 Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.

 Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)

 Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.

 Must have mental processes for reasoning, remembering, mathematics and language ability (reading, writing, and speaking the English language) to perform the duties proficiently.

 The noise level in the work environment is moderately high.

 Requires sufficient ambulatory skills in order to perform duties while at hospital.

 Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.

 Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.

 Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

 Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING

 High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.

 Must be at least 18 years old to perform duties involving radiography (x-ray) and exposure to radioactive substances.

 One year related experience required with customer service preferred.

 Medical background (veterinary technician, human healthcare, pharmaceutical, etc.) with medical terminology training is preferred

title: Risk Engineer Executive
description:
The Risk Engineer Executive is an expert-level individual contributor in risk engineering and loss prevention, serving as a recognized authority on complex risk management, property protection, operational resilience, and loss control strategies. This role provides enterprise-level technical leadership and consultative expertise to clients, carrier partners, producers, account teams, and senior leadership. As a trusted advisor on the most complex and technically challenging risk exposures, the Risk Engineer Executive develops innovative risk mitigation solutions, influences risk management strategy, and helps clients improve risk quality, reduce loss frequency and severity, and optimize insurance program outcomes. The role is frequently engaged in large accounts, specialized industry sectors, emerging risks, and high-impact client situations requiring deep technical expertise and advanced professional judgment. Operating with significant autonomy, the Risk Engineer Executive serves as a thought leader, technical mentor, and market-facing expert while contributing to organizational differentiation, client retention, growth initiatives, and risk engineering excellence across the brokerage.

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Engineering Leadership

  • Serve as the organization’s principal technical authority on risk engineering, loss prevention, property protection, operational risk, and resilience strategies.
  • Provide advanced consulting services for the organization’s largest, most complex, and highest-risk client engagements.
  • Evaluate highly complex property, casualty, operational, and business interruption exposures and develop strategic recommendations to improve risk quality and insurability.
  • Lead technical assessments involving complex manufacturing operations, critical infrastructure, catastrophe-exposed properties, supply chain vulnerabilities, and specialized industry risks.
  • Provide expert guidance regarding fire protection systems, natural catastrophe exposures, business continuity planning, equipment reliability, process safety, life safety systems, and operational resilience.
  • Develop innovative solutions to address emerging risks, evolving technologies, and changing risk environments.
  • Support enterprise initiatives involving complex technical, regulatory, and risk management challenges.

Strategic Client Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level client stakeholders regarding strategic risk management, loss control investments, and operational risk reduction opportunities.
  • Partner with producers, client executives, and account teams to strengthen client relationships and support retention and growth objectives.
  • Advise clients on enterprise risk improvement initiatives designed to reduce losses, improve underwriting outcomes, and enhance organizational resilience.
  • Provide strategic consultation regarding risk financing considerations, loss trends, operational exposures, and long-term risk management planning.
  • Participate in executive-level presentations, stewardship meetings, and strategic client engagements.
  • Support complex account reviews and high-value renewal strategies through technical expertise and risk engineering leadership.
  • Assist clients in understanding and applying industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices relevant to their operational environments.

Market & Carrier Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical resource in discussions with insurance carriers, engineering consultants, and underwriting partners.
  • Support market negotiations and placement strategies by communicating risk quality, operational improvements, and mitigation efforts.
  • Advise brokerage leadership regarding carrier risk appetite, underwriting expectations, engineering standards, and market trends.
  • Facilitate resolution of complex engineering and underwriting issues affecting account placement, renewal negotiations, or client strategy.
  • Provide technical leadership during engineering reviews, market presentations, and specialized risk evaluations.
  • Enhance relationships with carrier engineering and underwriting teams through subject matter expertise and market credibility.

Thought Leadership & Innovation

  • Serve as an internal and external thought leader on risk engineering trends, emerging hazards, and loss prevention best practices.
  • Research and evaluate evolving risks such as climate-related exposures, cyber-physical systems, supply chain disruption, advanced manufacturing technologies, and operational resilience challenges.
  • Develop technical resources, white papers, educational content, and client-facing materials to promote organizational expertise.
  • Represent the organization at industry conferences, carrier forums, professional associations, and client events.
  • Contribute thought leadership to support organizational growth strategies, market differentiation, and brand recognition.
  • Influence the development of risk engineering methodologies, service offerings, tools, and consulting frameworks.

Technical Mentorship & Organizational Impact

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Risk Engineers, Sr Risk Engineers, and other risk management professionals.
  • Support development of organizational standards, quality expectations, and technical best practices.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for the most complex and challenging risk engineering matters.
  • Review and provide feedback on technical reports, engineering assessments, and risk improvement recommendations.
  • Collaborate with leaders across brokerage, claims, analytics, underwriting, and client service functions to address complex client needs.
  • Support strategic projects requiring advanced technical expertise and specialized professional judgment.

Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Expert-level knowledge of risk engineering, loss prevention, operational resilience, property protection, and enterprise risk management principles.
  • Recognized expertise in one or more specialized risk disciplines such as property engineering, process safety, natural catastrophe management, industrial operations, construction risk, energy risks, transportation, healthcare, or manufacturing.
  • Deep understanding of insurance carrier engineering methodologies, underwriting practices, and loss prevention standards.
  • Exceptional ability to evaluate highly complex and ambiguous risks and develop practical, innovative solutions.
  • Advanced consulting, advisory, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to influence executive leadership, clients, carrier partners, and internal stakeholders through credibility and expertise.

title: Personal Shopping Coordinator
description:
Our Personal Shopping team are now looking for a Personal Shopping Coordinator to join them. Supporting a fast-paced and highly client-focused environment, you’ll play a key role in ensuring a seamless experience by coordinating stock movement and supporting the operational side of the client journey.


About the Role


In this role, you will work closely with Personal Shoppers and report into the Personal Shopping Manager, supporting the team to deliver exceptional service in every interaction. You’ll be responsible for coordinating stock movement across the store, ensuring products are delivered efficiently and accurately to clients.


You will:

  • Manage stock movement across departments, ensuring efficient delivery to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Oversee stock counts and ensure timely returns to Concession and Own Bought departments
  • Maintain stock accuracy, promptly resolving discrepancies and escalating where needed
  • Coordinate stock between Harrods locations, including dispatch, collection points, and customer areas
  • Process transactions, handle client orders, and prepare items for dispatch
  • Follow all compliance and security procedures, including till operations and stock protocols
  • Work closely with stock control and operational teams to ensure clear communication and accurate tracking
  • Support Personal Shoppers with operational tasks to deliver a seamless client experience

This role is fully on site, working 5 out of 7 days per week.


Please see our Hybrid@Harrods policy on our Career Site for more information or speak to a member of our Talent Acquisition team.


About You


You will be highly organised, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced retail environment. With strong operational knowledge and a collaborative approach, you’ll be confident supporting multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and service excellence.


You will:

  • Have experience working in a retail or operational support role
  • Demonstrate strong systems and till knowledge, with the ability to process transactions accurately
  • Be confident multitasking, managing competing priorities, calls, and emails
  • Have a strong understanding of stock management and inventory processes
  • Be an excellent communicator, building relationships across multiple teams
  • Take a proactive and solutions-focused approach to problem-solving
  • Be comfortable working in a physical role, including handling stock and moving products

About Us


Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.


Our Promise to You


Help us make the impossible possible for our customers and we’ll do something remarkable for you. As well as offering a friendly environment to inspire your best work, we provide abundant opportunities and support to build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.


Uniquely You


Whilst our job adverts outline the ideal qualities, skills, and prior experience for the role, we believe in the potential for growth and value individual strengths. If you can demonstrate the majority of skills and strong experience to thrive in this role, we would encourage you to apply.


At Harrods we believe the personality and authenticity of our people sets us apart. We celebrate and invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. title: Client Services Representative
description:
Summary:

Overview


Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with a strong team of committed animal lovers? Is problem solving and working with a variety of people something that energizes you? The ASPCA Animal Hospital Client Services Representative (CSR) creates an atmosphere of support for clients and their pets during their time with us.


Who We Are


The ASPCA Animal Hospital (AAH) provides expert, urgent medical care to some of NYC’s most vulnerable animals. As a component of the NYC safety net system, we provide subsidized care for animals whose owners are experiencing financial challenges and cannot otherwise afford medical care for their pet. We also provide medical care for animals who come to us through our internal partners, including victims of cruelty and neglect, as part of our partnership with the NYPD.


AAH is passionate about minimizing fear, anxiety, stress, and pain in our patients. Team members in this position are responsible for providing services and communication to clients, members of the public, co-workers, and patients that are consistent with our practice’s standards and Fear Free values.


What You’ll Do


The Client Services Representative reports directly to the Manager, Client Services and has 0 direct reports.


The CSR serves as a primary point of contact for clients throughout their experience at the hospital, providing support from check-in through check-out. Responsibilities include assisting clients with required paperwork, scheduling appointments, answering calls and messages, maintaining accurate client and patient information, and supporting electronic medical records. The CSR coordinates and facilitates communication across multiple platforms, connecting clients with medical teams and supporting communication between internal departments and external partners. Above all, the CSR provides compassionate, professional customer service with a high level of respect toward clients and their pets during what may be a difficult time.


Where and When You’ll Work


This full-time position works 4 days per week, 10-hour shifts. The schedule is Monday, Thursday-Saturday 8:00am-6:00pm, onsite at our 92nd Street location. Position may require occasional flexibility and occasional overtime, including weekends. Schedules are subject to change at the sole discretion of the ASPCA.


What You’ll Get


Compensation


The starting pay rate for this role is $22.00 hourly and falls under a collective bargaining agreement.

  • Staff in this role may be eligible for additional pay such as shift differential.

Benefits


At the ASPCA, you don’t have to choose between your passion and making a living. Our comprehensive benefits package helps ensure you can live a rewarding life at work and at home. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:


  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental and optional vision coverage.
  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, paid personal time, sick time, bereavement time, paid parental leave, and 10 company paid holidays that allows you even more flexibility to observe the days that mean the most to you.
  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings, including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar-for-dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year. Robust professional development opportunities, including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field and so much more

For more information on our benefits offerings, visit our website.

Responsibilities:

Responsibility buckets are listed in general order of importance, and include but are not limited to:

Client Service

  • Greet clients, determine nature of visit, and direct clients accordingly
  • Load rooms when necessary and log times in the appointment management software.
  • Build close working relationships with others, both internal and external, and at all levels
  • Use a non-judgmental approach to build trusting relationships with clients
  • Encourage the client to speak openly and honestly to their doctor about medical and financial concerns
  • Provide clients with required paperwork, ensure paperwork is completed properly
  • Assist owners in comprehension of information provided to them and support them with their decisions
  • Work with clients to obtain medical records from previous clinics as needed
  • Provide a safe and compassionate environment for our patients and clients by utilizing Fear Free techniques
  • Resolve client service issues within established guidelines
  • Attend to the client every 30 minutes while client is in the hospital to assess animal health and client comfort

Administrative Client and Hospital Support

  • Utilize computer system effectively – schedule appointments, create client accounts, view medical records, manage financial transactions
  • Answer phone calls – schedule appointments, take messages for doctors, answer general questions; guide clients without giving medical advice
  • Confirm daily appointments
  • Be familiar with and utilize procedure manual as effective reference tool
  • Discretely handle confidential client information such as social security numbers, credit card numbers, financial histories, etc. with adherence to all ASPCA privacy policies and Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS)
  • Complete financial transactions for clients, including taking credit card and cash payments and recording payment in computer system
  • Review and determine client eligibility to be seen at the ASPCA Animal Hospital according to One ASCPA Fund Guidelines
  • Maintain neat front desk appearance, keep supplies stocked

Qualifications

  • Demonstrate genuine respect and friendliness to all clients and staff; leverage differences in others’ perspectives and ideas; appreciate cultural differences and approach all interactions with kindness and an open mind
  • Must be organized and detail oriented and have a history of arriving on time and being ready to work at the start of your shift
  • Ability to handle money accurately and honestly
  • Ability to keep composure in a busy environment and handle every interaction with diplomacy
  • Enjoys working collaboratively as part of a team, willing to pitch in to help others, both a strong team player and individual contributor
  • Must be able to accurately and efficiently multi-task and problem solve in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Must be friendly, outgoing and “people-oriented”; comfortable speaking with people from a variety of backgrounds
  • Must have strong interpersonal and communications skills
  • Proficiency with computers required, and ability to learn software such as Box, Impromed, and Teams
  • Ability to exemplify ASPCA’s core values and behavioral competencies.

Education and Work Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of customer service experience required.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment preferred.
  • Experience handling difficult or emotionally sensitive client interactions preferred.
  • Experience in a veterinary care, animal welfare, healthcare, or nonprofit setting is a plus
  • Experience with any of the following preferred: scheduling, data entry, payment processing, or client record management

Language:

English (Required), Spanish (Required)

Education and Work Experience:

High School Diploma (Required)

Experience in working in a team driven environment, Fear Free® certified, or within 30 days of employment (required), Interest in working with diverse urban populations

title: Distribution Engineer
description:
At Leidos, the opportunities are boundless. We challenge our staff with interesting assignments that provide them with an opportunity to thrive, professionally and personally. For us, helping you grow your career is good business.


Leidos is seeking Distribution Engineers & Designers in the Framingham, MA who are passionate about electric utility design engineering. We’re looking for someone who is dedicated to ensuring that every project, no matter how simple or complex, is of exceptional quality. You'll be working directly with clients to make sure that Leidos' reputation for high-quality work is always maintained. If you join us in this role, you'll gain expertise in a variety of areas, including NESC, Structural Pole Modeling, Electrical Power Calculations, GIS design training, Field Data Collection, and Client Design Standards. Your greatest work is ahead!


This position is hybrid in nature, where 3 days/week are spent working in our office, collaborating with internal teams, and 2 days/week can be spent working remotely.


As a Distribution Engineer / Designer, you can expect to:

  • Perform design engineering for Leidos electric utility customers
  • Develop work packages for OH, UG, URD, and Make Ready, using customer GIS and WMS systems such as EFD, AUD, Smallworld, ArcGIS, Infor, EAM, STORMS, and Maximo
  • Manage scope, schedule, and budget of work assigned.
  • Perform functional tasks, planning, and/or customer follow-up
  • Perform scope analysis of work assigned and maintain schedule adherence to advocate client priorities
  • Initiate continuous improvement to workflow processes that drive efficiency and high-quality standards in client design deliverables
  • Gain experience in coordinating conflicting utilities and other field engineering design requirements, assessing and developing large design packages for complex cable/conduit projects in dense urban environments, work permit development, easements, and ROW applications
  • Be comfortable in both a field and office setting: the role may require local or regional customer-site visits to collect field data that will assist in developing work packages

What Sets You Apart (Background Requirements):

  • 2+ years of prior relevant experience is required.
  • Bachelor's Degree (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Industrial preferred); additional relevant experience/certifications may be considered in lieu of bachelor's degree
  • Experience and demonstrated proficiency with the National Electric Safety Code (NESC)
  • Some Prior experience with structural analysis, guying calcs, cable pulling calcs, coordination of protective devices, and electric demand and fault currents calculations.
  • Ability to provide your own reliable transportation, as some local or regional customer-related travel is anticipated (Job-related travel will be reimbursed at IRS-approved rates).
  • Ability to demonstrate strong written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills

You Might Also Have Some previous experience with:

  • Providing estimated costs, development of a BOM, calculating the CIAC.
  • Design tools such as Pole Foreman, Pull Planner, and Katapult.
  • Work management software and job estimating software.
  • CAD or MicroStation - performing Electrical Distribution design.

Professional Attributes that will help you succeed in this role:

  • Collaborative attitude and inclusivity of individuals of diverse backgrounds and geographic locations.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision
  • Positive attitude
  • Professional dress and demeanor

title: Enterprise Solution Architect - Manufacturing Planning
description:
Blue Yonder Title: Enterprise Solution Architect – Supply Chain Planning


Location: Virtual within the US


Travel required as needed for this role.


Overview

Blue Yonder is a leading SaaS and AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions software product company, and a Glassdoor “Best Places to Work” employer.

We are seeking an Enterprise Solution Architect to join the North America Professional Services team where your core focus is to ensure customers realize value from their Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning solutions.


Scope of role

As part of the Blue Yonder Consulting team, the core focus of this role is to help customers’ get value out of their supply chain by enabling supply chain planning related business processes via the implementation of Blue Yonder Planning solutions.


In this role, your core responsibilities include blueprinting, implementing and advising clients across an end-to-end supply chain scope, extending across Planning and Execution solutions, as well as being on the leading edge with our latest product innovations.


You will be playing a pivotal role as the functional liaison across key stakeholders, including executive project sponsors, key customer contacts, Project Managers, Solution and Technical Architects, to drive the timely and successful delivery of the final solution.


What you’ll do

  • Lead architecture and design discussions for large scale transformational programs and run End-to-End design authorities to ensure compliance and mitigate risk through detailed design and build
  • Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices in architecture and process methodology.
  • Has full command and accountability for the E2E Solution & Application architecture on a project, to enable the intended business value. Maintains a detailed knowledge of the technical integration architecture in the landscape and an ability to support technical design discussions.
  • Supports business process analysis or design/construction phase from an architecture perspective on the project.
  • Ask appropriate questions to assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture constraints.
  • Leads the project team to design and develop functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports and screens to ensure smooth integration between technical and functional business requirements.
  • Create templates and artifacts towards reusability and automation decreasing implementation lifecycle, reducing errors post go-live and efficient support operations.
  • Supports alignment with detailed business process blueprints for a given Domain and sub-vertical by working in collaboration with Consulting Directors
  • Supports Business Consultants or Solution Architects in creating and modifying procedural and system documentation throughout the project.
  • Supports Project Managers in detailed task planning on overall project plan (i.e. during sales cycle, after the project plan is complete, or based on enhancements) with an ability to estimate effort of task level implementation activities that are within the scope of the project and recommend appropriate role to execute those tasks.
  • Ensures knowledge transfer is conducted with key customer project team. Is a thought leader in their Product Solution area of focus and is able to apply that knowledge to customer situations.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations for users, management, and executive level audiences.
  • Liaises between various stakeholders on a project including Blue Yonder Consultants, Customer / partner consultants, Business users, IT, PMO, CM team, Cloud and Product teams to ensure the intended business objectives and value can be realized.
  • Provides primary user non-technical support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity. Provides guidance to support services in responding to base technical issues.
  • Provide guidance to support the development and execution of test scripts to ensure Blue Yonder software consistently meets the customer's business objectives.
  • Performs new product solution validation and end-to-end data flow, solution, interface, workflow & reports, and performance testing. Raise Jira & case tickets & provide feedback to PD/PMG on defects & enhancements.
  • Communicates business cases to PMG and PD regarding customer specific needs related to product functionality and enhancements. Interacts with PMG & PD regarding new releases and new functionality and acts as the liaison to communicate to the rest of the team.
  • Communicates and/or supports the business cases to PMG and PD regarding specific trends for future product functionality and enhancements while also identifying incremental revenue opportunities with existing customers / projects.
  • Provides assistance to identify the Change Management efforts needed for global or regional program implementations.

What we are looking for


Industry and Product Experience:

  • 10 years’ experience in Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning Solutions, specifically in Demand Forecasting and Supply Planning. This experience is required to be considered for the role.
  • In addition to the above, implementation experience or experience using Advanced Planning Solutions from Blue Yonder (including legacy i2 and Manugistics), or other equivalent products such as Kinaxis, o9, SAP APO, Oracle SCM, Logility, e2open, Steelwedge, OMP, etc.
  • Current or prior experience working in a management consulting organization or Supply Chain Center preferred

Skills:

  • Strong business analysis skills, understanding and usage of statistical algorithms, inventory optimization concepts, awareness of tactical planning on overall supply chain required.
  • Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels. Ability to prepare and deliver presentations for user, management, and executive level audiences.

Education:

  • Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research or Logistics preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree and relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of advanced degree.

title: Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist (CIS)/Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (CES)
description:
Summary:

Under the management Cardiac Interventional Services Manager, the Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist (CIS)/Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (CES) is a part of a patient care team that performs various cardiac, neuro and peripheral vascular diagnostic and interventional procedures.

The CIS must possess expertise in the theory and application of cardiovascular/peripheral vascular disease process, procedures specific to their specialty, as well as aseptic technique. The CIS/CES will be able to anticipate the next steps of the procedure by constant attention and assessment of the process and patient condition to promote a safe, expedient, quality patient outcome and positive patient experience.

The CIS/CES will scrub and assist the physician at the procedural table. They will also monitor, identify and record pertinent EKG and hemodynamic data. They will submit charges and document chronological events of the procedure. They will set up,operate and may troubleshoot Equipment pertinent to their specialty. RCIS - Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump (IABP), Rotoblator, Impella, Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR), Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS), CSI in addition to any new technologies. CES - Mapping, Programming, Recording with systems common to the field of electrophysiology. They will act as a resource to the physician by understanding the potential application, risks and benefits of all available procedural supplies and equipment. They will anticipate, gather and deliver required items to the sterile field using aseptic technique.

The CIS will be an active member of a 24/7 call team supporting Cardiac and Neurological emergencies.

Applications: Cerner(CIS), McKesson Horizon Cardiology, Vuemed.

Job Responsibilities:

1) Participates in team huddle/time-out and all aspects of the procedure.

2) Acts as a first assist during cardiovascular and Neurovascular procedures.

3) Maintains, AHA certification in ACLS and Healthcare Provider BLS.

4) Operates and maintains all diagnostic and therapeutic equipment under the direction of the performing physician.

5) Prepares the patient for the procedure in prep/recovery area and procedure room.

6) Explain the process and reinforce patient teachings throughout the procedure.

7) Sets up non-invasive monitoring. (EKG,BP, Pulse Oximetry, etc.)

8) Preps and drapes patients using appropriate aseptic and sterile techniques.

9) Facilitate insertion and manipulation of guide wires and catheters into vasculature under fluoroscopic guidance for cardiovascular and Neurovascular procedures.

10) Obtains invasive hemodynamic data, cardiac output, and blood samples as required by procedure.

11) Injects contrast manually or with the aid of a mechanical contrast device to visualize cardiovascular anatomical structures(angiography).

12) Manages diagnostic and therapeutic modalities. (FFR, IMPELLA, IABP, Angiojet, Rotoblator, CSI) CIS.

13) Performs Point of Care testing.

14) Assist and performs emergency resuscitation.

15) Performs patient monitoring as well as complete and accurate documentation of all aspects of the procedure—captures and inputs data for procedural calculations.

16) Manages access site and hemostasis, manual sheath removal.

17) Attends staff meetings, in-service, and other designated training events that will enhance clinical and other required skills.

18) Performs the minimum of on-call rotations as determined by staffing requirements and manager discretion to ensure competency is maintained. (CIS)

19) Dysrhythmia recognition.

20) Obtains RCES/RCIS within 3 years of Hire, if eligible for the exam.

title: Gastvrouw / Gastheer Bijbaan
description:
Ben jij die vriendelijke, behulpzame en betrokken gastvrouw / gastheer die graag de leden verwelkomt? Heb jij oog voor service en gastvrijheid, en vind je het belangrijk om de club netjes opgeruimd en schoon te houden voor onze leden? Dan is de rol van Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij onze Basic-Fit club in Scheveningen de perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Wij zoeken iemand voor deze leuke bijbaan voor 19,5 uur per week op Dinsdag, Donderdag en Vrijdag 08:30 - 15:00. Spreekt dit jou aan? Lees snel verder!

Dit bieden wij
Werken als Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij Basic-Fit betekent:
• Een bruto startsalaris van €15,17 per uur (vanaf 21 jaar). Ben je geen 21 jaar, dan gelden er aangepaste tarieven: €11,82 per uur (20 jaar), €9,11 per uur (19 jaar), €7,59 per uur (16-18 jaar);
• Vakantietoeslag van 8%;
• Een persoonlijke pensioentoeslag;
• 23 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van 40 uur);
• Reiskostenvergoeding (0,25 cent per km, van 1 tot max. 35 km afstand woon,-werkverkeer);
• Feestdagentoeslag van 50%.

De voordelen van werken bij Basic-Fit
• Bij Basic-Fit geloven we in jouw potentieel. Groei mee met ons mee als internationaal bedrijf en grijp de kans om door te groeien binnen onze organisatie. Je hebt onbeperkt toegang tot alle online trainingen van GoodHabitz.
• Je wordt onderdeel van de Orange Community waar diversiteit gevierd wordt en waar je jezelf mag zijn. Met de Orange Connect App ben je altijd verbonden en up-to-date.
• Wat is er beter dan werken in een omgeving waar gezondheid en fitness voorop staan? Maak gebruik van de mogelijkheid om zelf te sporten en ervaar de energieke en positieve werksfeer.

Zo ziet jouw functie eruit
Iedereen met veel plezier naar de club laten terugkomen, daar doe je het voor! Als Gastvrouw / Gastheer ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt van de club. Met een oprechte glimlach verwelkom je de leden en beantwoord je hun vragen. Je bent actief aanwezig op de werkvloer, stapt op de leden af, maakt een praatje en biedt met veel enthousiasme onze producten aan. Nieuwe leden geef je een rondleiding, adviseer je over onze lidmaatschappen en help je met hun inschrijving. Daarnaast zorg jij ervoor dat onze club tiptop in orde is: als jij er bent, zijn er geen rondslingerende gewichten of rommelige kleedkamers te bekennen. Hoewel je regelmatig jouw diensten alleen draait, werk je als team actief samen aan het resultaat van de club.

Wie zoeken wij?
Als enthousiaste Gastvrouw / Gastheer van Basic-Fit heb je:
• Een gastvrije, servicegerichte en energieke instelling;
• Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel voor het schoon en netjes houden van de club;
• Affiniteit met sport en fitness.

Ook ben je:
• Beschikbaar: het werken op onregelmatige tijden, zoals avonden en weekenden, vormt voor jou geen enkel probleem. De diensten die op de 24/7 clubs worden gedraaid zijn: ma t/m vrij van 08:30 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 21:00 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 14:00 uur. Op de non 24/7 clubs zijn de diensten die gedraaid worden: ma t/m vrij van 07:00 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 22:30 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 16:00 uur;
• Flexibel: je bent in staat om snel te schakelen bij veranderingen en invallen op nabijgelegen clubs zie je als een uitdaging;
• Zelfstandig: je motiveert jezelf en anderen, ziet het werk liggen en pakt dit snel op;
• Behulpzaam: met een enthousiaste houding sta je altijd klaar voor onze leden.

Over Basic-Fit
Basic-Fit is een dynamisch en sterk groeiende organisatie met een duidelijke missie. Inmiddels zijn wij de grootste fitness keten van Europa. Buiten Nederland hebben we clubs in België, Duitsland, Luxemburg, Frankrijk en Spanje. Ons doel is om de komende jaren verder te professionaliseren en door te groeien. Mede dankzij jouw inzet kunnen we onze groei realiseren en dat geeft weer nieuwe mogelijkheden voor jouw carrière om hierin mee te groeien!

Basic-Fit zet zich daarnaast in om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt voor iedereen. Of je nu één van onze leden of medewerkers bent, wij hebben aandacht voor jouw welzijn en focussen ons op diversiteit! Waar je ook voor gaat, wij zijn er om je te ondersteunen en je te helpen met #becomfortable te voelen. Zo kun jij de wereld aan!

Klaar voor de uitdaging? Solliciteer direct!
Wil jij komen werken bij dé grootste fitnessketen van Europa? Solliciteer dan nu via de apply button, bovenaan deze vacature en wellicht maak jij binnenkort deel uit van de Orange Community van Basic-Fit!

Heb je nog een vraag over deze bijbaan? Neem dan contact op met recruitment@basic-fit.nl.

  • Obsessed with mastery - you know what it takes to become good at what you do and are constantly pushing yourself to do it

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Overview

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical leader within AvidXchange's Data Engineering organization responsible for architecting, building, and scaling modern data platforms. In this role, you will drive the migration of legacy Azure SQL Server workloads to Databricks, design real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Kafka, enable AI and agentic capabilities such as Databricks Genie, and define the long-term data architecture strategy. You will partner closely with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, and Analytics teams to deliver secure, high-performing, and reliable data solutions at enterprise scale.

What You'll Do

Data Platform Architecture & Modernization

· Lead the design and implementation of scalable, cloud-native data architectures on Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakehouse patterns).

· Own and execute the migration strategy from legacy Azure SQL Server to Databricks, including schema translation, ETL/ELT re-platforming, data validation, and cutover planning.

· Define data modeling standards (medallion architecture, star/snowflake schemas) and ensure consistency across all pipelines and domains.

· Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and platforms to support long-term data strategy and organizational goals.

· Collaborate with Solution and Enterprise Architects to review and approve new data architecture designs.

Streaming & Real-Time Data Engineering

· Architect and implement Kafka-based streaming pipelines for real-time data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.

· Design event-driven architectures and streaming topologies using Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, or Spark Structured Streaming on Databricks.

· Establish patterns for schema management (Confluent Schema Registry), consumer group strategy, offset management, and dead-letter queuing.

· Ensure streaming pipelines meet SLA requirements for latency, throughput, and fault tolerance.

Optimization, Quality & Standards

· Debug and optimize Spark jobs, Delta Lake tables, and SQL workloads for performance, cost efficiency, and maintainability.

· Lead code reviews focused on senior engineers to enforce standards, best practices, and technical quality.

· Manage pipeline quality, data models, and CI/CD delivery workflows; guide teams on continuous improvement.

· Promote strong data management practices — data quality, lineage, observability, and governance.

· Identify opportunities to improve service delivery methods, processes, and resource utilization.

Leadership, Mentorship & Strategy

· Mentor data engineers at all levels, with particular emphasis on developing senior talent.

· Establish and evolve data engineering standards, best practices, and management of technical debt.

· Stay current on data platform trends (Databricks releases, Kafka ecosystem, open table formats) and contribute to long-term architectural vision.

· Develop plans for data security, disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and archiving across the Lakehouse.

AI, Agentic Capabilities & Intelligent Data Products

· Design and enable AI and agentic capabilities on the Databricks platform, including Databricks Genie for natural language data exploration and self-service analytics.

· Architect data foundations — clean, governed, well-documented Delta tables — that power Genie spaces, AI/BI dashboards, and LLM-driven data agents.

· Collaborate with ML and AI teams to build and maintain feature stores, vector stores, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines on Databricks.

· Evaluate and integrate emerging agentic frameworks (LangChain, Mosaic AI Agent Framework) to automate data workflows and enable intelligent data products.

· Define governance and observability standards for AI-driven data pipelines, ensuring reliability, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Partner with project managers and business leaders on initiatives involving enterprise data.

· Collaborate across teams to influence and strengthen data engineering practices organization-wide.

· Work with Analytics, ML, and product engineers to design and deliver end-to-end data solutions that meet business needs.

What We're Looking For

Required

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of data engineering experience in a high-availability, business-critical environment.

· Hands-on Databricks expertise: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, Databricks SQL, and cluster/job optimization.

· Proven experience migrating from legacy Azure SQL Server (or other relational RDBMS) to a Databricks Lakehouse — schema translation, data validation, and cutover strategies.

· Strong proficiency in Apache Kafka for streaming pipelines — producers/consumers, topic design, partitioning strategy, and Kafka Connect.

· Expert-level PySpark and/or Scala Spark skills, including performance tuning, broadcasting, partitioning, and caching.

· Deep understanding of data architecture patterns: medallion (bronze/silver/gold), Lambda/Kappa, event sourcing, and streaming-first designs.

· Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (ADLS Gen2, Azure Event Hubs, ADF, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor).

· Strong knowledge of infrastructure components — networking, cloud storage (Delta/Parquet), and cloud cost optimization.

Preferred

· Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification.

· Experience with ksqlDB, Kafka Streams, or Spark Structured Streaming for stateful stream processing.

· Confluent Platform experience: Schema Registry, Kafka Connect connectors, RBAC, and cluster management.

· Advanced Azure SQL Server expertise (2018+/Azure SQL MI) — stored procedures, indexing strategies, query plan analysis — valuable for migration contexts.

· Experience with dbt (data build tool) for SQL-based transformation layers on Databricks.

· Proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines for data engineering (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

· Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).

· Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data cataloging (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview), and data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo).

· Familiarity with secure coding practices, including OWASP Top 10 and secrets management.

· Experience implementing DataOps practices: automated testing, data observability, pipeline CI/CD, data contracts, and SLA monitoring across the Lakehouse.

· Hands-on MLOps experience: model versioning (MLflow), experiment tracking, model serving, and integrating ML pipelines with production data workflows on Databricks.

· Familiarity with Databricks Mosaic AI (formerly MLflow + Model Serving) for end-to-end MLOps lifecycle management.

· Experience with real-time ML feature stores or Lakehouse-based ML pipelines is a plus.

About AvidXchange

AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange, mindset is everything. title: Client Service Coordinator
description:
