title: Engineering Functional Lead - Innovation
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Brown Brothers Harriman has a long history of transformation and evolution driven by deep expertise, a passion for solving client problems, and smart applications of technology. Our dedicated innovation practice, Cable 5, is responsible for identifying, investigating, and incubating potential future new businesses, applying a disciplined, stage-gated innovation process from idea sourcing to MVP.


We are currently seeking an Engineering Functional Lead (FL) to join the Cable 5 team. This role is responsible for leading early-stage technical strategy, architecture definition, and feasibility validation for new product concepts. The Engineering FL operates at the intersection of business and engineering across early-stage concepts from idea to Product launch. They sit within an innovation design studio charged with deciding whether a product is worth building before code is written. The Engineering FL leads through technical influence in a multidisciplinary group of largely non-technical peers. As a key technical resource in our innovation discipline, this role will also support the exploration of market opportunities and act as a technical advisor in discussions with external fintechs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide a strong engineering point of view during early-stage product design and iteration by translating ambiguous product ideas into concrete technical approaches, connecting market intent with feasible technical capabilities
  • Work collectively within a multidisciplinary group, syncing internal and external participants to keep technical direction aligned
  • Guide multiple concept teams through ambiguity, ensuring clarity on priorities, sequencing, and execution strategy
  • Assess technical implications of concept tests and product direction decisions, translating them into clear architecture strategies
  • Lead structured feasibility assessments to uncover risks, constraints, and dependencies tied to product direction
  • Explain technical choices and the reasoning behind them in clear language for non-technical peers and senior leaders
  • Develop financial models for technical aspects of a product’s business plan, including build cost, operating cost, and unit economics. Responsible for the integration into the broader build/operate cost model
  • Partner with internal and external groups to assess the state of technical capabilities across relevant sectors and determine whether our concepts have a differentiated technology-driven right to win
  • Partner with BBH enterprise architecture to ensure alignment and known divergence with broader IT and security standards
  • Support the development of prototypes, technical interfaces, and lightweight implementations to validate product concepts
  • Provide oversight and guidance of external development partners which can align to BBH innovation standards and practices
  • Collaborate closely with fellow Functional Leads (Design, Research Product, etc.) and senior leaders to ensure alignment with technical aspects of each product concept

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10-15 years proven experience leading technical design and architecture for complex, greenfield products, ideally with extensive experience delivering cloud-based and/or enterprise-grade B2B solutions
  • Strong experience with modern application architectures (cloud-native, APIs, SaaS platforms, AI/ML, Generative AI where applicable)
  • Demonstrated ability to estimate complex, multi-layered projects and navigate uncertainty in new technology environments
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex systems and identify risks and tradeoffs
  • Intellectual curiosity and creativity, with the proven ability to communicate complex topics to non-technical and senior audiences
  • Comfort working in cross-functional environments alongside concept owners, designers, researchers, and engineers
  • Comfort working with abstract concepts, navigating ambiguity, lean testing, and agile ways of working in early-stage concept development.
  • Experience in Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)
  • Background in financial modeling for technology investments or product unit economics
  • Industry experience relevant to digital product innovation

What we offer:


  • To encourage cultural awareness and philanthropy, BBHers have 1 Culture Celebration Day and 1 Community Service Day in addition to their paid standard vacation allowance
  • Task based working system
  • Private medical care
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - offering independent and confidential counselling services for you and your family. You can get support for topics including family, marriage and relationships, finances, and legal issues.
  • Professional trainings and qualification support
  • Wellbeing Program
  • Online Social Fund benefit platform
  • Social, sport and integration events
  • Onboarding Program for new hires

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

title: Strategy & Business Analyst
description:
Position Overview

This position is responsible for providing systematic, objective, and traceable data analysis and decision support for corporate strategic planning, market entry, store network development, major investments, new businesses, enterprise systems, and resource allocation.

Through research on industry trends, competitors, consumers, regional markets, store operations, and internal company data, identify growth opportunities, strategic risks, and resource-allocation issues; develop business models, scenario analyses, and strategic KPI dashboards to help the CEO, CSO, and management make evidence-based decisions.

This position is accountable for the accuracy of analytical materials, logical completeness, reasonableness of assumptions, data sources, timely delivery, and quality of decision support. It does not replace the CFO in issuing formal financial conclusions, the Expansion Department in conducting specific site selection, or Merchandising, Marketing, or Operations in owning business operating results.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Industry Trends & Competitive Intelligence
    1. Continuously research industry trends in U.S. chain retail, Asian lifestyle consumption, beauty, snacks, collectibles, household goods, private label, OEM, e-commerce, and supply chain.
    2. Build a database of major competitor brands and track store count, market footprint, store formats, size, merchandise mix, price bands, brand positioning, promotions, membership programs, and expansion activities.
    3. Identify industry changes, competitive entry, business-model shifts, and potential substitution risks, and produce periodic analyses.
    4. Conduct special studies on significant competitive events and assess their impact on TESO stores, merchandise, brand, and expansion strategy.
    5. All research conclusions must identify data sources, dates, assumptions, and information limitations.
  3. Consumer, Trade Area & Market Insights
    1. Partner with Marketing, Operations, Merchandising, and Data teams to study consumer segmentation, purchasing behavior, brand awareness, consumer needs, and repeat-purchase drivers.
    2. Analyze differences in sales, category mix, average transaction value, and consumer preferences across cities, regions, store types, and customer segments.
    3. Research demographics, spending power, student, tourism, office, residential, and trade-area characteristics to support market-entry and store-format planning.
    4. Integrate surveys, interviews, store feedback, membership data, social trends, and external research to develop consumer insights.
    5. Consumer research is used for strategic and business decisions and does not replace Marketing’s responsibility for brand communications or marketing execution.
  5. Corporate Strategic Metrics & Business Analysis
    1. Support the CSO in building the corporate strategic metric tree and management strategic dashboard, translating the company’s 3–5 year strategy into annual and quarterly metrics.
    2. Integrate strategic data across sales, profit, cash, store openings, merchandise, inventory, supply chain, organization, systems, and new businesses.
    3. Analyze gaps between targets and actual results and identify trends, structural issues, primary causes, and potential impacts.
    4. Prepare data, charts, analytical conclusions, and decision items for quarterly strategic business reviews.
    5. Document data definitions, sources, update dates, and calculation logic; promptly flag inconsistent definitions across departments and drive alignment.
    6. Do not modify original financial, business, or system data without authorization.
  7. U.S. Store Network & Market Entry Analysis
    1. Support development of the U.S. store network plan by analyzing target regions, city clusters, market capacity, management span, and entry sequencing.
    2. Build city and market scoring models using demographics, customer segments, rent, competition, supply chain, talent, regional management capability, and existing store performance.
    3. Analyze the suitability of different store formats, sizes, category mixes, and investment models across markets.
    4. Analyze store density, spacing, potential sales cannibalization, warehouse/distribution radius, and regional economies of scale.
    5. Conduct 6-, 12-, and 24-month post-opening reviews for new markets and store cohorts, comparing original forecasts with actual results.
    6. The Expansion Department owns specific site development, field surveys, lease negotiations, and contract execution; this role owns city-, regional-, network-, and investment-model analysis.
  9. Business Cases, Scenario Analysis & Capital Project Analysis
    1. Develop business cases for new stores, warehousing, systems, OEM, private label, e-commerce, wholesale, new businesses, and strategic partnership projects.
    2. Define market size, key assumptions, investment amount, revenue sources, cost structure, gross margin, break-even point, payback period, organizational capabilities, and major risks.
    3. Build base, upside, cautious, and stress scenarios and analyze how changes in key variables affect project outcomes.
    4. Partner with the CFO and Finance to validate financial definitions, budgets, cash, and return models; formal financial conclusions are confirmed by the CFO and Finance.
    5. Compare alternative options for major projects, clearly identifying benefits, risks, resource requirements, and exit conditions for each option.
    6. After implementation, conduct post-investment or post-project reviews against the original business case to analyze forecast variance and realized value.
  11. Strategic Growth & New Business Analysis
    1. Research growth opportunities in new regions, new store formats, e-commerce, omnichannel, wholesale, private label, OEM platforms, and other areas.
    2. Assess candidate opportunities based on market size, consumer demand, competitive landscape, business model, and company capabilities.
    3. Support pilot design by defining test scope, target metrics, budget, timeline, owner, and exit criteria.
    4. Continuously track pilot data to determine whether conditions support scaling, optimization, continued observation, or termination.
    5. Avoid presenting only favorable data; accurately disclose key risks, invalid assumptions, and causes of project failure.
  13. Major Decisions & Management Materials Support
    1. Prepare analytical materials for strategic planning, major projects, market entry, and resource allocation based on the needs of the CEO, CSO, and management.
    2. Provide industry, competition, growth, store network, and strategic project analysis for Board and investor materials.
    3. Ensure consistency in data, definitions, and strategic logic used by management, the Board, and investors.
    4. Translate complex data into clear conclusions, key judgments, option comparisons, and action recommendations.
    5. Ensure all significant conclusions are traceable to original data, calculation logic, and information sources.
    6. Do not provide company analytical materials to external institutions, investors, or media without approval.
  15. Analytical Models, Data Assets & Team Management
    1. Build and maintain analytical databases covering industry, competition, markets, store networks, consumers, and strategic projects.
    2. Standardize templates for business cases, city scoring, scenario analysis, strategic dashboards, and post-project evaluations.
    3. Regularly review model formulas, links, data versions, assumptions, and cited sources to prevent use of incorrect versions.
    4. Establish review mechanisms for important analytical models; materials for major decisions should generally undergo a second-person review.
    5. Manager-level roles are responsible for assigning analytical work, professional review, coaching, and analytical-method development; analyst-level roles focus on executing research and models.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in strategic management, economics, finance, statistics, business analytics, market research, information systems, or related fields preferred.
  • Professional Experience: 2-4 years of experience in corporate strategy, consulting, investment analysis, business analysis, retail analysis, or related fields; demonstrated ability to independently complete complex analyses, business models, and management decision-support materials.
  • Industry Experience: Experience in chain retail, consumer goods, multi-store companies, commercial real estate, or new-business analysis preferred.
  • Knowledge & Skills: Industry research, consumer analysis, competitive analysis, business modeling, financial fundamentals, scenario analysis, market entry, store-network analysis, and strategic performance analysis.
  • Tools: Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and BI tools; SQL, Power BI, Tableau, mapping, or demographic-data analysis skills preferred.
  • Core Competencies: Logical analysis, business acumen, data accuracy, independent research, structured communication, critical thinking, confidentiality, and results orientation.
  • Language: Strong ability to research source materials, write, and communicate verbally in both English and Chinese.


Compensation

  • $72,000-$80,000 per year
  • Quarterly Performance Bonus: This position is eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus, subject to the eligibility requirements, performance criteria, and terms of the Company's bonus program.

Benefits

  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching - subject to the eligibility requirements

title: Gastvrouw / Gastheer Bijbaan
description:
Ben jij die vriendelijke, behulpzame en betrokken gastvrouw / gastheer die graag de leden verwelkomt? Heb jij oog voor service en gastvrijheid, en vind je het belangrijk om de club netjes opgeruimd en schoon te houden voor onze leden? Dan is de rol van Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij onze Basic-Fit club in Uden de perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Wij zoeken iemand voor deze leuke bijbaan voor 10 - 12 uur per week Zaterdag en Zondag. Spreekt dit jou aan? Lees snel verder!

Dit bieden wij
Werken als Gastvrouw / Gastheer bij Basic-Fit betekent:
• Een bruto startsalaris van €15,17 per uur (vanaf 21 jaar). Ben je geen 21 jaar, dan gelden er aangepaste tarieven: €11,82 per uur (20 jaar), €9,11 per uur (19 jaar), €7,59 per uur (16-18 jaar);
• Vakantietoeslag van 8%;
• Een persoonlijke pensioentoeslag;
• 23 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van 40 uur);
• Reiskostenvergoeding (0,25 cent per km, van 1 tot max. 35 km afstand woon,-werkverkeer);
• Feestdagentoeslag van 50%.

De voordelen van werken bij Basic-Fit
• Bij Basic-Fit geloven we in jouw potentieel. Groei mee met ons mee als internationaal bedrijf en grijp de kans om door te groeien binnen onze organisatie. Je hebt onbeperkt toegang tot alle online trainingen van GoodHabitz.
• Je wordt onderdeel van de Orange Community waar diversiteit gevierd wordt en waar je jezelf mag zijn. Met de Orange Connect App ben je altijd verbonden en up-to-date.
• Wat is er beter dan werken in een omgeving waar gezondheid en fitness voorop staan? Maak gebruik van de mogelijkheid om zelf te sporten en ervaar de energieke en positieve werksfeer.

Zo ziet jouw functie eruit
Iedereen met veel plezier naar de club laten terugkomen, daar doe je het voor! Als Gastvrouw / Gastheer ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt van de club. Met een oprechte glimlach verwelkom je de leden en beantwoord je hun vragen. Je bent actief aanwezig op de werkvloer, stapt op de leden af, maakt een praatje en biedt met veel enthousiasme onze producten aan. Nieuwe leden geef je een rondleiding, adviseer je over onze lidmaatschappen en help je met hun inschrijving. Daarnaast zorg jij ervoor dat onze club tiptop in orde is: als jij er bent, zijn er geen rondslingerende gewichten of rommelige kleedkamers te bekennen. Hoewel je regelmatig jouw diensten alleen draait, werk je als team actief samen aan het resultaat van de club.

Wie zoeken wij?
Als enthousiaste Gastvrouw / Gastheer van Basic-Fit heb je:
• Een gastvrije, servicegerichte en energieke instelling;
• Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel voor het schoon en netjes houden van de club;
• Affiniteit met sport en fitness.

Ook ben je:
• Beschikbaar: het werken op onregelmatige tijden, zoals avonden en weekenden, vormt voor jou geen enkel probleem. De diensten die op de 24/7 clubs worden gedraaid zijn: ma t/m vrij van 08:30 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 21:00 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 14:00 uur. Op de non 24/7 clubs zijn de diensten die gedraaid worden: ma t/m vrij van 07:00 tot 15:00 uur of van 15:00 tot 22:30 uur, en op za/zo van 09:00 tot 16:00 uur;
• Flexibel: je bent in staat om snel te schakelen bij veranderingen en invallen op nabijgelegen clubs zie je als een uitdaging;
• Zelfstandig: je motiveert jezelf en anderen, ziet het werk liggen en pakt dit snel op;
• Behulpzaam: met een enthousiaste houding sta je altijd klaar voor onze leden.

Over Basic-Fit
Basic-Fit is een dynamisch en sterk groeiende organisatie met een duidelijke missie. Inmiddels zijn wij de grootste fitness keten van Europa. Buiten Nederland hebben we clubs in België, Duitsland, Luxemburg, Frankrijk en Spanje. Ons doel is om de komende jaren verder te professionaliseren en door te groeien. Mede dankzij jouw inzet kunnen we onze groei realiseren en dat geeft weer nieuwe mogelijkheden voor jouw carrière om hierin mee te groeien!

Basic-Fit zet zich daarnaast in om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt voor iedereen. Of je nu één van onze leden of medewerkers bent, wij hebben aandacht voor jouw welzijn en focussen ons op diversiteit! Waar je ook voor gaat, wij zijn er om je te ondersteunen en je te helpen met #becomfortable te voelen. Zo kun jij de wereld aan!

Klaar voor de uitdaging? Solliciteer direct!
Wil jij komen werken bij dé grootste fitnessketen van Europa? Solliciteer dan nu via de apply button, bovenaan deze vacature en wellicht maak jij binnenkort deel uit van de Orange Community van Basic-Fit!

Heb je nog een vraag over deze bijbaan? Neem dan contact op met recruitment@basic-fit.nl.

The Automation Control Technician is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing automated manufacturing systems. Ideal candidates will bring a comprehensive educational background in Mechatronics and a strong understanding of industrial automation principles.

  • Assist with installation, debugging, and start-up of new equipment in collaboration with Engineering.
  • Maintain detailed equipment logs and document process changes.
  • Support and adjust vision systems and other automated inspection tools.
  • Provide support and collaborate with production teams to resolve equipment issues.
  • Promote and adhere to safety, environmental, and quality system requirements.

1. Equipment Setup & Maintenance

  • Successfully help Setup and maintain electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical systems on production equipment by working with operators, line leads, and engineering
  • Ensure all systems are calibrated and function according to specifications. Help to execute and maintain machine challenges and parts.

2. Preventive Maintenance Execution

  • Complete scheduled preventive maintenance tasks as outlined in the PM program.
  • Document maintenance activities and flag potential issues before they cause downtime.

3. Troubleshooting & Repairs

  • Diagnose and resolve equipment issues using foundational knowledge of:
  • PLC systems
  • Ohm’s Law
  • Hydraulics (Tubes, Injection Molding, Rubber Molding)
  • Use schematics and technical documentation to guide repairs.

4. Process Improvement Support

  • Collaborate with Engineering to identify and implement process improvements that enhance output and reduce waste.
  • Provide feedback on equipment performance and suggest optimization opportunities.

5. Documentation & Reporting

  • Accurately complete and maintain quality-related documentation in compliance with regulatory agencies and our customers.
  • Maintain accurate equipment logs, including downtime, maintenance actions, and process changes.
  • Report on performance metrics and issues to supervisors and engineering teams.

6. Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all safety protocols, environmental regulations, and Quality System Requirements (QSR).
  • Ensure work areas and equipment meet compliance standards.

7. Team Collaboration

  • Support and guide production associates during equipment troubleshooting.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and cross-functional teams.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, or Abilities (KSA’s):

  • Analyzing schematics and wiring diagrams
  • Understanding and applying Ohm’s Law
  • Troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems

title: Instructional Coach
description:
About the role

To empower and support educators in their professional growth and development, enhancing instructional practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. The Instructional coach will collaborate with teachers and administrators to identify areas of instructional need, provide targeted and personalized coaching, and facilitate the implementation of evidence-based teaching strategies. By leveraging their expertise and mentoring skills, the Instructional Coach aims to improve student learning outcomes, promote reflective teaching practices, and contribute to the overall advancement of teaching excellence throughout the school community.

What you'll do

Curriculum & Instruction:

  • Trains all new and existing teachers on the curriculum used throughout the academy in accordance with the charter contract. If acting as the designated Literacy Coach, as well, this position trains all teachers in literacy programs.
  • Provides support with the implementation of progress monitoring.
  • Support the Academy leader by instilling instruction, culture, and climate throughout the Academy.
  • Engages in reflective practice with teachers including observing, modeling, co-planning etc.

Assessment & Data:

  • Monitor, support and evaluate student achievement in both growth and proficiency.
  • Use student data to evaluate the impact of teachers’ development strategies and classroom interventions in student learning.
  • Trains teachers on testing expectations and provides support in preparing students for summative testing.
  • Generates reports to analyze low and high performing students and furthermore, designs interventions to support them.
  • Demonstrate to teachers on how to Desegregate data for Title 1 and help and determine what will be school focus and grade level focus for intervention.
  • Demonstrate to teachers on how to monitor and evaluate student achievement in both growth and proficiency.
  • Demonstrate to teachers on how to use student data to evaluate the impact of teachers’ development strategies and classroom interventions in student learning.

Leadership & Coaching:

  • Serves as a key member of the academy leadership team.
  • Conduct weekly meetings with school leadership.
  • Shares responsibility for the achievement of students.
  • Works as Lead Mentor for all new teachers.
  • Stays up to date on current trends and practices in education; specifically looking at innovative ideas that match with the model’s philosophy.
  • Conducts coaching through classroom observations (using DERS and TeachPoint) and one-on-one meetings with teachers.
  • Keeps detailed records related to coaching sessions and feedback shared with teachers.
  • Provides feedback on classroom environments, instructional practices, lesson plans, child interactions and adult interactions to help educators grow and excel.
  • Supports the development of the teacher assistants so their work is in alignment with the curriculum and appropriate interventions.
  • Works with the special teachers, literacy coach, math interventionist, and reading interventionists to ensure their interventions are in alignment with the curriculum.
  • Works to ensure any teacher in an alternative pathway program has a firm grasp on classroom management and the curriculum.

Other:

  • Demonstrates exceptional classroom techniques, which include the art of questioning, clarity of assignments, communicating, an atmosphere of mutual respect, independent thought and expression, and student and teacher experiences in large and small groups.
  • Uses resources effectively to support learning in the classroom, the Academy and the community.
  • Participates in PLC meetings.
  • Communicates with the Curriculum Specialist at Choice Schools on a monthly basis.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

  • Valid Michigan teaching certificate.
  • Able to use technology as an instructional tool in the classroom as a means of analyzing academic achievement data and as a tool to aid effective communications.
  • Exemplary work habits verified by reference checks.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Masters degree and either advanced coursework in reading or complete on of professional development in evidence-based literacy instructional strategies.
  • Demonstrated competence as a teacher in all areas of focus.
  • Knowledge of, and experience teaching, the academic curriculum.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written expression using proper grammar and vocabulary.

About Choice Schools Associates

Battle Creek Montessori Academy (BCMA) is part of the Choice Schools Community. As a comprehensive education service provider, Choice Schools offers a student-centered approach to tailored school operations support. Much like a superintendent's office, Choice Schools provides invaluable assistance in various crucial areas, including instruction, professional development, curriculum, human resources, finance, compliance, communications, and enrollment. By being a part of the Choice Schools Montessori Model, BCMA is a vibrant community of learning, comprised of multiple other outstanding Montessori schools within the state. The Montessori Model will provide you with the support and collaboration of a large district while serving at a tight-knit community school in your area.

description:
Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM)

Clearance Level - High (Active or eligibility to gain DV STRAP)

Location: Huntingdon UK

UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL

The Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) is part of the Service Management team (ITAM Team) and provides consistent & efficient management of Assets and Service Configurations within the service for Leidos customers. The primary objective of the SACM Lead is to use the Leidos SACM product set (People, Process, Technology etc.) to define and manage the configuration elements of services that are user-centric. Responsible for the delivery of cost effective SACM Management that achieves customer’s requirements, meets mission needs and which can be fully integrated with the customer’s service.

Service Delivery

  • Reporting into the Service Delivery Manager (SDM) and ITAM Team lead to ensure the SACM service model is fit for operational purpose, support and management (maintainable and adaptable) and in line with the Customer and Leidos Configuration Management strategy.

  • All SACM aspects, contribute to the creating Configuration Management Plans and associated Configuration Management documentation e.g. Data Dictionary & Data Modelling Guide, along with the common sub-processes to support development of the SACM solution.

  • Collaborating with Service Architect and Engineers to develop the SACM architecture.

  • Support defining and delivering the discovery interface control mechanism as selected from the supported interfaces defined in the Interface Control Documents (ICD).

  • Collaborating with Programme or Project Management to lead on the SACM elements of delivery to enable the transition of the service into live production.

  • Collaborating with Programme or Project Management and Leidos procurement to ensure the identification and managed introduction of new or replacement Assets and Configuration Items.

  • Identifying and managing SACM related risks, dependencies and issues appropriately aligned to the Service Delivery Plan.

  • Involvement in transitioning new SACM services from Projects to Business as Usual (BAU) through formal Service Transition processes and Service Readiness Review gates.

  • Liaising with Programme Management, Service Delivery and customers to assure delivery of quality SACM service products on time and to budget.

  • Ensuring teams involved with delivery of the SACM service have their processes and supporting artefacts.

  • Supporting transformation of the customer organisation to manage Assets and Service Configurations.

  • Working closely with the Service Operations team to ensure that implemented or changed services are capable of delivering to target service levels and performance indicators.

Service Operations

  • Reporting to the Service Delivery Manager (SDM) and ITAM Lead to ensure the SACM service model is operational, support and management and in line with the Customer and Leidos SACM design.

  • Assistant ownership of the SACM Process, associated documentation and tooling e.g. CMDB to maintain and manage Service Configurations and Assets.

  • Manage SACM Audits and Verifications.

  • Liaising with Programme Management, Service Operations and customers to assure the quality of SACM service products, including co-ordinating with the Change Manager.

  • Ensuring teams using elements of the SACM service follow the processes and supporting artefacts.

  • Manage Assets and Service Configurations to maintain services.

  • Working closely with the Service Operations team to ensure that implemented or changed services deliver to target service levels and performance indicators.

CSI

  • Championing SACM and associated processes and procedures within the organisation, operating within the ITIL frameworks and compliant with ISO20000 where it is a defined deliverable for the customer.

  • Identifying areas of improvement.

  • Establishing CSI mechanisms for the life of the service.

You will have experience in managing SACM solutions within enterprise environments. Good understanding of the SACM IT technologies infrastructure components and business processes. Highly experienced and qualified in service management frameworks (ITIL) and their practical implementation with regard to SACM. The SACM must have:

  • Knowledge of SACM concepts and techniques.

  • An operational understanding of supply chains.

  • Experience of SACM for major IT systems and services.

  • Experience of supporting SACM activities and delivering and maintaining Assets and Service Configurations for customers.

  • The ability to write coherent, concise, and readable technical documentation.

  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

  • Experience of developing service based process and procedures in a commercial environment.

  • Experience of driving through service improvement activities.

  • Understanding of how technology, process, tools and people combine together to provide effective SACM solutions.

  • Experience in selecting and applying SACM principles, policies and techniques in client operational environments.

  • The ability to work under pressure and to deadlines; with a flexible and pragmatic approach.

  • Awareness and understanding of Change and Problem Management, maintaining Service Levels, ITSCM and Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills including presenting.

  • Client Relationship Management - Build effective relationships with client team at all levels.

  • Understanding of SecDevOps function and agile development methodologies.

  • Experience and knowledge of financial management, cost centre control and project planning and delivery.

It is desirable for the SACM Lead to have:

  • As awareness of Asset and Configuration Management Tooling technologies and how they can be used and configure to best serve our customers.

title: Senior QA Engineer II
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Senior QA Engineer II will lead quality efforts for products supporting healthcare providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. This role combines hands-on testing with technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is self-directed, organized, and committed to delivering reliable, accessible, and user-centered products.

This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to establish quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze business requirements, architecture, interfaces, integrations, and dependencies to develop comprehensive, risk-based test strategies.
  • Define and improve quality standards, testing practices, and processes across the team and partner teams.
  • Create and maintain test strategies, plans, cases, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications, including exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, end-to-end, and UI testing.
  • Define and advance test automation standards and coverage, balancing product risk with reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Test REST APIs and backend services for correctness, reliability, and resilience.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects and quality risks through resolution.
  • Lead root cause analysis with engineers to resolve defects and prevent recurrence.
  • Communicate test strategy, quality risks, release readiness, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify systemic quality and process issues, align the appropriate stakeholders, and drive practical improvements through completion.
  • Mentor engineers and other team members to strengthen quality practices and shared ownership of quality.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence and delivery speed.
  • Evaluate web and mobile applications against applicable accessibility requirements, including WCAG, through manual and automated testing.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing based on product risk and team needs.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of professional software quality assurance experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading quality initiatives across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Deep knowledge of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and risk-based testing for complex systems.
  • Strong understanding of web and mobile technologies, client-server architecture, APIs, integrations, and system dependencies.
  • Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform mobile applications on iOS and Android, including testing across devices, operating-system versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java.
  • Experience developing or improving test automation frameworks, standards, coverage, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Experience using modern web or mobile automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows.
  • Knowledge of accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG, with experience using tools such as Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test-management tools, such as Jira, in an Agile development environment.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks and technical tradeoffs to varied audiences.
  • A record of driving cross-functional quality or process improvements through completion.
  • Experience mentoring technical and non-technical colleagues and building quality capability across teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

title: Technical Analyst INT
description:
Mid-level technical analyst who ensures operational reliability of services by diagnosing and resolving incidents, improving runbooks and automation, monitoring batch jobs and integrations, and partnering with engineering and product teams to deliver stable, observable systems.

Key responsibilities
  • Lead triage and resolution of medium-to-high priority incidents; coordinate cross-functional responders and communicate status to stakeholders.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes or reliable workarounds; run post-incident reviews and track corrective actions.
  • Maintain and improve runbooks, playbooks, monitoring, alerting and operational automation to reduce manual toil.
  • Monitor, validate and troubleshoot scheduled batch jobs, ETL pipelines and integrations; manage reruns, dependency chains and capacity issues.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and operational reports to surface trends, capacity needs and SLA adherence.
  • Support releases, configuration changes and integration testing; validate rollback plans and deployment impacts.
  • Identify recurring issues and translate them into prioritized product/engineering improvements.
  • Mentor junior analysts and contribute to onboarding, documentation and best practices.

Required qualifications
  • 3–5 years experience in technical operations, support engineering, SRE, or systems administration.

  • Hands-on experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK) and incident management (PagerDuty, OpsGenie, ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Wireperson Service
description:
A wireperson is responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining electrical systems and components. They work with various types of wiring, cables, and connectors to ensure proper functioning of electrical equipment and systems. Wirepersons may read and interpret electrical schematics and blueprints, and they often work closely with electricians and other technicians to complete projects. They must adhere to safety regulations and follow industry standards to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical system.

Essential Responsibilities
• Use hand tools (e.g. crimpers, strippers, torquing tools, calibrating tools, etc.) to perform tasks.
• Run and bundle wires according to Powell wiring standards.
• Layout, install, drill and tap devices onto doors and back pans.
• Install name plates and space heaters.
• Install and terminate CTs.
• Operate continuity buzzers.
• Terminate and run wire for MCC, SWGR, and harnesses according to wire diagram.
• Promote a safety culture as well as attend all safety meetings.
• Ensure that work areas remain clean and well organized.
• Perform in process inspections

Minimum Qualifications
• Minimum education level of a High School Diploma or General Education Equivalent Diploma is preferred.
• Ability to read and understand point-to-point wiring diagrams
• Ability to read and use a tape measure
• Must have a basic command of the English language, both written and verbal.
• Safely use variety of hand/power tools.
• Lift up to 50lbs using proper lifting techniques.

Preferred Qualifications
• Basic computer knowledge considered and asset.
• Knowledge of calibration
• Read and understand spec sheet and master copy drawing.

Skills, Abilities & Other Requirements
• Positive attitude.
• Willingness to learn.
• Ability to follow direction from Senior Assemblers and Lead Assemblers.
• Effectively demonstrates on-time delivery and the ability to stay focused on goals and responsibilities.
• Self-starter with ability to take on multiple tasks with a drive to succeed.
• Challenges the status quo; looks for better or more efficient ways to get results.
• Ability to adapt to new ideas, technology, processes or product changes.
• Believes and displays through actions that our customers represent our current success and remain vital to our future growth.
• Demonstrates integrity and ethical decision making.
• Conscientious, thorough, accurate, and reliable when performing and completing job tasks.
• Able to work effectively within your team and around other departments and their activities.
• Ability to learn and adhere to all manufacturing policies and practices to ensure adherence to ISO requirements.

Working Conditions

• Safety sensitive position in a temperature-controlled manufacturing or industrial environment with occasional outside activities.
• Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times (i.e., hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety harnesses as required) and respirators when required.
• Must be able to work from all type of ladders (step ladders, "A" frame ladders and all size extension ladders) and scaffolding.
• Working at heights usually no higher than 30 feet in the air on or using proper lift equipment.

Physical Requirements

• Able to maintain body equilibrium and agility to prevent falling when walking, standing, crouching, ascending or descending stairs.
• Bending the body at the waist, the legs at the knees, and extending arms and hands in any direction in a repetitive manner continuously.
• Continuous standing, walking 50–300-foot distances for long periods of time with only occasional sitting.
• Must be able to climb stairs frequently throughout the shift.
• Able to frequently look over shoulders, work with both arms above shoulders and use both arms at full length frequently.
• Using upper extremities to apply or exert a force continuously up to 50lbs.
• Frequent use of hand tools such as tin snips, hammer, and power tools (some vibrating), for long periods of time.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
The Undersea Systems Division at Leidos currently has an opening for a Senior Systems Engineer to support a customer site in San Diego, California. This is an exciting opportunity to apply systems engineering, naval operations, test and evaluation, and technical project-management experience in support of large-scale fleet activities and critical maritime missions.


The selected candidate will serve as the onsite Senior Systems Engineer and senior technical representative, working closely with the Leidos Project Manager, customer leadership, engineers, fleet personnel, operational stakeholders, and government representatives. The position will support day-to-day onsite execution of program activities while also contributing directly to systems engineering, integration, test, and evaluation efforts.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the onsite senior technical representative for Leidos at the customer site in San Diego.
  • Work side by side with customer leadership and technical personnel to support day-to-day program execution and mission priorities.
  • Support the Leidos Project Manager with program planning, execution, customer coordination, schedule management, risk management, and delivery of program commitments.
  • Lead and coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder organizations.
  • Translate customer operational needs into technically sound engineering approaches, priorities, requirements, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with engineers, subcontractors, fleet personnel, operators, government stakeholders, and program leadership to resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Track technical scope, milestones, schedules, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Maintain project-management artifacts, including project plans, schedules, milestone trackers, risk and issue registers, action-item logs, and status reports.
  • Identify schedule, resource, technical, interface, cost, or performance concerns and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Facilitate technical interchange meetings, program reviews, working groups, integrated product team meetings, and customer engagements.
  • Guide engineering teams in systems architecture, requirements analysis, systems integration, interface definition, verification and validation, and technical documentation.
  • Review engineering products and ensure technical deliverables are accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with customer and program requirements.
  • Support development and review of engineering analyses, technical assessments, system requirements, design documentation, integration plans, and program deliverables.
  • Support test and evaluation planning, assessment, and reporting activities as needed; extensive at-sea testing is not expected to be the primary responsibility.
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, program-status updates, decision presentations, risk updates, and recommendations to senior military and government leadership.
  • Analyze technical and operational information to identify deficiencies, risks, limitations, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate responses to customer requests and ensure follow-up actions are completed on schedule.
  • Support program planning, resource coordination, subcontractor or partner coordination, and preparation of technical inputs for contract deliverables.
  • Provide technical and program leadership during periods of increased operational activity or surge support.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagements, program activities, fleet events, and occasional demonstrations or assessments.
  • Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from engineers and operators to senior military and government leaders.
  • Support other systems engineering, technical leadership, and Deputy Project Manager activities as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, naval architecture, mechanical engineering, ocean engineering, electrical engineering, project management, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, naval engineering, maritime operations, fleet support, technical leadership, program management, or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex maritime, naval, shipboard, submarine, underwater, or other defense systems.
  • Experience working directly with customer, government, military, engineering, or operational stakeholders to address technical requirements and mission needs.
  • Experience leading or coordinating engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines or organizations.
  • Experience supporting program execution, including schedule management, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, stakeholder coordination, and status reporting.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or managing technical documentation, engineering analyses, requirements, system designs, integration products, or program deliverables.
  • Experience analyzing technical or operational information and communicating recommendations through written products, briefings, status reports, and presentations.
  • Experience facilitating technical meetings, program reviews, working groups, or customer engagements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a customer-facing environment alongside senior government, military, engineering, and program personnel.
  • Ability to balance systems engineering responsibilities with onsite Deputy Project Manager duties.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including overseas travel several times per year.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as a Deputy Project Manager, Assistant Project Manager, technical lead, chief engineer, or equivalent onsite program representative.
  • Experience coordinating across government organizations, engineering teams, fleet personnel, contractors, operational commands, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience with software development, scripting, or software-intensive systems.
  • Technical competency with Linux operating systems and environments.
  • Experience with maritime command-and-control, communications, combat systems, unmanned systems, or related mission technologies.
  • Graduate degree in engineering, systems engineering, project management, or a related technical discipline.
  • DAWIA, Defense Acquisition Corps, INCOSE, PMP, or other relevant professional certification.
  • Experience supporting classified programs, defense acquisition, operational planning, intelligence organizations, or government technical agencies.

title: Senior Director, Data Science
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is seeking a Senior Director of Consumer Data Science to lead a multi-team organization that partners across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and the broader business. You will set the strategy and operating model for consumer data science, strengthen the systems and standards that make scientific outputs reliable, actionable, and scalable, and guide high-impact decisions through measurement, experimentation, causal inference, and ML.

This leader will help define how Reddit measures and improves relevance across the consumer journey—from retrieval and ranking to feed, search, recommendations, and community discovery—and will shape the organizational capabilities required to advance these systems over the long term. Accordingly, the role requires the technical depth to evaluate architecture and analytical investments, guide state-of-the-art ML system improvements, and the leadership presence to align senior leaders around difficult tradeoffs.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with senior leaders across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and business functions to define company-level bets, priorities, and tradeoffs.
  • Set the data science strategy for Reddit’s feed, recommendation, search, retrieval, and ranking systems, including objective design, candidate generation, ranking quality, relevance evaluation, experimentation, and long-term optimization.
  • Establish the measurement and experimentation framework for relevance optimization, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, counterfactual analysis, guardrail metrics, metric integrity, and the connection between model improvements and consumer and community outcomes.
  • Translate complex user and community behavior into clear, impartial insights that improve product strategy and consumer outcomes.
  • Establish durable standards for measurement, experimentation, causal inference, reproducibility, privacy, responsible AI use, and self-serve measurement, at scale.
  • Build multi-team roadmaps, operating cadences, and clear accountability that turn company direction into durable delivery.
  • Exercise strong technical judgment across architecture choices, analytical systems, hiring, and sponsorship of high-leverage programs.
  • Build or rebuild systems and practices that make analytical work reliable, adoptable, and scalable rather than dependent on individual heroics.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional Directors, managers, and IC5+ leaders across multiple teams or pillars.
  • Set a high talent bar through succession planning, calibration, and clear expectations for coaching, performance, accountability, and growth.
  • Create durable cross-org forums and operating mechanisms that improve coordination, culture, and decision quality.
  • Align senior product, engineering, and business leaders on measurement strategy, difficult tradeoffs, and decisions with material multi-year impact.
  • Represent Reddit externally and internally as an acknowledged thought leader and visible culture shaper for rigor.
  • Partner with teams advancing ML and analytical systems that deepen understanding of Reddit’s UGC and community ecosystem.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Deep data science expertise in measurement, experimentation, causal inference, ML, data platforms, and analytical systems, with the technical judgment to set company-scale standards.
  • Experience in UGC or community ecosystems and a strong point of view on how data science can improve consumer experiences while protecting analytical quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
  • Proven ability to connect model and system improvements to consumer value, content quality, trust, diversity, healthy participation, and long-term business outcomes—not only short-term engagement metrics.
  • Senior leadership experience leading multi-team or multi-pillar organizations and delivering attributable business impact through durable roadmaps, operating mechanisms, and long-range bets.
  • Proven organization builder with a track record of recruiting and retaining exceptional senior leaders, developing Directors and managers, and creating a healthy, high-trust leadership bench.
  • Exceptional communication and influence with experience aligning senior product, engineering, and business leaders; resolving conflict; and communicating uncertainty, risks, and tradeoffs with intellectual honesty.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. title: Porter - Blue Sky Residence
description:
About Us

At BRC, we help New Yorkers experiencing homelessness reclaim their lives with opportunities for health, self-sufficiency, and hope, while restoring dignity and respect. We invest in our employees through growth, learning, and meaningful work across Manhattan, Brooklyn, the Bronx, and Queens, offering a wide range of benefits and a supportive team environment. Join our passionate team, make a real difference every day, and be part of a community that’s building a more caring and compassionate city – apply today!

Role Overview

The Facilities Porter is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, sanitary, and welcoming environment within BRC residential, shelter, and program facilities. Reporting to the Maintenance Supervisor or Facilities Manager, this position performs custodial services, building maintenance support, sanitation, waste management, facility inspections, and general property upkeep. The Facilities Porter plays an essential role in supporting facility operations, workplace safety, and compliance standards while helping create a dignified environment for clients, staff, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform daily custodial duties throughout residential, shelter, and office environments.
  • Sweep, mop, vacuum, dust, sanitize, and disinfect common areas, offices, restrooms, kitchens, dining areas, and client spaces.
  • Collect, remove, and properly dispose of trash, recycling, and other waste materials.
  • Monitor and replenish cleaning supplies, paper products, and restroom supplies.
  • Support facility readiness by setting up, moving, or arranging furniture, equipment, and supplies for meetings and events.
  • Complete routine building inspections and report maintenance issues, safety hazards, equipment failures, and repair needs.
  • Help building operations through light maintenance activities, such as changing light bulbs, and assisting maintenance staff.
  • Communicate facility needs and maintenance concerns to the Maintenance Supervisor or Facilities Manager.
  • Provide excellent customer service while interacting with clients, residents, visitors, vendors, and staff.
  • Respond to cleaning emergencies and spills.
  • Maintain cleaning logs, maintenance records, and complete assigned documentation.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • One year, or more, of experience in custodial services, porter services, janitorial work, housekeeping, facilities maintenance, building operations, environmental services, or property maintenance.
  • Knowledge of commercial cleaning methods, sanitation procedures, and workplace safety practices.
  • Ability to safely use cleaning equipment, custodial tools, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Ability to follow maintenance procedures, work orders, and operational instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness, safety, and customer service.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical duties including standing, walking, bending, reaching, pushing, pulling, and carrying materials.
  • Ability to work effectively within a team-oriented facilities management environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One or more years of experience in facilities operations, building maintenance, custodial services, environmental services, property management, or commercial cleaning.
  • Experience working in supportive housing, homeless services, shelters, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, residential properties, or nonprofit organizations.
  • Familiarity with OSHA standards, infection-control procedures, and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Bilingual proficiency preferred.

Working Conditions

Work is performed primarily in residential, shelter, office, and program environments. Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, and carrying up to 50 pounds. Regular exposure to cleaning chemicals, dust, waste materials, and varying indoor/outdoor conditions. Direct interaction with clients, visitors, contractors, and staff throughout the workday.

Benefits

  • Competitive health and dental plans, with coverage available for your spouse, domestic partner, and dependents
  • Minimum of 3 weeks paid vacation, 12 paid holidays, plus additional paid sick and personal time
  • 403(b) retirement plan with BRC matching contributions
  • Tuition assistance and a variety of career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for healthcare, transit, and childcare expenses
  • Free resources for legal, financial, and personal support

title: Finance Intern - Global Risk Oversight (Summer 2027)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

  • Vertiv’s Global Risk Oversight (GRO) function is seeking a motivated, curious, and detail-oriented summer intern pursuing studies in Accounting, Finance, Internal Audit, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business, or a related field. The internship provides hands-on exposure to internal audit, financial and operational controls, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements, risk assessment, and the use of data and technology in assurance work. Working alongside GRO professionals, the intern will support well-defined audit and controls activities, develop practical business knowledge, and contribute observations and recommendations that strengthen risk mitigation and the company’s system of effective controls.
What You Will Learn and Contribute
  • Audit execution: Assist with clearly scoped audit and SOX procedures, including walkthrough support, evidence collection, sampling, control testing, and documentation of results under the guidance of GRO team members.
  • Business process and risk understanding: Develop an understanding of core financial, operational, and support processes; learn how business objectives, risks, and internal controls connect.
  • Audit planning and program development: Support background research, process understanding, risk identification, and the development or refinement of audit steps and testing programs.
  • Documentation and analysis: Prepare clear, accurate, and well-organized workpapers, process narratives, testing summaries, and other audit documentation consistent with GRO methodology.
  • Data analytics and technology: Use Excel and, where appropriate, data analysis or visualization tools to organize information, identify trends or exceptions, and explore how leading technologies can enhance audit and control-testing practices.
  • Results and recommendations: Summarize testing observations, discuss potential issues with the project team, and help develop practical, actionable recommendations to strengthen processes and controls.
  • Collaboration and communication: Work collaboratively with financial, operational, and IT teams; participate in project discussions; and communicate progress, questions, and conclusions clearly and professionally.
  • Continuous improvement: Contribute ideas that improve audit efficiency, internal control awareness, risk mitigation practices, and GRO tools or templates.
  • Professional development: Build relationships across the organization, seek and apply feedback, expand knowledge of internal audit and business practices, and gain insight into career paths within risk, controls, accounting, and analytics.
Qualifications
  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business, Information Systems, or related fields.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding how processes and controls work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications; exposure to data analysis, visualization, process-mapping, or automation tools is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

title: Independent Living Specialist - MAP Bronx
description:
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a field based position, working in the community in clients’ apartments as part of a residential treatment model. Responsible for all aspects of assigned caseload in transitional community based mental health housing program. Clients will have a mental health diagnosis (SPMI) and/or substance use disorder. Assist with the intake and admission process, restorative services daily, develop and update service plans, maintain chart documentation, provide supportive counseling, teach and assist with activities of daily living, assist clients with money management and independent medication, assist with recreational activities, provide linkages and referrals to community resources such as medical, mental health and/or substance abuse services as needed. Utilize a harm reduction approach and motivational interviewing techniques with clients, Make regular visits to client apartments to ensure a safe and secure environment and assist with coordinating repairs as needed. Participate in community meetings and interdisciplinary team meetings. Be on call during off-hours. Participate in BRC approved trainings. Provide emergency first aid/CPR assistance when needed. Related duties as assigned. Reports to clinical supervisor.

HOURS

Full-time, 35 hours per week

  • Tuesday-Saturday 10am-6pm

QUALIFICATIONS

BA strongly preferred, but will consider several years of related experience in mental health field in lieu of BA. Supportive counseling, case management, ADL skills training, bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred. Basic computer literacy required. CPR training certification or willingness to take training class in CPR.

*Vaccination preferred but not required.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Are you looking to make a positive impact on the lives of those in your community? At BRC, our staff help New Yorkers experiencing homelessness reclaim their lives by providing a hand up, offering opportunities for health and self-sufficiency, and restoring hope and dignity.

Each and every BRC staff member makes heroic contributions to our city, providing vital services in times of crisis and need. Through our commitment to employee wellbeing and development, BRC provides a workplace where staff can achieve their goals, make a difference with our clients, and grow personally and professionally. BRC is committed to a safe and healthy workplace: we provide PPE to all employees and enforce temperature monitoring and physical distancing best practices across our programs.

Today, we have over 1000 full-time, part-time, and per-diem positions located in Manhattan, Brooklyn, the Bronx and Queens. Come and learn why 95% of BRC employees report that they would recommend BRC as a good place to work, and join us in building a more caring and compassionate city.

PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:

The Metropolitan Apartment Program (MAP) is a transitional housing program targeting formerly homeless clients who are either mentally ill or dually diagnosed as mentally ill and chemically addicted. Funded by the NYS Office of Mental Health and Medicaid, MAP comprises apartments in Manhattan and the Bronx for 87 clients who can function and thrive in a more independent living environment than a traditional community residence. The mission of MAP is to provide a safe and supportive environment where residents partake of rehabilitation interventions that will assist them in the attainment of their work, social and community living goals. A variety of services are available, including case management, substance abuse groups, money management, daily skills training and recreational activities.

BENEFITS

BRC takes the health, safety, and wellbeing of our employees seriously. Employees are eligible for health insurance and paid sick time benefits immediately upon starting work. In addition, full time employees receive a generous benefits package, including:

  1. Competitive health and dental plans, with coverage is available for your spouse, domestic partner, and dependents.
  2. A minimum of 3 weeks paid vacation, 12 paid holidays, and additional paid sick and personal time. A 403(b) pension plan with a matching benefit paid by BRC.
  3. Tuition assistance and many training opportunities for career development.
  4. Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) are available so employees can set aside pre-tax dollars for healthcare, transit and childcare.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
At Amico, we believe in fostering collaboration and empowering our team to tackle ambitious challenges head on. title: Fire Alarm Technician
description:
We are seeking a skilled Senior Fire Alarm Technician to install, maintain, inspect, troubleshoot, and repair fire alarm and life safety systems in commercial and industrial environments. This role also supports fire research, investigation, and risk assessment projects, including evaluating structures and developing pre-fire plans.

The ideal candidate has deep technical expertise in fire alarm systems, strong knowledge of fire codes and standards, and the ability to independently manage complex projects while collaborating with internal teams, clients, and other trades.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Install new fire alarm systems in accordance with design specifications, manufacturer guidelines, and applicable codes

  • Perform routine inspections, testing, and preventive maintenance to ensure system reliability and code compliance

  • Diagnose and repair system faults involving control panels, detectors, notification devices, power supplies, batteries, and communication circuits

  • Utilize advanced troubleshooting techniques for fire alarm and life safety systems, including VESDA systems

  • Troubleshoot interconnected systems such as HVAC shutdowns, smoke dampers, fire doors, and other integrated life safety components

  • Collaborate with other tradespeople and contractors on site to coordinate work.

  • Perform electrical and fiber optic troubleshooting, including ground faults and communication issues

  • Respond promptly to emergency service calls for system failures or false alarms

  • Conduct fire research, fire investigations, and fire risk assessments

  • Perform detailed assessments and analyses of structures and fire protection systems

  • Develop and maintain pre-fire plans and fire safety documentation

  • Analyze data and inspection results to identify risks and recommend mitigation strategies

  • Test system components and accurately document inspections, test results, deficiencies, and repairs

  • Ensure compliance with NFPA 72, local and national fire codes, building codes, and OSHA safety standards

  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance activities, repairs, and corrective actions

  • Stay current on industry standards, codes, and emerging technologies related to fire alarm and fire protection systems

  • Work independently with significant impact on operational results and project deliverables

Basic Qualifications

  • TS/SCI w/ Poly Clearance is required

  • High school diploma or equivalent (technical training or certification in fire alarm systems preferred)

  • Proven experience as a Fire Alarm Technician or in a related electrical/low-voltage field

  • Strong knowledge of NFPA 72, local fire codes, and OSHA safety standards

  • Hands-on experience installing, inspecting, and troubleshooting fire alarm systems

  • Working knowledge of electrical wiring, circuitry, schematics, and low-voltage systems

  • Experience troubleshooting Siemens Fire XLS and Siemens Desigo systems

  • Understanding of preventive maintenance activities

  • Ability to safely use testing equipment, hand tools, and diagnostic instruments

  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Preferred Qualifications

  • NFPA Certification

  • NICET Fire Protection Certification

  • Journeyman Electrician License

  • Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior technical staff

  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs.

  • Comfortable working on ladders, scaffolding, and in various environmental conditions.

  • Willingness to occasionally operate and work from manlift to 40 feet
