title: Instructional Designer & Technologist
description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director - Center for Teaching and Learning, the Instructional Designer & Technologist (IDT) will provide instructional design and technology support for all campuses and will assist with all IDT training, support, and professional development. The IDT staff will develop instructional materials and products and assist in the technology-based redesign of courses. The IDT staff will assist faculty and staff in learning about, becoming proficient in, and applying instructional technology.

Appropriate placement on the Alabama Community College System salary schedule C3 3.

For more information about salary schedules, refer to .


For any questions or additional information, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@coastalalabama.edu.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The Instructional Designer & Technologist’s primary responsibility is serving as an education professional whose job is to assist with identifying the performance, skills, knowledge, information and attitude gaps of a targeted audience and help create and deliver learning experiences to fill this gap. This position will be based on the Bay Minette campus but travel will be required to other Coastal Alabama campuses, as needed.


At a minimum, the essential functions of this position shall include:

  1. Develop instructional or training roadmaps for online and hybrid courses and programs.
  2. Create engaging learning activities and compelling course content.
  3. Adapt instructional content or delivery methods for different levels or types of learners.
  4. Visualize instructional graphics, the user interface, and the finished product.
  5. Analyze and apply trends and best practices in learning technologies and instructional design.
  6. Design instructional aids for stand-alone or instructor-led classroom or online use.
  7. Maintain project documentation and electronic course development documentation.
  8. Support students, faculty, and staff via phone, email, and in person with instructional design and technology questions and issues.
  9. Use assistive technology and create instructional content that meets WCAG standards.
  10. Assist instructors and the Distance Education Department in developing ADA compliant course and training materials; monitor online course content for ADA compliance; troubleshoot issues with software and instructional materials as needed.
  11. Assist instructors with developing and documenting course activities and substantive interactions for DOE and SACSCOC requirements.
  12. Assist the Coordinator of Instructional Design and Technology with conducting professional development sessions in collaboration with the Professional Development Team, covering technologies such as Coastal Alabama’s learning management system (Canvas), Respondus Products, Honorlock, TurnItIn.com, Tutor.com, Microsoft Office 365, live conferencing tools (Skype for Business, BigBlueButton and Microsoft Teams), Bridge (professional development system for employees) and other educational technologies.
  13. Conduct training sessions through group and one-on-one sessions with live conferencing tools, such as: Skype for Business, BigBlueButton and Microsoft Teams.
  14. Travel to multiple campus locations to meet in person with faculty and staff for various training and professional development sessions.
  15. Assist with hybrid and online Master Template workshops and Master Template course design and maintenance.
  16. Represent the Distance Education Department on committees and in general to the campus community; participate in professional associations and seminars, as appropriate.
  17. Maintain a highly professional attitude and demeanor at all times.
  18. Exhibit appropriate and satisfactory leadership with the College.
  19. Comply with ACCS and College policies, as well as state and federal laws.
  20. Provide responsible, adequate, and satisfactory leadership on campus and within the College.
  21. Demonstrate excellent leadership traits and skills in all aspects of the position.
  22. Communicate positively and professionally in all aspects of the position.
  23. Ensure the positive promotion of the College and integration of all campuses within the College.
  24. Perform other duties as assigned.

All positions at Coastal Alabama have the job responsibilities below:

  1. Handles sensitive information in a confidential manner.
  2. Maintains a highly professional attitude and demeanor at all times.
  3. Provides responsible, appropriate, and satisfactory leadership on campus and within the College.
  4. Communicates positively and professionally in all aspects of the position.
  5. Attends all employee meetings, College meetings, and professional development activities.
  6. Becomes thoroughly familiar with all pertinent state and national policies and comply with said policies.
  7. Serves on and provides information to college committees as needed.
  8. Complies with ACCS and College policies, as well as state and federal laws.
  9. Ensures the positive promotion of the College and integration of all campuses within the College.
  10. Is prompt and punctual in reporting for work, meetings, and office hours.
  11. Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

EVALUATION OF PERFORMANCE

The job performance of the Instructional Designer & Technologist will be evaluated, at a minimum, annually, by the Director of Distance Education in accordance with the College and Alabama Community College System policies.


Required Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field from a regionally accredited institution.
  2. Five years of related experience.
  3. Demonstrated experience with instructional design models. Samples of demonstrated experience are required to be included with the application packet.
  4. Demonstrated experience writing effective copy, instructional text, and/or video scripts. Samples of demonstrated experience are required to be included with the application packet.
  5. Demonstrated experience conducting professional development workshops. Samples of demonstrated experience are required to be included with the application packet.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field from a regionally accredited institution.
  2. Experience creating and designing courses in a learning management system, specifically Canvas.
  3. Experience working in a community college setting.

Application Procedures/Additional Information

APPLICATION PROCEDURES:

A complete application packet consists of the following:

  • A completed online application form.
  • Current resume’ showing education degrees earned and complete employment history.
  • Copies of transcripts from all colleges attended where required degrees were conferred. Degree(s) must be posted on transcripts. Official copies will be required if employed with the institution.

Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications as indicated in this vacancy announcement and must submit a completed application packet in order to be considered for an open position. Applications that do not have the required attachments are considered incomplete and will be immediately rejected. In addition, only completed applications received during the period of this vacancy announcement will be considered.

All applicants are required to apply on-line for job opportunities. To apply on-line, go to and click on the job title you are interested in and then click on the "Apply" link. If this is the first time you are applying using our on- line job application, you will need to create an account and select a Username and Password.

Please Note:

  • It is recommended that you have digital (PDF) copies of your resume and unofficial and/or official transcripts. You will be required to upload this during the application process.
  • We do not accept paper, faxed or emailed applications and application materials.
  • You may not put “see resume” on any section of the application form.
  • Please ensure that uploads are not behind a paywall or a password-protected area. The screening committee may disqualify your application packet if required uploads are inaccessible.
  • When you finish the steps to apply to a job, you will receive an on-screen notice that you’ve successfully applied. However, this notice does not mean your application materials are complete.
  • Correspondence regarding positions (i.e., scheduled interview appointment, position filled announcement) will be sent to applicants through the e-mail address used on the applicants’ NEOGOV accounts. Applicants are required to monitor their e-mail accounts for updates regarding positions.
  • Incomplete application packets will eliminate the possibility of an interview. It is the sole responsibility of the applicant to ensure his or her application packet is complete.
  • The college may require that applicants for faculty positions submit supplementary information from the attending college registrar to explain undergraduate courses that received graduate credit on the academic transcript prior to being considered for an interview.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Coastal Alabama Community College is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the Alabama Community College System, including all postsecondary community and technical colleges under the control of the Alabama Community College System Board of Trustees, that no employee or applicant for employment or promotion, shall be discriminated against on the basis of any impermissible criterion or characteristic including, without limitation, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, disability, sex, age or any other protected class as defined by federal and state law.

It is College policy to provide equal opportunity for employment and advancement to all applicants and employees as required by appropriate federal and state law.

Coastal Alabama Community College will make reasonable accommodations for qualified disabled applicants or employees. Applicants in need of an accommodation(s), should contact the Human Resources Office prior to the interview.

Coastal Alabama Community College reserves the right to withdraw this job announcement at any time prior to the awarding. The College reserves the right to fill the position within one year of the stated anticipated starting date or not to fill the position due to budgetary or operational considerations. Further, the College reserves the right to fill more than one position in the same job classification should another vacancy occur during the search process.

Coastal Alabama Community College is a multi-campus organization and employees of the College may be assigned to work at any of the College worksites, may be required to travel among various work sites for both day, evening, and weekend responsibilities, and must provide their own mode of transportation.

Coastal Alabama Community College is an active participant in the Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-verify). E-verify electronically confirms an employee's eligibility to work in the United States as required by the Department of Homeland Security.

title: Business Analyst Junior+ [Identity]
description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the Identity team, one of the key infrastructure areas of the bank.

The team is responsible for the centralized storage, processing, and quality of customer master data. We maintain a single source of truth about users — validation, normalization, deduplication, and distribution of data across company systems — and provide services to every product team in the bank.

In this role, you will support new product launches — credit, debit, investment, insurance, and others — from the perspective of correct personal data collection, legal consents, and compliance with regulatory requirements. This is a role with a lot of cross-team interaction, where understanding business processes, shaping requirements, and keeping data quality under control at every step of the customer journey matter most.

Challenges that await you:

  • Describing and developing the processes for collecting, processing, and using customer personal data
  • Supporting new product launches from the data side: which personal data is collected, which legal consents are required, and how regulatory requirements are met
  • Collecting and documenting requirements from product teams and Compliance and translating them into changes in our systems
  • Building and maintaining business processes for new product launches
  • Setting up and developing data quality metrics (DQC) and monitoring them on a regular basis
  • Checking that master data is transferred correctly between systems and investigating the root causes of discrepancies and anomalies
  • Contributing to the rules for deduplication, merging, identification, and version management
  • Analyzing current processes for handling personal data: collection, validation, normalization, deduplication, addresses, and documents
  • Preparing documentation and artifacts (BPMN, UML, data flow diagrams)
  • Coordinating day-to-day communication between product teams, Compliance, KYC, and Origination

What makes you a great fit:

  • 1-2 years of experience as a Business Analyst
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or another technical field
  • Good understanding of business processes and experience modelling them
  • Good SQL knowledge: writing queries, working with joins and aggregations
  • Basic Python and an understanding of how databases work
  • Ability to work with metrics and monitor the quality of processes
  • Attention to detail and the ability to analyze results
  • Strong communication skills and experience working across teams
  • B2 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team

Our ways of working:

  • Innovative Spirit: A commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions

  • Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication

  • Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community

  • Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together

  • High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances

Our benefits:

  • Relocation support to one of our hubs — Serbia, Georgia or Mexico— with assistance for the employee and their family

  • Flexible work from one of our offices or remote

  • Healthcare Coverage

  • Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications

  • Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursements

  • Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave

title: Director, Product Owner
description:
The Role

The CMC Director, Product Owner leads product lifecycle management, value chain, launch planning and supply chain operations oversight for mFLUSIVA, mCOMBRIAX and mRESVIA. The role connects global portfolio and supply strategies with country execution, ensuring launches and lifecycle changes are delivered in a coordinated, compliant and supply-ready manner while maintaining reliable day-to-day performance.

You will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our Global Supply Chain (GSC) strategy is aligned with the company’s ambitions of delivering innovative mRNA medicines to the market. You will serve as the leader of the Product team and lead an integrated team responsible for planning, launching, and managing the life cycle of various products. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain processes, collaboration across CMC functions, an enterprise collaboration mindset and a deep commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

As Product Owner, you are accountable for post-launch product lifecycle leadership, integrating CMC commercialization, value stream performance, lifecycle risk and KPI management, global expansion, variations, manufacturing network resilience, and end-to-end supply readiness across the commercial lifecycle.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Own the integrated product lifecycle and commercialization agenda across markets, indications, presentations, launches, regulatory changes, transfers, variations and discontinuations, translating global portfolio and commercial strategies into clear requirements, milestones, dependencies, decisions and accountable owners.

  • Establish and lead cross-functional lifecycle and launch governance across CMC, including stage gates, readiness criteria, Commit-to-File/Commit-to-Launch processes, launch coordination and integration into long-range planning, IBP, Product Phase S&OP/S&OE and country operating plans.

  • Lead CMC commercialization strategy and readiness, translating market and patient/customer needs into product configurations, SKU strategy, launch sequencing, delivery models and executable cross-functional plans.

  • Own the end-to-end product value chain strategy and roadmap, including value-stream maps, current and target conditions, performance metrics, improvement priorities, and physical, information/document and financial flows.

  • Drive product supply-chain and manufacturing network strategy and resilience, including network footprint, multi-site manufacturing and packaging configurations, capacity flexibility, intercompany/product-ownership flows, tax/tariff considerations and disruption/scenario readiness.

  • Integrate clinical and commercial supply planning across the product lifecycle, ensuring demand visibility, inventory strategy, planning and master-data readiness, reliable supply-chain operations, and effective transition from launch to steady-state commercial supply.

  • Own post-launch product performance and risk management, including the product risk register, success metrics/KPIs, mitigation plans, performance gaps and escalation of key risks and decisions through appropriate leadership forums.

  • Lead post-launch CMC regulatory lifecycle and variation management (Including ASU for 1010 & 1083), including RTQs, global expansion readiness, market commitments and health authority responses, partnering with the Variation Office and functional teams and applying the agreed Product Lead/Product Owner ownership model.

  • Own commercial product image and lifecycle readiness, coordinating global and local artwork, labeling and packaging configurations, manufacturing-site implementation, change control, serialization/traceability, master data and supply readiness.

  • Act as the CMC/Product Team leader and representative in enterprise forums, driving cross-functional decision-making, governance, financial planning and alignment across CMC, Commercial, Regulatory and Supply Chain.

  • Lead communication and coordination of major product lifecycle activities, including launches, tech transfers, network changes and other cross-functional product initiatives, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies and timely execution.

  • Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, using lifecycle learnings, data, benchmarking and value-stream performance to establish reusable standards and improve product and supply-chain performance.

  • Additional duties as may be assigned from time to time.

  • Experience: 12+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with a focus on Supply Chain, CMC Program Management, Value Chain Leadership, or similar roles. Experience in CMC commercialization and an understanding of value creation within the biopharmaceutical industry.

  • Strong analytical skills to synthesize data, enabling informed decision-making and optimization of operations.

  • Adaptability in dynamic environments, excelling under pressure while driving continuous improvements.

  • Clear and concise communication with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on strategic initiatives and objectives.

  • A desire to make an impact as part of a high-growth, transformational company that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative.

Our Working Model

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

ABOUT ABBOTT

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

WORKING AT ABBOTT

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Production areas that are clean, well-lit and temperature-controlled
  • Training and career development, with onboarding programs for new employees and tuition assistance
  • Financial security through competitive compensation, incentives and retirement plans
  • Health care and well-being programs including medical, dental, vision, wellness and occupational health programs, Medical Benefits start day 1
  • Vacation – 120 hours of accrued vacation (1st yr is prorated) + vacation buy program + 5 personal days + 10 paid holidays
  • Retiree Healthcare program
  • Robust 401(k) retirement savings with a generous company match
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A stable company with a record of strong financial performance and history of being actively involved in local communities
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced Automation Team Lead to lead a team of hourly Controls Technicians supporting our manufacturing, laboratory, and warehouse operations. This role is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient execution of preventive maintenance, troubleshooting automation and electrical systems, and partnering with Engineering to implement system improvements and capital projects across the site.

The Automation Team provides 24/7 support for critical operations through the maintenance, troubleshooting, optimization, and continuous improvement of PLC-based control systems, VFDs, process control loops, industrial networks, and automated production equipment.

The Team Lead will play a critical role in developing technical talent, improving equipment reliability, enhancing automation performance, and supporting manufacturing through advanced controls troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and automation lifecycle management, including obsolescence identification and replacement planning.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Controls Technicians, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize, coordinate, and manage daily and long-term work activities to support operational objectives and equipment reliability.
  • Onboard, train, and mentor new team members while supporting career development and succession planning.
  • Establish and maintain site automation standards around, ensuring control systems are properly documented, labeled, and supported with up-to-date drawings, manuals, and troubleshooting resources.
  • Ensure current backups are maintained for PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and other programmable devices, along with the software and tools required to support and recover systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and support for PLC, HMI, VFD, servo, motion control, industrial network, and process control systems throughout the facility.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis efforts for complex automation, controls, electrical, and process-related issues.
  • Identify automation and controls obsolescence risks and develop replacement strategies, partnering with Engineering teams to establish long-term capital plans.
  • Partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, and project teams to successfully integrate new equipment, system upgrades, and capital projects into plant operations.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with internal customers and cross-functional partners.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading maintenance, controls, automation, or technical teams in an industrial manufacturing environment.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and electrical systems associated with high-speed manufacturing, filling, or packaging equipment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, industrial networks, motor control systems, and plant equipment, including pumps, hydraulics, pneumatics, and utility systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and P&ID diagrams.
  • Experience troubleshooting control systems, analyzing automation failures, and supporting PLC- and HMI-based equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Maximo or a similar computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
  • Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience supporting industrial controls and automation systems in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience leading or mentoring technicians in troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Knowledge of process controls, PID loops, and loop tuning.
  • Working knowledge of Rockwell Automation platforms, including RSLogix 5000 and Studio 5000.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication networks and protocols, including DeviceNet, EtherNet/IP, HART, IO-Link, and Foundation Fieldbus.
  • Experience supporting VFDs, servo systems, motion control applications, and motor control centers.
  • Prior experience in a liquid manufacturing, processing, or packaging facility.

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description

Fugro is seeking a highly experienced Project Manager to take ownership of the delivery of complex projects within our Positioning & Construction Support (PCS – Positioning and Construction Support) service line in Aberdeen. The position is on a Fixed Term Contract for 12 months.


This is a project delivery role for an established professional who brings strong commercial acumen, sound judgement and the confidence to lead high‑value, risk‑managed projects in dynamic operational environments.

As a Project Manager, you will be fully accountable for project performance across safety, quality, commercial outcomes and client satisfaction. You will lead PCS projects from tender handover through mobilisation, execution and close‑out, acting as the primary authority for project decisions and the main interface with clients. Success in this role requires the ability to operate autonomously, manage complexity, and apply robust governance while maintaining a strong delivery focus.


This position is suited to an experienced Project Manager with a background in construction support, positioning, offshore, marine or technically complex project environments, who is comfortable holding responsibility for financial performance, risk ownership and senior client relationships.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Assume full end‑to‑end accountability for the delivery of PCS projects, ensuring excellence in safety, quality, schedule, cost and client outcomes.
  • Act as the senior client representative for assigned projects, leading client engagement, managing expectations and resolving issues at an appropriate level.
  • Lead mobilisation, execution and demobilisation activities, ensuring projects are well planned, resourced and controlled.
  • Own and actively manage project risk, including QHSSE, commercial, contractual, technical and operational exposures.
  • Maintain full commercial responsibility, including project P&L ownership, forecasting, cost control, cash flow, invoicing and margin protection.
  • Identify, negotiate and manage changes in scope through formal Variation Order processes, ensuring commercial robustness and transparency.
  • Provide leadership to project teams and technical specialists, setting clear expectations and driving performance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure appropriate selection and deployment of equipment, methodologies and resources aligned to project risk and operational requirements.
  • Apply Fugro governance frameworks, approval authorities and project controls consistently and rigorously.
  • Monitor project performance, intervene decisively where needed, and implement corrective actions to protect delivery outcomes.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to the continuous improvement of PCS project delivery practices.
  • Act as a role model for project management discipline, professionalism and Fugro values.

What You’ll Need to Thrive in This Role:

  • Extensive experience performing as a Project Manager with full lifecycle ownership of technically complex projects.
  • Strong background delivering projects within construction support, positioning, marine, offshore or similar operational environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project P&L, commercial risk, cost control and financial performance.
  • Proven ability to manage risk across QHSSE, contractual, technical and operational dimensions.
  • Confidence acting as the senior client interface and representing the business with credibility and authority.
  • A collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong leadership, decision‑making and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable working autonomously, managing ambiguity and making informed judgements under pressure.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 tools, particularly Excel, Word and Microsoft Project.
  • Experience operating within structured project governance frameworks.
  • A recognised project management qualification (PRINCE2, APM PMQ, PMP or equivalent). Sufficient relevant experience can compensate for lack of qualification.

About Us

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.


What we offer

Fugro provides a positive work environment as well as projects that will satisfy the most curious minds. We also offer great opportunities to stretch and develop yourself. By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. Which should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye and can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.


Our view on diversity, equity and inclusion

At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge and talents give us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behaviour and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together we create a safe and liveable world’ – and to each other.


Benefits of joining our team

  • Extensive career & training opportunities both nationally and internationally.
  • Competitive salary
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private medical insurance
  • Health cash plan
  • Group life assurance
  • Group income protection
  • Flexible working hours and the potential to work 2 days a week from home in accordance with your manager and corporate policies.
  • Electric car scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Discounts platform
  • The Fugro Card (pre-paid virtual visa card, which earns cash back automatically when money is spent at any participating retailers)
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
  • Long service awards
  • Fugro values awards
  • Employee referral bonus scheme

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

HIGHLIGHTS

title: JLR LEVEL 4 TECHNICIAN/SHOP FOREMAN
description:
JLR Level 4 Technician / Shop Foreman

Jaguar Land Rover Columbia | Columbia, South Carolina
Mills Automotive Group

Jaguar Land Rover Columbia is looking for an experienced JLR Level 4 Technician / Shop Foreman to join our service leadership team.

This opportunity is available because our current Level 4 Shop Foreman is being promoted to Service Director—a great example of the career growth available within our organization.

This is not simply another technician position. We are looking for a highly skilled Jaguar Land Rover professional who can diagnose the difficult vehicles, support and develop other technicians, improve shop efficiency, and help us build one of the strongest JLR service departments in the region.

If you are currently a JLR Level 4 Technician, Master Technician, Diagnostic Technician, or Shop Foreman and want an opportunity where your technical ability, production, and leadership are rewarded, we want to talk with you.

What You'll Do

As our Level 4 Technician / Shop Foreman, you will be a working technical leader in the shop. You'll lead and support the team while continuing to turn your own hours.

Responsibilities include:

  • Diagnose and repair complex Jaguar and Land Rover concerns

  • Maintain personal production while fulfilling Shop Foreman responsibilities

  • Serve as the shop's technical resource for difficult diagnostic cases

  • Assist technicians with troubleshooting, repair strategy, and technical questions

  • Help ensure repairs are completed correctly the first time

  • Work closely with Service Advisors and Service Management on difficult or unusual repairs

  • Review diagnostic processes and help prevent unnecessary parts replacement

  • Assist with technical escalations and JLR technical cases

  • Support warranty repair quality and proper documentation

  • Help dispatch and prioritize work when needed

  • Monitor workflow, technician productivity, efficiency, and quality

  • Perform quality-control inspections on appropriate repairs

  • Coach and mentor developing technicians

  • Help identify training opportunities within the shop

  • Maintain a clean, organized, professional working environment

  • Promote teamwork and accountability throughout the service department

What We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Jaguar Land Rover Level 4 certification strongly preferred

  • Extensive Jaguar and Land Rover diagnostic and repair experience

  • Strong electrical and drivability diagnostic ability

  • Experience using JLR diagnostic systems, technical information, and factory repair procedures

  • Strong understanding of modern vehicle electrical networks and systems

  • Ability to diagnose complex concerns rather than simply replace components

  • Previous Shop Foreman, Team Leader, or technician mentoring experience preferred

  • Strong communication and leadership skills

  • Excellent documentation and repair-order habits

  • Commitment to fixing vehicles correctly and taking care of the client

  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record

The Person We're Looking For

Technical ability matters, but how you operate matters just as much.

At Mills Automotive Group, we believe long-term success is built around five principles:

Character. Integrity. Hard Work. Teamwork. Production.

Our Shop Foreman needs to demonstrate all five.

We want someone technicians respect because of their knowledge, consistency, willingness to help, and personal standards—not simply because of their title.

You should be comfortable holding people accountable while also being willing to get involved when someone needs help solving a difficult vehicle.

Compensation — Built to Reward Leadership AND Production

This is a working Shop Foreman position with multiple components to the compensation plan.

The compensation structure includes:

  • Monthly base salary

  • Shop production/hour override

  • Personal flagged-hour compensation

  • Ability to continue producing and earning as a technician while being compensated for the performance of the shop

  • Compensation structure designed to reward both individual production and team performance

For a high-performing Level 4 technician, this creates an opportunity to increase earnings by helping the entire shop become more productive, not simply by turning more hours individually.

Full compensation details and override structure will be discussed during the interview process.

Why Jaguar Land Rover Columbia?

We want to build a service operation known for both technical excellence and an exceptional client experience.

For the right technician, this position provides an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the entire department—not just the vehicles assigned to your stall.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with Jaguar and Land Rover's latest vehicle technology

  • Take a leadership role within the shop

  • Help develop the next generation of JLR technicians

  • Influence shop processes and technical standards

  • Build a long-term career with Mills Automotive Group

  • Work in an environment focused on growth, accountability, performance, and recognition

  • Join an organization with a demonstrated path from Shop Foreman into senior Fixed Operations leadership

Benefits

Benefits may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) options

  • Paid time off

  • Factory and continuing technical training

  • Employee vehicle purchase opportunities

  • Career advancement within Mills Automotive Group

Relocation assistance may be considered for the right JLR Level 4 candidate.

Ready for the Next Step?

If you've reached the upper levels of Jaguar Land Rover technical certification and are ready for an opportunity where you can diagnose, produce, lead, teach, and help shape a shop, we'd like to hear from you.

This position offers something different from a traditional flat-rate technician role: your earning potential grows when you produce—and when the team you lead produces.

Apply confidentially to learn more about the opportunity at Jaguar Land Rover Columbia in Columbia, South Carolina.

Jaguar Land Rover Columbia | Mills Automotive Group

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintain a drug-free workplace.

title: Application Tester

description:
Vulnerability Management Specialist – AGO SOC – Canberra | On-site


This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold an active TSPV security clearance. NV2 candidates may be considered where there is a willingness and ability to uplift to TSPV. A successful DISA is required as part of the conditions of employment.


About Leidos Australia


At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.


Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.


Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:


  • Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days, part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
  • Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
  • Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
  • Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
  • And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About the Team


The GEO SPACES Security Operations Centre provides security services to the client through a range of functions, including Vulnerability Management. You will work alongside SOC analysts and Security Engineers across multiple mission systems at varying classifications.


The team consists of seasoned and experienced security professionals who are capable of independent initiative. New team members are expected to come up to speed quickly, supported by a structured onboarding period covering team ways of working, organisational context and mission environment complexity.


While there is a strong expectation of initiative, the team works collaboratively on complex tasks and offers strong opportunities for self-development, technical growth and career broadening experiences.


The Opportunity


We are seeking a Vulnerability Management Specialist to support the AGO - GEO SPACES Security Operations Capability. This is an on-site role based in Canberra, supporting work within a secure and mission-critical environment.

You will be responsible for delivering an end-to-end Vulnerability Management process in coordination with the SOC and Security Engineering teams. The role will focus on vulnerability notification, tracking, escalation and stakeholder engagement, while also contributing to process and technology uplift across the function.


You will act as the primary point of contact for Vulnerability Management related functions, questions and escalations, providing timely and considered advice to stakeholders across technical and non-technical areas of the broader organisation.


About You


You are an experienced Vulnerability Management professional who can operate with initiative, communicate risk clearly and work confidently across complex security environments. You understand how Vulnerability Management integrates with broader cyber security functions and can balance technical depth with practical, outcome-focused advice.

You bring a collaborative approach to problem solving, can brief stakeholders across varied technical backgrounds, and are comfortable making informed risk assessments under time constraints where information may be limited.


In this role you will


  • Have demonstrated experience with common Vulnerability Management toolsets, including cloud integrations.
  • Experience uplifting existing Vulnerability Management processes towards defined maturity levels and SLAs.
  • Experience deploying, testing and validating Vulnerability Management tools at enterprise level across multiple systems and configurations.
  • Ability to brief stakeholders across technical and non-technical backgrounds.
  • Collaborative approach to solving problems and working with other teams and stakeholders.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement across personal capability and wider team outcomes.
  • Clear understanding of Vulnerability Management processes and integrations with security functions such as Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Monitoring and Detection, Incident Response and Detection Engineering.
  • Ability to conduct and confidently communicate risk assessments with limited information under time constraints.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold an active TSPV security clearance. NV2 candidates may be considered where there is a willingness and ability to uplift to TSPV. A successful DISA is required as part of the conditions of employment.

title: AMN - Superintendent - Tenant Solutions

  • Cooperate with the owner and his representatives, keeping them informed of construction progress
  • Cooperate with architects or owner representatives on an amicable basis, but in the long-term interest of the company
  • Hold job site meetings with the project manager and the regional manager
  • Report regularly to the project manager to keep them constantly informed on job progress, plans, and problems that could significantly affect costs or schedules

  • Direct adherence to the company’s safety program in all phases and areas of the project
  • Make decisions under tight deadlines
  • Organize people, tools, and equipment and plan/manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results
  • Demonstrate leadership skills with ability and willingness to face challenges, direct others, and effectively address conflict
  • Exhibit commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes, making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting/exceeding internal and external customer expectations
  • Act in a manner of integrity that shows support for the company, its values, and the employees while maintaining a constant focus on meeting/exceeding customer requirements and expectations

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5-25 years of construction experience
  • Computer skills: proficiency in using Word, Excel, Outlook, and project scheduling programs
  • OSHA certification and familiarity with safety protocols
  • Possess and maintain a current, valid driver's license in your state of residence
  • Ability to travel to project sites as needed
  • Ability to meet the physical demands of the job, including but not limited to: standing or walking for long periods of time, occasionally on uneven terrain, bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing stairs, and/or lifting heavy loads of up to 50 pounds.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

title: Health Information Systems and Digital Health Advisor, DOS LEAP Global - Niger
description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

LEAP Program Description

Global Solutions Ventures (GSV) – a joint-venture partnership between ZemiTek, LLC and Dexis Consulting Group – is implementing the Long-term Exceptional Technical Assistance Project (LEAP Global), a mechanism originally used by USAID to battle against infectious diseases such as malaria, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, neglected tropical diseases, and pandemic influenza. As of July 1, 2025, LEAP Global transitioned to the U.S. Department of State (DOS). This initiative aims to address the complex human resource challenges faced by national infectious disease programs in the USA-supported countries.

The intervention of this project is to hire and embed technical expert advisors and subject matter experts within government entities. By directly embedding the technical expertise within the national programs, LEAP provides long-term, sustainable lifesaving support to empower host governments to lead and manage key aspects of their infectious disease portfolios and improve coordination between the U.S. Government and the host country.

About the Position

As part of the implementation of the MOU between the Government of Niger and the Government of the United States, specialized technical assistance is envisioned to support the strengthening of the health system, particularly through the Health Information System and digital health.

The Directorate of e-Health plays a central role in coordinating, providing technical guidance, harmonizing, documenting, securing, and monitoring digital initiatives in the health sector. It must ensure that digital platforms and solutions are coherent, interoperable, secure, sustainable, and aligned with national priorities.

The Ministry currently has several platforms and business systems used for data collection, reporting, analysis, and utilization. However, significant challenges remain including fragmentation of solutions, insufficient documentation, interoperability needs, variable data quality, difficulties in user support, insufficient ongoing training, and the need to strengthen data sovereignty and protection.

The recruitment of an Advisor in HIS and Digital Health will strengthen the operational capacities of the Directorate of e-Health, providing cross-cutting support to technical directorates and programs, particularly for needs related to maternal and child health and malaria, without replacing the structures responsible for the programs.

The Advisor will support the e-Health Directorate in carrying out life-saving humanitarian assistance (LHA) service delivery in full alignment with the new Presidential Executive Order (EO) directives.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Directorate of e-Health in coordinating digital initiatives, preparing technical meetings, notes, reports, presentations, and monitoring documents.
  • Support the implementation of the e-Health master plan, roadmaps, action plans, annual priorities, and partner-supported activities.
  • Support the technical and functional monitoring of priority platforms such as DHIS2, eCHIS/CommCare, OpenClinic, mSupply/eLMIS, STELab, dashboards, and other solutions adopted by the Ministry.
  • Contribute to the mapping of data flows, indicators, and organizational units, the documentation of workflows, and the progressive application of interoperability standards.
  • Support the improvement of data quality, analysis, visualization, and use for decision-making, particularly in the areas of maternal health, child health, and malaria.
  • Contribute to addressing requirements related to data protection, cybersecurity, classification of digital interventions, service continuity, and digital sovereignty.
  • Support the establishment of sustainable mechanisms for training, e-learning, helpdesk services, knowledge base, user documentation, and skills transfer.
  • Produce and maintain guides, procedures, terms of reference, technical notes, reports, training materials, and knowledge capitalization documents.

Expected Results

  • The Directorate of e-Health has close, structured, results-oriented technical support.
  • Digital initiatives are better coordinated, better documented, and better aligned with the master plan.
  • Priority platforms, data, and interoperability workflows are better monitored.
  • Security, data protection, and digital sovereignty requirements are better addressed.
  • The capacities of national teams and users are sustainably strengthened.
  • Improved HIS for maternal and child health and malaria.

Expected Deliverables

  • Technical assistance work plan;
  • Technical notes, meeting minutes, reports, and presentations supporting the Directorate of e-Health;
  • Mapping platforms, data flows, interoperability needs, and prioritization matrices;
  • Contributions to Terms of Reference, specifications, guides, SOPs, procedures, and action plans;
  • Training materials, skills transfer documents, and knowledge base content;
  • Monthly or quarterly technical assistance reports, with operational recommendations.

REPORTING:

The Advisor will provide a detailed monthly report to the U.S. Department of State submitted by the 5th day of the following month. Additionally, the Advisor will submit a weekly progress report to U.S. Embassy/Department of State (and participate in weekly calls) to include a short paragraph about main successes for that week.

Qualifications

  • University degree at Master's level (Bac+5) or higher in computer science, information systems, public health, statistics, epidemiology, data management, digital health, systems engineering, or an equivalent field.
  • At least five to seven years of experience in health information systems, digital health, health platform management, data analysis, interoperability, technical documentation, or institutional support.
  • Experience working with a Ministry of Health, a central directorate, a national program, a health project, or a technical partner; knowledge of the Niger context and digital sovereignty issues.
  • Good knowledge of the e-Health master plan/strategy, its strategic pillars, priority projects, governance mechanisms, and implementation requirements;
  • Strong command of digital health standards, principles, and frameworks, including the classification of digital interventions, architecture frameworks, interoperability standards, and data governance best practices;
  • Knowledge of national and institutional requirements related to data protection, digital security, and compliance, particularly in connection with the ITU, HAPDP, CNAC, and ANSI;
  • Practical command of issues related to health platforms: DHIS2, eCHIS/CommCare, OpenClinic, mSupply/eLMIS, STELab, dashboards, and other national solutions;
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, realistic, and actionable functional and technical requirements for service providers and technical teams;
  • Ability to produce professional documents: Terms of Reference, specifications, technical notes, reports, procedures, user guides, and training materials;
  • Ability to support technical directorates, programs, and partners without replacing their own responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of maternal and child health and malaria national and/or global indicators and data priorities.

  • Collaborate with support staff to ensure projects advance the department’s mission and strategic security goals.

Other Duties:

  • Partner closely with the CIO to support development of IT strategy, priorities, and roadmap.

Qualifications:

  • Preferred master’s degree in information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience in securing Azure cloud environments and maintaining hybrid infrastructures is required.
  • Strong network experience in IT infrastructure, including design, implementation, and management of enterprise networks.
  • Strong grasp of business and management principles, with proven ability to oversee departmental operations.
  • Exceptional communication skills and able to articulate clearly.
  • Proven success in managing cross-functional teams and collaborating with executive leadership on security and compliance initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Cisco, Nutanix, FortiGate, SolarWinds, and Azure.

title: Liability Adjuster II
description:
JOIN THE ASSURANCEAMERICA TEAM

Do you want to be part of an organization where you are valued, and your ideas and opinions have an impact? Join the AssuranceAmerica team.

For more than 25 years, AssuranceAmerica has provided superior property and casualty insurance products through contracted independent agents and directly to customers. Our team succeeds through diversity of thought, experiences, skills, and backgrounds.

Liability Adjuster II

The Liability Adjuster II is responsible for managing a caseload of complex liability and coverage claims, including those involving minor bodily injuries. This role requires the execution of thorough investigations to gather all necessary facts, along with a strong understanding of policy language to ensure accurate and timely coverage and liability determinations. While working with a degree of autonomy, the Adjuster will collaborate with their supervisor for guidance on more nuanced or high-exposure cases.

About the ROLE

Each day at AssuranceAmerica is different, but as a Liability Adjuster II you will:

  • Conduct thorough investigations and evaluations of coverage, liability, and damages across all lines of personal automobile insurance/.
  • Accurately assess exposure and evaluate injury claims in a fair, consistent, and equitable manner based on the facts and extent of damages.
  • Negotiate timely and appropriate settlements, ensuring all required documentation is obtained to support proper claim resolution and closure.
  • Manage low-complexity, attorney-represented injury claims with sound judgement and attention detail, maintaining compliance with internal guidelines and industry standards.
  • Control expenses and adhere to company reserving philosophy by maintaining proper reserves
  • on all pending claims/potential exposures.
  • Meet and maintain general file handling goals and procedures as outlined by the company including maintaining a 1:1 closing ratio and status on diary reviews.
  • Properly utilize underwriting and policy systems and understand its features and functionality, as needed.
  • Attend any available seminars and classes applicable to this position and the skills required to meet the job duties and responsibilities.
  • Continually ask questions and have a desire to develop additional skills to better investigate and evaluate claims.

About YOU

  • Excellent communication skills with demonstrative ease with both verbal and written formats.
  • Attention to detail and ability to multi-task.
  • A high degree of motivation and team orientation.
  • Direct, results driven, and dedicated to the success of the business and each other.

Required

  • Minimum three years of experience handling auto claims.
  • Minimum of two years of experience handling complex liability and coverage issues and unrepresented bodily injury cases.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Non-standard experience.
  • Adjuster’s license in relevant state or the ability to obtain one quickly.
  • Bilingual (English-Spanish).

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
  • Must be able to navigate various departments of the organization's physical premises.

About US

  • We are direct, results-driven, and dedicated to the success of our business and each other.
  • We are a diverse group of thinkers and doers.
  • We offer many opportunities to grow in your professional skills and career.
  • We fight homelessness by directing 5% of our earnings from each policy we sell to organizations that help those in need. We call it our Generous Policy.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • AssuranceAmerica provides these benefits to Associates:
    • Premium healthcare plans: All full-time Associates and part-time Associates working a regular schedule of 30 hours, or more, are eligible for benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Voluntary Life, Flexible Spending Accounts, and a Health Savings Account.

YOU’RE INVITED TO APPLY

We believe the right fit is more important than a checklist. If you have most of what we’re looking for in this role and our culture and mission speak to you, contact us. We want to hear from you!

title: Senior QA Engineer II
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Senior QA Engineer II will lead quality efforts for products supporting healthcare providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. This role combines hands-on testing with technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is self-directed, organized, and committed to delivering reliable, accessible, and user-centered products.

This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to establish quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze business requirements, architecture, interfaces, integrations, and dependencies to develop comprehensive, risk-based test strategies.
  • Define and improve quality standards, testing practices, and processes across the team and partner teams.
  • Create and maintain test strategies, plans, cases, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications, including exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, end-to-end, and UI testing.
  • Define and advance test automation standards and coverage, balancing product risk with reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Test REST APIs and backend services for correctness, reliability, and resilience.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects and quality risks through resolution.
  • Lead root cause analysis with engineers to resolve defects and prevent recurrence.
  • Communicate test strategy, quality risks, release readiness, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify systemic quality and process issues, align the appropriate stakeholders, and drive practical improvements through completion.
  • Mentor engineers and other team members to strengthen quality practices and shared ownership of quality.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence and delivery speed.
  • Evaluate web and mobile applications against applicable accessibility requirements, including WCAG, through manual and automated testing.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing based on product risk and team needs.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of professional software quality assurance experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading quality initiatives across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Deep knowledge of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and risk-based testing for complex systems.
  • Strong understanding of web and mobile technologies, client-server architecture, APIs, integrations, and system dependencies.
  • Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform mobile applications on iOS and Android, including testing across devices, operating-system versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java.
  • Experience developing or improving test automation frameworks, standards, coverage, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Experience using modern web or mobile automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows.
  • Knowledge of accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG, with experience using tools such as Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test-management tools, such as Jira, in an Agile development environment.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks and technical tradeoffs to varied audiences.
  • A record of driving cross-functional quality or process improvements through completion.
  • Experience mentoring technical and non-technical colleagues and building quality capability across teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Retirement made easy! Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $165,000-$185,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

title: Staff Actuary - LTC Valuation
description:
Job Family

Actuarial

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit .

Job Description Summary

Initiates, organizes, and directs actuarial research, experience studies, statistical analyses, calculations and audits.

Job Description

Responsibilities


  • Develops actuarial assumptions to use in pricing, reserving or actuarial modeling, including experience studies in support of assumptions.
  • Coordinates, prepares, and performs actuarial analyses to develop pricing strategies, valuation approach or risk management strategies.
  • Develops and maintains profit studies, non-forfeiture values and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) actuarial items, reserve programs, rate files, procedures and/or similar processes.
  • Prepares actuarial portion of financial reports or other documents (e.g. state insurance department filings, rating agency survey forms, internal management reports, etc.).
  • Communicates actuarial research results to business unit management.
  • May develop, maintain and document computer-based programs, Sarbanes-Oxley procedures and model validation.
  • Maintains documentation of actuarial research and analyses.
  • Provides consultation and clarification on actuarial models and risk issues.
  • Coordinates and directs special actuarial projects.
  • May supervise one or more Actuarial Analysts, Actuarial Students or Actuarial Technicians.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor's Degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or related field and 5 years of relevant experience.
  • In lieu of Bachelor's, will accept Master's in a listed discipline and 3 years of relevant experience.
  • ASA or equivalent professional designation.
  • Demonstrates high quality judgment, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Effectively communicates, both verbally and in writing, advanced mathematical and analytical concepts to various audiences.
  • Works well under pressure and within time constraints to effectively accomplish individual and team objectives.
  • Advanced computer skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Programming skills.

Working Conditions

  • This is a hybrid position requiring three days (Tuesday-Thursday) in office per week in one of our hub locations (Cedar Rapids, Baltimore, Philadelphia, or Denver).
  • Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position

Compensation

The salary for this position generally ranges between $100,000 - $125,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.


Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus of 12.5% based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

description:

Job Summary

To administer trusts: Legal Claims Trusts (Medical Negligence and RAF) in accordance with the Trust Mandate. Responsible for taking all assets forming part of the trust into possession and to invest and administer these to the optimal benefit of the beneficiaries within the parameters of the Trust document and legislation.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Trust Administration

  • Administer trusts in accordance with trust deeds, legal requirements, policies and procedures.
  • Ensure trust assets are correctly transferred, protected and insured.
  • Manage property-related matters, including insurance, rates, taxes, rental agreements and tenant administration.
  • Review and process beneficiary requests, allowances and ad hoc payments.
  • Oversee trust terminations and distributions to beneficiaries.
  • Maintain accurate records, correspondence and trust documentation.

2. Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for trust beneficiaries, trustees and related stakeholders.
  • Attend to client enquiries and requests via telephone, email, correspondence and in-person engagements.
  • Provide ongoing updates regarding trust performance, investments, payments and administration.
  • Ensure service delivery aligns with agreed service standards and client expectations.

3. Investment Administration

  • Prepare investment proposals for trust funds in accordance with approved investment models and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of trust investment portfolios.
  • Present investment recommendations to Investment Committees for approval.
  • Ensure implementation and monitoring of approved investment strategies.

4. Risk, Compliance and Controls

  • Monitor trust risk reports, reconciliations, overdrafts and uninvested funds.
  • Identify discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure adherence to fiduciary legislation, internal policies, anti-money laundering requirements and trust governance principles.
  • Maintain audit-ready records and documentation.

5. Financial Reporting

  • Review and validate annual trust financial statements.
  • Ensure beneficiary statements, tax schedules and supporting documents are accurate and distributed timeously.
  • Maintain beneficiary records and follow up on outstanding documentation.

6. Tax Administration

  • Manage SARS registrations and ongoing tax compliance for trusts.
  • Submit annual and provisional trust tax returns via SARS eFiling.
  • Review tax assessments and arrange payment of taxes where required.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Law (NQF Level 6), or
  • Estate and Trust Diploma, or
  • Certificate in Deceased Estates Administration, or
  • Advanced Estate and Trust Diploma, or

Experience Required

Essential

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in a fiduciary environment as a Trust Officer or Estate Administrator.

Preferred

  • 3 years' experience in trust administration or fiduciary services.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong knowledge of trusts, fiduciary services and relevant legislation.
  • Understanding of trust taxation and SARS compliance requirements.
  • Investment administration and portfolio review capability.
  • Client relationship management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer literacy and proficiency in trust administration systems.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement.

Key Competencies

  • Client Focus
  • Planning and Organising
  • Attention to Detail
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Decision Making
  • Accountability
  • Results Orientation

  • Following Banfield protocols and practices, focusing the team to achieve practice priorities while building our culture and brand.

  • Day-to-day supervision of the team when called upon and ensuring quality medical care, exceptional client service, associate engagement and maximum productivity.
